items.sourceText:
## What's Changed
* Let Stop end a Claude turn that Claude no longer runs by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/14228
* Preview Word documents and open the agent workspace from Files by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/14223
* Ignore Linux GPU records that earlier versions wrote by mistake by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/14236
* build(nix): install OpenBot 0.76.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/14243
* Keep only the newest boat snapshots and accept a changed apt Label by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/14245
* Move late 0.76.0 release notes into CHANGELOG.md by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/14249
* Open the agent browser in its own window by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/14225
* Release v0.76.1 by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/14258


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/compare/v0.76.0...v0.76.1

## What's Changed
* Let agents find threads with the settings search by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13588
* Show a question card that the runtime snapshot leaves out by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13585
* Show why a provider Connect failed, and keep Pi warnings out of Last error by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13586
* Hide the OpenBot launcher when another launcher starts the AppImage by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13596
* Fit the window to a tile on tiling Linux desktops by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13589
* Let an agent run tasks at the same time and get their results back by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13577
* End an Antigravity routine run after routine_no_update by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13599
* Load older thread messages when the user scrolls near the top by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13594
* Tell the agent when a Telegram call fails because the relay is down by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13613
* build(nix): install OpenBot 0.75.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13621
* Send the channel result back to the agent that sent the request by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13575
* Let the user choose the ChatGPT account for GPT live voice by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13609
* Let the channel lead answer when routing times out by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13591
* Let OpenCode routines with nothing to report end quietly by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13629
* Download a Devin CLI that exists after a failed release check by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13625

* Say why a workflow image step did not make the image by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13667

items.sourceText: Following [1.4.268](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.268), here is the next round of Orca. Bots learn eight more agents, and the phone app catches up with the desktop. ## Bots on eight more agents, a fuller phone & a quieter Mac ✨ Bots can now run on Kiro, Kimi Code, Auggie, Gemini CLI, Kilo Code, MiMo Code, Droid and Goose, Chat opens more agents directly, and the phone app can answer, approve and set up almost everything the desktop can. - 🤖 **Run bots on more agents:** Bots can run on Kiro, Kimi Code, Auggie, Gemini CLI, Kilo Code, MiMo Code, Droid and Goose. Chat can open Kiro, Auggie and Goose too, and Kiro chats run your own hooks. - 📱 **Do more from your phone:** Answer an agent's questions and Google or Composio setup cards from its chat, review tool approvals and access requests in Needs you, manage an agent's tools and webhooks, start a new chat from +, and browse a group's threads and items. These need the matching mobile build. - 🔐 **Antigravity, your way:** Google account users can pick Orca's built-in Google sign-in or the agy agent, and agy has its own Sign in in Settings. - 💤 **A quieter Mac when idle:** Idle Mac terminals use less CPU, and Git work starts on the background process worker on macOS and Linux. - 🧭 **Clearer chats:** Older messages show calendar dates, Resume stands out in a paused queue, and Claude chats that settings block from Full access say so and pick the closest allowed mode. ## About Orca Bots (Beta) Orca Bots work like first-class teammates: they now run on many more agents, hand work to each other in group rooms, and send results you can actually open. - **Eight more agents behind your bots:** Kiro, Kimi Code, Auggie, Gemini CLI, Kilo Code, MiMo Code, Droid and Goose join the agents a bot can run on. - Links show progress while Bots publish them, and you can reject an access request right from its Give access dialog. - 🤝 **Hand-offs in group rooms:** When a bot names another member as @Name in its reply, that member picks up the turn. - 📎 **Results you can open:** Bots share a link, attach the file or give the content instead of a path on their own computer, and local paths in Slack messages become readable labels. - 🧩 **One skills folder per bot:** A bot's own skills live in one agent-neutral folder that every agent it runs on can use. ## Coming soon - Antigravity bug fixes - More connectors - Easier moving of bots between different machines - More performance improvements - Fix bots stall issues under heavy task load - Improved PR review workflow - More plugin API - Sidebar UX improvements --- ## What's Changed ### 🤖 Bots, connectors & access *Bots can run on Kiro, Kimi Code, Auggie, Gemini CLI, Kilo Code, MiMo Code, Droid and Goose, hand turns to each other with @Name in group rooms, and share results as links or attachments. Bot Settings rows fit on one line, connector icons match, and access requests can be rejected from their confirm.* * Never overwrite user Cursor/Hermes files; keep new-agent bots across a rollback by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45466 * Quick replies bind to their question, bounded avatar sync, offscreen loop pause (1.4.267 scan slice G) by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45504 * Stop generation when the requesting document ends by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45508 * Let bots run on Kiro by @LDH1103 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45533 * One agent-neutral skills folder for a managed agent's own skills by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45822 * A managed agent's @Name reply hands the turn to that member by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45845 * Use 32 px avatars in the sidebar by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45908 * Explain missing provider details in historical runs by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45910 * Let bots run on Kimi Code by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45911 * Let bots run on Auggie by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45963 * Let bots run on Gemini CLI by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45985 * Show progress while publishing or updating a link by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45989 * Deliver bot reports as links or attachments and redact local Slack paths by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45991 * Say Slack threads with an Orca chat keep that chat's agent by @brennanb2025 in item's asking message by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46005 * Let bots run on Kilo Code and MiMo Code by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46018 * Draw items.sourceText:
## What's changed

- Added sign-in to organizations managed in Anthropic's Enterprise Admin Console: after `claude auth login`, Claude Code applies the organization's settings and uses its cloud provider or gateway
- Added easel, a built-in mod that draws charts when asked and under MCP metrics results, on Pro, Max and, where available, Team and Enterprise on macOS and Linux; turn automatic charts off in `/config`
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_FULL_SIGN_IN_LINK=1` to print the full sign-in link, if the short one shows an error or a script reads values from it
- Self-hosted runner: Added `--start-dir` / `SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_START_DIR` to have Claude start its work in a folder of a repository, while settings and hooks load as without it
- Added a notice in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions when a plugin marketplace can't be fetched because its repository isn't one of the session's
- Self-hosted runner: Added a notice when Anthropic-managed git refuses a plugin's own repository, naming the plugin and what to do
- Added `commandPrinted` to `claude plugin install --json` results, true when the plugin's install command wrote to stderr, and `commandFailed` when it exited with an error, was killed or timed out
- Added `claude_code_self_hosted_runner_order_to_registered_seconds` to the self-hosted runner's `/metrics`: seconds from work order issued to registration accepted, on orchestrator-spawned runners
- Added `claude_code_self_hosted_runner_order_to_first_session_seconds` to the self-hosted runner's `/metrics`: seconds from work order to first session handed over, on runners started for a session
- Fixed Claude Code freezing for up to several minutes right after compacting a very long conversation
- Fixed WebFetch freezing the session for minutes on some pages, and returning an empty result for some others
- Fixed `ExitWorktree` and the worktree exit dialog deleting a worktree that another running Claude Code session was working in
- Fixed changes to user settings being lost when several Claude Code processes saved them at the same time
- Fixed `--continue` and `--resume` opening an empty session or failing when the last saved message had a missing or invalid timestamp
- Fixed the first prompt after a sleep of two minutes or more waiting three minutes on a connection that had died, on Linux and WSL
- Fixed turns failing with "JSON schema is invalid", and session files growing by many megabytes, when many MCP tools have an input schema that the API refuses
- Linux: Fixed Bash commands waiting seconds and showing no file diff for the rest of a session in slow repositories with large ignored folders such as `node_modules`
- Windows: Fixed Bash commands running slower for the rest of a session after Git Bash took 10 to 60 seconds to start, on machines with no custom start-up files
- Fixed `/rewind` sometimes restoring an older version of a file when two queued prompts, or stacked skills, ran together right after a turn that changed it
- Fixed text and images added when approving a permission prompt being dropped when the approved command or tool then failed
- Fixed MCP resources from claude.ai connectors and plugin servers not being attached when @-mentioned in the terminal's prompt box
- Fixed an MCP server that subagents declare being shut down when one of them finished, while other subagents or the session were still using it
- Fixed Claude in Chrome staying "not connected" after a brief connection problem, even though Chrome was open and signed in
- Fixed terminal sessions on Amazon Bedrock (Mantle) started with no model selected ignoring a pinned Opus model, and still calling an unavailable default model after announcing a fallback
- Fixed the rest of what you were typing being lost when a plan arrived in fullscreen mode
- Fixed claude.ai connectors with different names being dropped when they share a server URL (anthropics/claude-code#101856)
- Fixed plugins going missing from the installed list when several `claude plugin` commands ran at the same time
- Fixed task dependencies and metadata being lost when several task updates ran at the same time
- Fixed incomplete backups of `~/.claude.json` being kept, and displacing good ones, when the disk was full
- Fixed a long pause in Code Mode after code that read hundreds of files in projects with path-scoped rules or Read deny rules
- Fixed the built-in chart tool failing when Claude called it in Code Mode
- Fixed Code Mode ignoring an MCP tool's request to end the turn from a script in auto and bypass permissions modes
- Fixed Code Mode in auto mode dropping earlier thinking and rewriting the prompt cache when a mod added a note after a script loaded a skill
- Fixed Code Mode not restoring a file that a script had read after Esc and `/compact`
- Fixed `/context` undercounting system tools in Code Mode before Claude's first reply
- Fixed a stopped background subagent sometimes not staying stopped
- Fixed Claude still waiting for a background agent that was stopped just as it finished, in sessions run by an app or the SDK
- Fixed background sessions sometimes waking in their previous permission mode after approving a plan
- Remote Control: Fixed the note about background agents ended by a Stop from a phone or the web showing in the terminal as if you had typed it
- Remote Control: Fixed the mobile apps hiding the Diff and pull request buttons, or showing a stopped session as working, after turning it on mid-conversation
- Fixed environment variables written by a SessionStart hook being lost with `claude -p --continue`
- Fixed `claude -p` exiting 0 with no message when its output went to a file on a full disk: it now prints an error and exits 1, though a full NFS export may go unnoticed
- Fixed the system prompt keeping the earlier model's instructions when the model was changed after `/context` but before the first message
- Fixed Claude sometimes replying to its commit attribution reminder and ending the turn early after the model changed mid-turn; it can still happen where managed settings set the PR attribution line
- Fixed Esc not ending an LSP tool call that was waiting for a slow or stuck language server
- Fixed LSP tool calls and diagnostics failing when several calls or edits arrived while a language server was still starting
- Fixed `/mcp` listing plugin servers as built-in: they now stand under "Plugin MCPs", `--mcp-config` and built-in servers under "Other MCPs", and a server's page names its plugin
- Fixed an "MCP server blocked by enterprise policy: easel" warning showing at every start when an MCP allowlist or denylist excludes the built-in chart tool, which stays blocked
- Fixed `/stats` counting new activity in UTC days instead of your local time zone
- Fixed `/ultrareview` failing or reviewing the wrong code after the shell moved into another repository: it now stops and names both folders
- Fixed Grep reporting no matches when the pattern held a line break without multiline mode; it now reports the rejected pattern
- Fixed Jupyter notebooks saved with a byte order mark being reported as invalid JSON by the Read and NotebookEdit tools
- Fixed link reference definitions being dropped from CLAUDE.md and memory files that contain an HTML comment
- Fixed running Monitors keeping the earlier conversation in memory until they end
- Fixed some Claude Desktop sessions on third-party providers, other than scheduled tasks, ending a turn with "Prompt is too long" when a PDF larger than the context window followed a long conversation
- Fixed the choice between two user or project agent files declaring the same name depending on the order the file search listed them
- Fixed `claude daemon logs` never exiting inside a git repository when there is no log file
- Fixed markdown hiding a character or two after bold or italic text when a backslash came before an emoji later in the paragraph
- Fixed Edit refusing some valid hook commands in Claude settings files
- Fixed `Read` with a page range showing both halves of a scanned two-page spread on each of its pages
- Fixed line breaks and class stereotypes missing from Mermaid diagrams in HTML artifacts
- Fixed the Project instructions picker in `/config` showing only one of its four choices in a 24-row fullscreen window
- Fixed a subagent's own subagents and forks running on the plan-mode model in plan mode under `opusplan` or `haiku`
- Fixed WebFetch page summaries ignoring the `/effort` level when a gateway refuses the small fast model
- Fixed `claude -p` on Google Cloud's Agent Platform ignoring `--settings '{"fastMode":true}'` when the model comes from `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` or a settings file; such runs now bill at the fast mode price
- Fixed startup under `forceLoginOrgUUID` being refused after one temporary server error or dropped connection
- Fixed `claude mcp remove` giving no way forward for a claude.ai connector: it now says to turn it off in /mcp or remove it on claude.ai
- Fixed the /mcp "Connect on claude.ai" check saying "not connected" when claude.ai has a connector at the server's URL without its query
- Fixed `/install-github-app` and `/design-login` showing a generic failure for an account on hold instead of the on-hold notice and appeal link
- Fixed a running MCP task being reported as stopped when you move a session to the background; the background session can now follow the task, but not if its server uses stdio or sets headers
- Fixed self-hosted runners ignoring a session until they exited, after its failure report was lost or the session was given back to the same runner
- Fixed self-hosted sessions losing the prompt cache and earlier thinking when the list of repositories a restart couldn't prepare changed
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed tool calls behind a permission prompt vanishing with no result when a new runner took over the prompt, in sessions with telemetry off
- Fixed resumed self-hosted runner sessions starting without their pushed work in large repositories when `--push-outcome-on-release` is set
- Fixed self-hosted runner sessions being shown as working when Claude Code hangs at every start and `--startup-timeout-min` is from 2 to about 6
- Fixed `pkill -f` in self-hosted runner sessions on Linux ending its own shell with exit code 144, or the runner (needs a `pkill` with `--ignore-ancestors`)
- Fixed scheduled tasks on self-hosted runners having no tool to notify their owner when telemetry is off or a third-party provider is used
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed one slow `spawn-runner` hook keeping the orchestrator from claiming sessions for its free slots; it now polls every 4 to 6 seconds while a slot is free
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed a 403, such as an IP allowlist's, logged as a bad secret or token: most such lines now lead with the server's reason, so update log alerts that match the old words
- Fixed self-hosted runners' warn mode for repository settings stopping at the first finding of most kinds: it now goes on, up to 50 for a session, and says if it stops early
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed runners that start on a full disk taking sessions and failing them; they now wait for room and exit 1 after a minute with no session, unless started from a work order
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed a failed start suggesting a retry when the runner's machine had no git credentials; the error now says whom to ask and what to do if the repository is wrong
- Fixed the self-hosted runner's `last_poll_age_seconds` reading 0 while the runner had never polled successfully
- Fixed the notice about a skipped scheduled task that names no organization: it now says to start Claude Code with `--resume`, because `/resume` inside a running session doesn't run the task
- Fixed `claude plugin validate` wrongly warning that a mod's `AbovePrompt` or `AbovePromptList` hook never runs in VS Code
- Fixed `/design-sync` deleting a file it had just uploaded when Claude Design stored that file under a changed name
- Reverted 2.1.329's removal of the automatic retry when `max_tokens` exceeds a mod

details.change: 主な話題：不具合修正、モデル対応、MCP・外部連携。キーワードに基づく日本語の暫定分類です。具体的な変更内容と提供条件は公式原文で確認してください。
details.before: 旧版の具体的な挙動は取得した本文だけでは確認できません。比較結果は未確認です。
details.after: 「Claude Code v2.1.330：公式リリース」で案内された範囲が対象です。機能・提供条件は下の公式出典で照合してください。
details.workflow: 読み取り専用のテスト用コネクターを一つ接続し、最初のターンと再接続後に同じツールが使えるかを確認する。対象は「Claude Code v2.1.330：公式リリース」。この更新が必要な操作に影響するかを切り分けるための提案です。
steps: 現在の製品名・バージョン・ログイン方法を控え、公開データを使うテスト用フォルダを用意する。
読み取り専用のテスト用コネクターを一つ接続し、最初のターンと再接続後に同じツールが使えるかを確認する。同じ入力・同じ依頼を保存する。
公式ノートの対象バージョンに切り替え、同じ依頼を再実行する。成功可否・手直し回数・出力差分を記録する。
details.benefit: この作業で再現した場合に限り、やり直しや手動確認が減る可能性があります。速度・品質の改善率は測定していません。
details.environment: プラン・地域・アプリ/CLIの対応条件は公式ページで確認が必要です。
details.limitations: ChatGPT Plus / Claude Pro / Google AI Proの契約からAPI利用権や他製品の機能を推定しません。CLI・アプリ・Webの提供差に注意してください。

items.sourceText:
## What's Changed
* Refuse an unknown trigger event in edit_workflow by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12892
* Price GPT-6.2 Sol in agent usage by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12913
* release: prepare the mobile app v1.4.12 by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12915
* Save memory changes that a background subagent makes after the turn ends by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12911
* Send the Signal home on system_remote_connect by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12919
* Stop busy servers from running out of memory and freezing by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12929
* Show the agent's model on a workflow agent step by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12930
* End an ACP session start that the agent never answers by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12935
* Show the media node prompt panel only on hover by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12933
* Say why an MCP server did not start when it is down or cannot be reached by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12937
* Keep an ended turn from staying active after a late steer by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12936
* Show a workflow step's new result after you pick an older one by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12940
* Start a workflow loop at its leftmost entry on the canvas by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12944
* Save streamed text without a scan of the whole chat by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12949
* Copy reference connections when duplicating a canvas image node by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12938
* Show connected pictures on an Agent step and tell the agent to use them by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12945
* Show an empty state after a workflow delete by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12953
* Let workflow model steps read image inputs by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12951
* Add a media composer and Higgsfield settings to workflow steps by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12954
* Plan 012: archive ended pool servers in B2; prove export and import on a pool machine by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12789
* Fix the iOS release build and the Google Play feature check by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12967
* Keep the own git login for repositories without the GitHub app by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12974
* Close question notifications that ended while the app was offline by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12979
* Plan 012 item 2: D1 table and Worker secrets for pool server archives by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12912
* Give the run time of a schedule trigger to the next workflow steps by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12985
* End a stale chat turn that holds the agent's queue by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12994
* Detach open questions while a provider update or restart waits by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12997
* Keep Telegram chat history after a restart by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13003
* Keep a message that is sent while an idle provider briefly reports no sign-in by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13014
* Move an agent to its backup model when its model is gone (HTTP 410) by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13019
* Archive a replaced Codex session again when another app held it by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13016
* Add Run from this step to the workflow canvas step menu by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13021
* Plan 012 items 3, 5, 6: archive ended pool servers in B2 by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12928
* Hide the Codex missing source rollout error at start by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13035
* Keep a backup model until the usage limit resets when a usage read has no data by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13037
* Keep the steps of a quiet routine run with no text by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13034
* Restore open file tabs after a restart by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13044
* Stop the live voice from saying it hands requests to the agent by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13053
* Delete the throwaway ACP session of a background task by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13058
* Do not continue a turn that started a task by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13064
* Keep and show the settings of each workflow step by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13029
* Tell the requesting agent to send a request again after a temporary failure by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13068
* Show the openbot.run pages in all app languages by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13070
* Tell the user when the GitHub tools do not start for an agent by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13075
* Continue a Gemini turn after a refused sign-in token, also after work by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13086
* Finish an agent delete that a quit or reload stopped by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13088
* Load web page cards a few at a time by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13095
* Release a held teammate answer after a turn that started before it by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13101
* Give a chat app mention only its own file, not earlier ones again by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13113
* Find a Bitwarden CLI that nvm installed on a Mac or Linux by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13123
* Remove a ChatGPT safety-blocked turn so the chat can continue by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13129
* Run each Hermes session in its own process before Hermes 0.22.1 by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13150
* Keep skill ids readable when a short saved password is part of them by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13151
* Keep a teammate's internal result out of a WhatsApp, Slack, Telegram or Discord chat by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13155
* Stop reading retired ACP sessions again at each start by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13156
* End a ChatGPT turn quietly when a teammate sends the same result again by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13159
* Show a notice when a Claude turn ends with no answer by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13168
* Price GPT-6.2 Astra in agent usage by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13172
* Remove the false dictation shortcut from the agent settings search by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13230
* Say which step frees an agent folder that another program holds by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13231
* Keep an animated GIF moving when an agent sets its picture by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13234
* Keep a WhatsApp message that first arrives undecryptable by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13246
* Make the Claude model and usage checks obey the Claude setup switch by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13247
* Keep vowel, tone and accent marks in attachment names by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13255
* Read Vietnamese replies aloud without repeated words by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13259
* Run a routine again after the clock is corrected at startup by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13273
* Keep channel unread counts between channel list reads by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13276
* Run hidden Gemini MCP tools in the server process of the session by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13278
* Move to the next backup model when a dotted model name is unknown by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13279
* Keep the agent dock position after a Windows restart by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13297
* Show the error when a spent credit balance stops a turn by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13311
* Mark the mobile app 1.4.12 available on iOS, and turn on its cloud servers and browser flags by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13313
* Mark the mobile app 1.4.12 available on Android, and turn on its cloud servers and browser flags by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13319
* Download missing provider CLIs on a hosted server and leave caches out of pool archives by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13321
* Let the mouse wheel scroll the agent list on iPad by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13345
* Let a Grok channel member post its answer without a tool search by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13346
* Add utm_source=openbot to web links that a user opens from a chat by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13354
* Let touch taps reach the Windows agent dock by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13364
* Give invite discount on first payment only and pay yearly invite credit in 30-day parts by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13360
* Let the owner give a self-run server to another account by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12845
* Send a mobile message again after the app returns from the background by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13373
* Keep the model to go back to when the account pool moves a backup agent by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13374
* Show MCP sign-in on the mobile app for custom servers by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13377
* Show each Antigravity model pool in the mobile plan limits by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13384
* Keep Claude's "No response requested." line out of the chat by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13386
* Go back to the chat under a page on Back by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12253
* Place each finished-work card next to the seat of its agent by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/12837
* Start the stdio MCP servers of a Grok agent in OpenBot by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13390
* Open the dialer from phone numbers and tel: links in mobile chat by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13399
* Update bloub to 0.6.7 and remove its patch by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/13327

items.sourceText: A quick patch on [1.4.266](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.266) with stability and UI improvements. ## What's new in 1.4.267 - 🛠️ **Steadier status bar:** Stability improvements. by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44647 - 💬 **Smoother chat:** Finished turns now settle cleanly. by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45817 - 🤖 **Cleaner Bots card:** The sidebar intro card is simpler and fits any width. by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45442 ## Introducing Orca Bots (Beta) Orca Bots work like first-class teammates: every managed agent session gets its tools and identity, bots can share on the owner's behalf, they follow Slack threads and Gmail triggers more reliably, and connecting them is clearer and safer. - **Every bot session gets its tools and identity:** Managed agent sessions are no longer limited to Claude and Codex; each one starts with the tools and identity it needs. - 🔗 **Bots can share, just like the owner:** Agent CLI callers can use Sharing the same way the owner does. - 💬 **Slack threads show what a bot is doing:** A thread now reflects what its turn is working on, and long answers arrive whole instead of cut up. - 📬 **Gmail triggers match the real sender:** Triggers match the sender's actual address, not a display name that can differ. - 🛡️ **Clearer access warnings:** The access confirm dialog now spells out what you are allowing before you connect a bot. Everything else in 1.4.266 is unchanged. See the [1.4.266 release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.266) for the full list. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.266...v1.4.267

items.sourceText: We shipped more than one release today. Check out [1.4.267](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.267) and [1.4.266](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.266) too. ## Bots on more agents, richer Slack & a faster Orca ✨ Bots can now run on Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Hermes, Slack gets scheduling and canvases, and Orca does less work in the background so it feels quicker. - 🤖 **Run bots on more agents:** Bots can run on Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Hermes, and OpenCode 2.x bots get their standing instructions. New bots get an identity card, and Soul & Memory have redesigned editors. - 🖼️ **Send images and files:** Attach images and files in bot chats, group chats and item comments, including to a bot on a paired computer. Images on a Slack request reach the agent as images. - 💬 **More from Slack:** `orca slack post --at` schedules a post for later, and new `pin`, `canvas`, `list` and `scheduled` commands cover pins, canvases and lists. Connecting Slack takes the copied token without extra clicks, and mentions read as names. - ⚡ **A lighter, smoother Orca:** Animations run smoothly again instead of about once a second, spinners and pulses draw fewer frames, credential reads move off the main thread, and automatic heap profiles are gone. Orca also suggests cleaning up workspaces when the disk is almost full. - 🧭 **More reliable workers and chats:** Chats cut by a crash or restart can continue, a worker's final report wakes the agent that started it, and worker names in chat open the worker. Chat also gets Antigravity, Claude, Codex and Droid fixes. - 🌐 **Annotate pages on remote hosts:** Browser annotations now work on remote hosts too. ## About Orca Bots (Beta) Orca Bots work like first-class teammates: every managed agent session gets its tools and identity, bots can share on the owner's behalf, they follow Slack threads and Gmail triggers more reliably, and connecting them is clearer and safer. - **Every bot session gets its tools and identity:** Managed agent sessions are no longer limited to Claude and Codex; each one starts with the tools and identity it needs. - 🔗 **Bots can share, just like the owner:** Agent CLI callers can use Sharing the same way the owner does. - 💬 **Slack threads show what a bot is doing:** A thread now reflects what its turn is working on, and long answers arrive whole instead of cut up. - 📬 **Gmail triggers match the real sender:** Triggers match the sender's actual address, not a display name that can differ. - 🛡️ **Clearer access warnings:** The access confirm dialog now spells out what you are allowing before you connect a bot. ## Coming soon - Antigravity bug fixes - More connectors - Easier moving of bots between different machines - More performance improvements - Fix bots stall issues under heavy task load - Improved PR review workflow - More plugin API - Sidebar UX improvements --- ## What's Changed ### 🤖 Bots, connectors & access *Bots can run on Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Hermes, get redesigned Soul & Memory editors and a new-bot identity card, and take images and files in chats and item comments. Slack gains scheduled posts, pins, canvases and a smoother setup, and paired servers get clearer sign-in.* * Generate an avatar with an installed image-capable agent by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44361 * History sharing on Linux without perl takes Codex's lock coordination through flock(1) by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45028 * Only mark a chat turn local when its journal proves Orca began it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45040 * Keep other computers' bots visible in the new-group picker by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45122 * Ask in a normal comment with quick replies, keeping the comment box by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45139 * Show the full hovercard on collapsed Bots avatars by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45141 * Route a paired server's groups back to that server by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45146 * Slack mentions read as names in titles, earlier messages and notifications by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45156 * New bot: identity items.sourceText:
## New Features

- Added GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra to model catalogs, with Sol as the default catalog selection. (#62106)
- Enabled the TUI workspace by default, with searchable document previews, image previews, and subagent transcripts alongside the main conversation. (#61352, #61888, #61889, #61919, #62157)
- Added configurable undo and redo shortcuts to the non-Vim prompt composer, including restoration of attachments and large pastes. (#61954)
- Added `codex exec --remote <ADDR>` to start or resume noninteractive sessions on an existing app server. (#61707)
- Added `/rc` and `/remote` to manage local remote control and display device pairing codes from the TUI. (#62121)
- Added custom MCP status line selection and authoring through `/statusline` when `tui_extensions_statusline` is enabled. (#61979, #61988, #62037)

## Bug Fixes

- Preserved drafts, queued follow-ups, and interrupted input with their original threads when switching or resuming sessions. (#61216)
- Kept permission profiles intact when changing working directories. (#61195)
- Prevented late completion events from cancelling approvals for a newer turn. (#61801)
- Preserved earlier edits in aggregate diffs when steering an active turn. (#61820)
- Fixed scrolling that inserted stray characters, composer caret jumps, and redraws using stale terminal dimensions. (#62139, #62174, #62175)
- Fixed enterprise MCP sign-in for identity providers that issue ID tokens without refresh tokens. (#62129)

## Chores

- Updated source builds and release tooling to Rust 1.99.1. (#61205)
- Updated XML dependencies and removed obsolete security advisory exceptions. (#62068)

items.sourceText:
## What's changed

- Added a trust dialog warning that says where a folder's hooks are declared
- Added a warning in the conversation, in Claude Desktop and other non-interactive hosts, when hooks in managed settings fail to load
- Added this session's scheduled tasks, `/loop` wakeups, the goal and this conversation's forks to `/tasks`; x stops one after asking
- Added a "Server message" row to a server's page in `/mcp` that shows the JSON-RPC error message of a remote HTTP MCP server that refuses the connection
- Added a "Marketplace auto-update" row to `/status` that names managed marketplaces that get no automatic updates, and why
- Added support for turning on Code Mode while OpenTelemetry events and metrics are enabled; each tool call the code makes sends its events; tracing still keeps it off
- Fixed `~/.claude.json` sometimes being reset to defaults when a network stall or file lock made it unreadable and cleared during a save
- Fixed repeated sign-outs on macOS when Claude Code could read the Keychain but not save to it. That session now stops at expiry and says why, and other sessions stay signed in
- Fixed `/terminal-setup` corrupting VS Code settings or keybindings files around block comments, and reporting success while losing the Shift+Enter binding where keybindings.json has an unclosed string
- Fixed files accepted through the IDE diff being saved without their last newline, and losing their byte order mark (BOM) when an edit was accepted by saving the diff in VS Code
- Fixed picking a cloud session in `/teleport` replacing your open conversation: the pick now starts a new session, as `/clear` does, and `/resume` brings the old one back
- Fixed `/usage-credits` asking Pro and Max users to log in again after opening the browser, and the link disappearing after 8 seconds if the browser doesn't open and a task stops for usage credits
- Fixed `/usage` saying usage credits are off when they had run out or reached the monthly limit, and `/model` not telling Pro and Max users when that limit blocks a model that runs on usage credits
- Fixed the spend limit menu showing your spend as your monthly limit and wrapping its rows under the pointer in narrow windows
- Fixed a status line script that prints without end freezing the prompt and using gigabytes of memory
- Fixed an empty, frozen screen after approving managed settings while the --resume picker, the trust dialog or another set-up screen was waiting
- Fixed choosing Default in `/model` replacing your saved model with your organization's default when the Default row already showed your saved model
- Fixed an MCP server being signed in again after you cleared its authentication while a token refresh was running
- Fixed background MCP tasks that stalled after a slow reconnect: Claude Code now reconnects most HTTP MCP servers by itself when one is left on an older protocol version
- Fixed PDFs, images and `.docx`, `.xlsx` or `.pptx` files that MCP servers or websites send as `application/octet-stream` being saved as .bin, which kept Claude from reading the PDFs and images
- Fixed `/code-review <pr number>` sometimes reviewing the checked-out branch instead of the pull request without saying so: it now reads the pull request with `gh pr diff`, or says when it can't
- Fixed `/code-review` stopping at a permission prompt, on most models, to look for a `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` that doesn't exist
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed `--push-outcome-on-release` sometimes deleting a session's branch on the git host
- Fixed Code Mode hiding a script's finished edits and the stopped command after Esc, and losing them on exit
- Fixed a runaway loop in Code Mode filling the machine's memory; it is now stopped at a limit
- Fixed a background agent running on when it was stopped while it was being resumed
- Fixed background shell commands using memory for the earlier conversation until they exit
- Fixed Remote Control using memory for the earlier conversation after a compaction or `/clear` in sessions run by Claude Desktop, IDEs or the SDK
- Fixed Stop not ending a request in Claude Desktop sessions on Bedrock while it waits on a hung AWS credential_process or sign-in call
- Fixed Claude sometimes failing to send you a file on its first try on Opus 4.8 and Opus 5
- Fixed Claude not being told that a connected MCP server's tools could not be loaded, and taking it for a server with no tools, in sessions with tool search
- Fixed `claude mcp login` and `/mcp` saying a service doesn't accept sign-ins from Claude Code when the service's client registration had been retired (HTTP 410 Gone)
- Fixed another case of claude.ai-synced plugin hooks failing with "Plugin directory does not exist" while a session was still running on macOS
- Fixed auto mode asking for manual approval to `rm` a symlink that points outside the working directory or at itself
- Fixed `/sandbox` on Linux listing `allowUnixSockets` entries as allowed: they don't open those sockets there, and `/sandbox` now says so
- Fixed pressing Esc twice to clear a mistyped code ending the sign-in in `/install-github-app`
- Remote Control: Fixed sessions going back to their first effort level after a restart while the app still showed the level you picked (not yet for sessions that start in Ultracode)
- Fixed a removed plugin's MCP server staying connected in headless sessions after `reload_plugins` or when the account's plugin list drops it
- Fixed the Claude Docs connector's tools going missing when a plugin or MCP server at the same address failed to connect, and its error wrongly suggesting `/login`
- Fixed a new skills, commands or agents folder being missed when `--add-dir` names the working directory or Claude Code starts in the home folder
- Fixed sessions started from a pre-warmed process ignoring the `autoCompactWindow` setting in the project's `.claude/settings.json`
- Fixed `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` staying in effect in a running session after it is removed from settings.json
- Fixed the Agent tool's `effort` parameter being ignored for named teammates in agent teams
- Fixed `/auto-mode-setup` ignoring recent auto mode denials when it scans a project for rules to suggest; it may now offer allow rules from them, and you review each before it's saved
- Fixed a false "Couldn't save this change" warning after adding a permission rule or directory in a subfolder or worktree whose own `.claude/settings.local.json` is unreadable or malformed
- Fixed cloud sessions telling Claude to run a network proxy check after a failed request, which auto mode then blocked
- Fixed headless rewind and fork going ahead while a message sent right after a model change still waited on it
- Fixed Claude not being told when a background task was stopped while a cloud session was restarting
- Fixed `/team-onboarding` reporting a guide as shared on Team and Enterprise plans when the server refused the upload
- Fixed panels and questions being cut off at the prompt in fullscreen, `/help`, history search and the background tasks list losing rows or titles in short windows, and tables wrapping in dialogs
- Fixed resumed sessions showing "Rejected" or "Declined" for edits, questions and plans that were cut off when the session ended
- Fixed `/passes` showing the wrong number of passes after a server error, and offering usage credits for sharing when no guest passes are left
- Fixed `claude --help` output being cut short when piped to another program
- Fixed `/terminal-setup` turning on "Use Option as Meta key" in Terminal.app on macOS 27, and tips there suggesting Option+Enter instead of Shift+Enter
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed setup failing on Git LFS repositories cloned through Anthropic-managed git; sessions now start on pointer files, and `git lfs pull` fetches the content
- Fixed sessions on self-hosted environments not starting from a git remote with an SSH host alias, GitHub SSH certificates or a GHE.com SSH user; an unresolved alias's error gives two git commands
- Fixed remote MCP servers in self-hosted runner sessions staying without tools, or (over https) disconnected, after a timeout or network error
- Fixed self-hosted runner sessions being shown as having stopped responding while Claude Code was still starting
- Fixed Code Mode keeping in memory every large text file that code read, and memory growing each time a background subagent was woken
- Fixed Code Mode stopping a script at its ten-minute limit while an MCP form, an MCP link prompt or a prompt that always asks was waiting for an answer
- Fixed Code Mode scripts receiving a "moved to the background" message as data from most MCP calls over two minutes: the script now waits up to ten minutes, then gets an error
- Fixed mods that list only some tools silently turning Code Mode off; such a mod no longer keeps it off, so use managed settings for that
- Fixed Code Mode ignoring an MCP tool's request to end the turn when the tool was called from a script that Claude waits for
- Fixed a Code Mode script's `let x;` keeping the value that an earlier script gave `x`
- Fixed a Code Mode script's call with no argument failing with a missing-parameter error on tools that need none
- Fixed Code Mode scripts losing access to tools through `tools` in sessions with more than 4,096 tools
- Fixed the `/code-review` findings card often showing "high" for a review that ran at medium, on most models
- Fixed key hints in permission prompts, questions, `/model` and `/rewind` ignoring `keybindings.json`
- Fixed auto-scroll, the PR status badge, the auto-compact warning and the ultracode tag not following the `/config` switches that control them in a running session
- Fixed a custom cancel key not working in `/add-dir`, `/tui` feedback and the save-workflow form
- Fixed arrow keys in the save-workflow form moving the selection in the workflow view behind it
- Fixed `/config` saying nothing, or "dismissed", after changing many settings
- Fixed Read and @-mentions showing one line too many for files that end in a newline
- Fixed `/status` not naming the model that opusplan and haiku use in plan mode
- Fixed `claude doctor` advising a Keychain unlock inside a macOS sandbox, where unlocking can't help
- Fixed the "Jump to bottom" pill staying hidden after copying text and scrolling away, the row under it going blank when its label changed, and quick PageUp presses scrolling too far in fullscreen
- Fixed a screen update sometimes being skipped when memory is low
- Fixed long code blocks losing a blank line and repeating another in scrollback
- Fixed prompt suggestions sometimes showing placeholder text such as `_(no suggestion)_`
- Fixed the line about earlier messages on resume blaming a damaged file when the file was intact
- Fixed characters disappearing from the prompt when its text held a color code that sets several styles and a keyword or command was highlighted
- Fixed `/rename` and `UserPromptSubmit` hook titles in `claude remote-control` sessions not showing on claude.ai and mobile
- Fixed the Remote Control diff listing a file twice when the branch renamed it and it was then edited
- Improved the automatic clean-up of old sessions on computers with managed settings
- Improved `/tui` and other in-place restarts to wait briefly for a login refresh, so they are less likely to sign you out
- Improved memory use in long sessions that edit many files, and in long Claude Desktop sessions on macOS and Linux with many large MCP tool results
- Windows: Improved start-up and the first search on PCs where Claude Code's search program starts slowly
- Improved auto mode's handling of a short reply such as "yes" to Claude's question when telemetry is off, behind a gateway to the Anthropic API, or on Microsoft Foundry
- Improved memory use of idle Claude Desktop and SDK sessions after a long turn, and after `--resume` or `--continue` of a session that holds screenshots or large tool results
- Improved how fast a Claude Desktop Code session with Remote Control on is read

## What's Changed
* Changelog for v0.69.0-preview.0 by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30222
* Changelog for v0.68.0 by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30224
* chore(release): bump version to 0.70.0-nightly.20261110.g1603e9bab by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30223
* test(cli): remove redundant lowercase restart test in AdminSettingsChangedDialog by @luisfelipe-alt in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30221
* fix(cli): preserve Unicode prompts and strip ANSI fragments in session previews (#29915) by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30220
* fix(cli): preserve selected worktree across authentication restarts (#30078) by @duvanka-prasad in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30176
* fix(core): preserve interrupted placeholder after empty model responses to tool turns by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30228

* fix(core): scale undici bodyTimeout when request timeout exceeds 300s default by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30258
* fix(core,cli): report accurate output token limits in models list by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30253
* fix(cli): restore workspace directories only after resumeChat succeeds by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30259
* fix(core,cli): scope foreground retry status to active main prompt and current model policy by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30266
* fix(cli): initialize auth capabilities and deduplicate options when listing models by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30271
* fix(cli): skip system MCP servers with insecure command permissions by @elberthc-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30283

* chore(deps): update workspace dependencies and sandbox runtime packages by @DavidAPierce in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30321
* fix(cli): disclose canonical link path and default consent prompt to no by @jvargassanchez-dot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30289
* fix(cli): detect local git clone from CLI path instead of cwd by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30315
* fix(ide): use per-user discovery directory and atomic port file writes by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30340
* ci: pre-pull triage image and clear Docker login in dedup workflows by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30342
* fix(core): keep ASK_USER for shell commands with unresolved expansion by @luisfelipe-alt in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30338
* fix(core): match commandPrefix and commandRegex rules against the top-level command argument by @luisfelipe-alt in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30355
* chore(deps): adjust workspace dependency pins and update simple-git by @DavidAPierce in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30356

items.sourceText: [Previous release: 1.4.264](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.264) — Chat commands find their workspace, keeping browser work with the right chat. ## Introducing Orca Bots (Beta) Orca Bots work like first-class teammates: every managed agent session gets its tools and identity, bots can share on the owner's behalf, they follow Slack threads and Gmail triggers more reliably, and connecting them is clearer and safer. - **Every bot session gets its tools and identity:** Managed agent sessions are no longer limited to Claude and Codex; each one starts with the tools and identity it needs. - 🔗 **Bots can share, just like the owner:** Agent CLI callers can use Sharing the same way the owner does. - 💬 **Slack threads show what a bot is doing:** A thread now reflects what its turn is working on, and long answers arrive whole instead of cut up. - 📬 **Gmail triggers match the real sender:** Triggers match the sender's actual address, not a display name that can differ. - 🛡️ **Clearer access warnings:** The access confirm dialog now spells out what you are allowing before you connect a bot. ## Highlights **Bots, connectors and access.** Connect a bot through a faster connector picker with category icons, a trimmed Slack connect dialog that shows how to mention the bot once it is installed, and a clearer access-control warning. Other conversations are listed for reference only in an agent's context, so a bot stays focused on the one it was asked about. Finish alerts and worker stop reports carry the reply a transcript read adds, and agents are told which mail type to set, including over `--on`. **A lighter desktop for busy chats and terminals.** Long tab strips render only the visible region, session saves write changed entries, new messages get through while other chats stream, and a terminal scroll loop that could freeze the window is fixed. **Send while other chats stream.** A new chat’s sending work gets priority over background streaming writes. Hidden composers also stop listening to every keystroke, and closed chats release status rows they no longer need. These changes reduce competing work when several conversations are active. **Read status without losing the thread.** Expand activity rows for details or open a subagent’s own view. Text before a question remains visible after the turn folds, retained diagrams survive workspace switches, and failed loads of earlier messages offer Retry. **Use the agent on the right host.** Claude and Codex installation follows the host where the chat runs. An existing personal installation takes precedence; Orca’s managed copies are available to its terminals too. Remote account controls and usage displays also receive fixes. **Choose automatic desktop updates.** Enable **Automatic updates** in **Settings → General → About** to let Orca download, install and relaunch using your update cadence, channel and delay. It defaults to off. Automatic installation waits if it would terminate a live or launching in-process terminal, a WSL move is active, or window state cannot be saved. **Phone compatibility.** The phone changes listed below are source changes included in this release boundary. Installing this desktop update does not install a mobile app update; those features require the corresponding mobile build. --- ## What's Changed ### Bots, connectors & access * Drawer tabs use the app's loading, empty and error states by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44388 * The agent's drawer and its settings pages use the shared sheet header by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44402 * Chat on the phone: agent, automation, CI and subagent events become status rows by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44440 * Show why the agent's drawer couldn't load, and give its item page the sheet back button by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44459 * Finish alerts and worker stop reports carry the reply a transcript read adds by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44649 * Tell agents which mail type to set, including over --on by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44332 * Agent context: other conversations are listed for reference only by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44738 * Agents: give every managed session its tools and identity, not just Claude and Codex by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44837 * Sharing: let agent CLI callers share, as the owner can by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44880 * Open the connector picker faster by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44048 * Tell a Slack thread what its turn is doing, and send long answers whole by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44384 * Add connector category icons by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44662 * Remove connector category counts items.sourceText: New Features Added GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra to model catalogs, with Sol as the default catalog selection. ( #62106 ) Enabled the TUI workspace by default, with searchable document previews, image previews, and subagent transcripts alongside the main conversation. ( #61352 , #61888 , #61889 , #61919 , #62157 ) Added configurable undo and redo shortcuts to the non-Vim prompt composer, including restoration of attachments and large pastes. ( #61954 ) Added codex exec --remote <ADDR> to start or resume noninteractive sessions on an existing app server. ( #62121 ) Added custom MCP status line selection and authoring through /statusline when tui_extensions_statusline is enabled. ( #61979 , #61988 , #62037 ) Bug Fixes Preserved drafts, queued follow-ups, and interrupted input with their original threads when switching or resuming sessions. ( #61216 ) Kept permission profiles intact when changing working directories. ( #61195 ) Prevented late completion events from cancelling approvals for a newer turn. ( #61801 ) Preserved earlier edits in aggregate diffs when steering an active turn. ( #61820 ) Fixed scrolling that inserted stray characters, composer caret jumps, and redraws using stale terminal dimensions. ( #62139 , #62174 , #62175 ) Fixed enterprise MCP sign-in for identity providers that issue ID tokens without refresh tokens. items.sourceText: [Previous release: 1.4.265](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.265): Orca Bots as first-class teammates, with a lighter desktop for busy chats. ## Introducing Orca Bots (Beta) Orca Bots work like first-class teammates: every managed agent session gets its tools and identity, bots can share on the owner's behalf, they follow Slack threads and Gmail triggers more reliably, and connecting them is clearer and safer. - **Every bot session gets its tools and identity:** Managed agent sessions are no longer limited to Claude and Codex; each one starts with the tools and identity it needs. - 🔗 **Bots can share, just like the owner:** Agent CLI callers can use Sharing the same way the owner does. - 💬 **Slack threads show what a bot is doing:** A thread now reflects what its turn is working on, and long answers arrive whole instead of cut up. - 📬 **Gmail triggers match the real sender:** Triggers match the sender's actual address, not a display name that can differ. - 🛡️ **Clearer access warnings:** The access confirm dialog now spells out what you are allowing before you connect a bot. We shipped two releases today. Check out the [previous release, 1.4.265](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.265) too. ## Sign in to Antigravity your way Antigravity chats can now sign in with a Gemini API key or Google Agent Platform (ADC), and new chats run on a signed-in agy so chat, quota and the picked account all agree. More agents also work out of the box: Orca installs its own copies when a host has none. - 🔑 **Gemini API key or Google Agent Platform:** Choose how an Antigravity chat signs in, and see the same account in chat and quota. - 📦 **More agents, ready to use:** Orca installs its own OpenCode, Cursor, Copilot, Grok, Kimi Code and OMP when a host has none, and offers CLI updates for every native-chat agent. - 🛡️ **Steadier Antigravity on every platform:** Auto-updates stay off for host launches, Windows discovery and hook timing are fixed, and the reviewer decides on tool use. - 🖼️ **Image previews:** Recent pasted and dropped images show a preview, and Codex CLI image previews work. - 📱 **A friendlier phone:** Unread bells on agent rows and session tabs, your host's Orca version with update steps, and no more endless spinners on desktops it cannot reach. ## Highlights **Bots, comments and the sidebar.** Reorder Bots and Projects in the sidebar, write longer item comments in a stacked composer, step through items without leaving it, and reply to an open question straight from its card in Activity. The collapsed Bots sidebar is clearer, and Slack mentions in agent chat show as names. **Quieter, calmer chats.** Finished quiet turns hide their Worked for bar with a gentle fade, and resume-on-restart is a small toast instead of a dialog. Terminal tabs keep their name after they close and on resume. **Built for paired servers.** Open localhost links from SSH and paired hosts in that host's Orca browser, play video and audio in remote HTML previews, and read and change a server's notification switches from a paired client. Headless servers stop advertising updates they cannot perform. **Lighter on your machine.** Session saves keep unchanged entries identical, host status work happens only for hosts that changed, and Windows tools launch from absolute System32 paths. Linux opens a password-less keyring before falling back, and repackaged .deb installs are no longer handed to dpkg. **Phone compatibility.** The phone changes listed below are source changes included in this release boundary. Installing this desktop update does not install a mobile app update; those features require the corresponding mobile build. --- ## What's Changed ### Bots, connectors & access Item composer, Slack mentions, sidebar polish and safer connector output. * Dashboard and Activity rebuild only the panes that changed by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43033 * Orca slack post and attach take @person and DM them by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44224 * Enlarge the item comment box into a stacked composer by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44597 * Allow reordering Bots and Projects in the sidebar by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44672 * Slack read output shows Slack mention tokens by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44849 * Agent chat shows Slack user mentions as names by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44851 * Stop reserving space under the item comment box by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44858 * One line per bot in the @ picker, with a gap between rows by @AmethystLiang in Activity by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44879 * Tip the bot when its Needs you ask is hard to read by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44902 * Filter plan step titles sent to a Slack thread for secrets (STA-16258) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44928 * Clarify bot sidebar card: host icon, actionable Needs you hovercard, chat clicks only switch by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44967 * Step through items from the comment box by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44968 * Compact item row hover actions by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45063 * Improve the collapsed Bots sidebar by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45069 ### 📱 Phone & mobile *Phone changes cover Home, Agents, History, workspace menus and chat. They require a corresponding mobile build (0.0.68).* * Make the agent drawer's Settings read-only while the computer is offline by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44841 * Stop items.sourceText:
# Hermes Agent v0.23.3

**Release Date:** November 19, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~370 PRs merged since v0.23.2 into a stable release for the GitHub release (CLI and installers), the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.24.0.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## About this release

Measured at commit `caafe5389ae`, the window since v0.23.2 contains **1,657 non-merge commits** across **3,948 changed files** (+222,379 / −96,154), **370 merged PRs** and **60 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: one prompt-cache lifecycle controller (warming through long tool runs, compaction of idle chats before the 1h cache expires, Nous Portal on the full 1h lifecycle, `prompt_caching.cache_ttl` defaulting to `auto`), compaction that archives the tool results it drops, the proactive tool-result prune on by default, a one-question first-run CLI setup with the free tier included, GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol (+ Pro) on OpenRouter and Nous Portal, a "Waiting on teammates" strip above Bot Chat composers, the Linux AppImage agent payload run from a stable per-build copy, the storage layer split behind a persistence interface with its SQLite backend, dependency security bumps (oauthlib, opentelemetry, tornado), and a large batch of new plugin-catalog entries.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.24.0**, which will document everything from v0.23.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Updating

- Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
- Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: [v0.23.2...v0.23.3](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v0.23.2...v0.23.3)
