items.title: Claude Code v2.1.328：公式リリース
items.summary: 主な話題：安全性・権限管理、不具合修正、モデル対応。キーワードに基づく日本語の暫定分類です。具体的な変更内容と提供条件は公式原文で確認してください。
items.why: MacとWindowsのAIエージェントに作業を委任する際の安全性に関わるため、優先して確認する価値があります。
items.try: 検証用リポジトリで現在の設定をバックアップし、権限・サンドボックス動作を更新前後で比較してください。
items.availability: プラン・地域・アプリ/CLIの対応条件は公式ページで確認が必要です。
items.sourceText:
## What's changed

- Added auto mode for Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry and Claude apps gateway; interactive sessions with no permission mode start in it
- Added `"onFailure": "block"` for `mcp_tool` hooks, as for command and HTTP hooks: a hook whose call fails blocks the action
- Added a warning when a message from a session that skips permission prompts may be held and dropped by a cloud session
- Added a notice in `/status` and `claude doctor` when an OpenTelemetry exporter has no endpoint and its data would likely be lost
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_DEFERRED_TOOL_RESUME`, which lets a host stop `claude -p --resume` and `--continue` from running a tool call that a hook deferred
- Added support for apps that embed Claude Code to switch on the policy plugin's `allowManagedModsOnly` option; an admin's managed settings still win
- Added a startup warning to the Claude apps gateway when a policy's `maxEffortLevel` is not a valid effort level
- Self-hosted runner: Added `--repository-folder` to name the folder that sessions use for a repository at `--capacity 1`, in place of its path under the base folder, which can't be a symbolic link
- Self-hosted runner: Added a start-up warning when the host's settings.json sets a default permission mode that sessions ignore
- Self-hosted runner: Added `--hook-label` to `claude self-hosted-runner orchestrator`, to hand chosen session labels to the `spawn-runner` hook
- Self-hosted runner: Added `--metadata key=value` to `claude --environment`, to label a session for the `spawn-runner` hook
- Self-hosted runner: Added `claude_code_self_hosted_orchestrator_session_queue_wait_by_reason_seconds` to the orchestrator's `/metrics`, so a re-opened session's wait can be told from a new one's
- Self-hosted runner: Added an orchestrator metric, `claude_code_self_hosted_orchestrator_sessions_given_up_total`, that counts by cause how often Anthropic gave up starting a runner for a session
- Fixed Bash commands in zsh stopping with a "not found" error at a word that starts with `=`, such as `echo ====` or `[ a == b ]`; `=cmd` no longer expands to a command's path
- Fixed automatic compaction reusing the session's earlier system prompt instead of rebuilding it the way `/compact` does
- Fixed markdown rendering freezing on some very long or malformed input
- Fixed rare screen freezes
- Fixed Esc often being lost at a permission prompt or question when you typed straight after it; in terminals that send Alt as Esc and a key, an unused Alt or Option key now declines there
- Fixed a paste or a terminal's reply being typed into the prompt when a slow connection cut it in two
- Fixed saving a scheduled task erasing the project's other saved tasks when the scheduled tasks file can't be read, on third-party providers or with telemetry or feature flags turned off
- Fixed a scheduled task with a typo in the project's scheduled tasks file being deleted the next time that file was saved
- Fixed a case where a resumed cloud session could lose its compaction summary or recent messages when a message was saved late
- Fixed the token counts on the spinner and for subagents counting a retried reply twice, missing replies that were not streamed, and standing still while Claude thinks
- Fixed the error shown when usage credits run out mid-response, which named a rate limit
- Fixed auto mode failing every turn outside Claude Desktop with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` set behind a gateway rejecting betas, on Bedrock, Agent Platform, Foundry or Claude apps gateway
- Fixed `CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS` not lengthening the 5-minute connection limit on gateways, custom base URLs and cloud providers
- Fixed some Claude Desktop sessions on third-party providers, other than scheduled tasks, ending for good with "Prompt is too long" after large tool results; the largest are now left out
- Fixed MCP tools whose input schema starts with `anyOf`, `oneOf` or `allOf` going missing on third-party providers or with telemetry or feature flags turned off
- Fixed an MCP tool with an invalid input schema failing requests on third-party providers or with telemetry or feature flags turned off; the tool is now left out and Claude is told why
- Fixed effort being turned off for a subagent's model for the session if Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform or Foundry refused its progress summary's effort setting (regression in 2.1.327)
- Fixed Code Mode stopping a script when a permission prompt outside auto or bypass mode, a plan approval or a question stayed open for ten minutes
- Fixed Code Mode scripts in auto and bypass-permissions modes failing to call an MCP server that had connected while the previous script was running
- Fixed Code Mode scripts not running in the background in auto or bypass permissions mode in a session chosen in the `claude --resume` picker
- Fixed Code Mode losing a loaded skill, hook context or a note typed with a permission approval when resuming a session in which one reply ran several scripts
- Fixed Claude not being told that a Code Mode script was cut off when the session was resumed from the picker or in a mode that asks for permission
- Fixed Code Mode silently using `undefined` for top-level variables that an earlier failed script never set
- Fixed Code Mode scripts not being told when a failing command's long output was cut
- Fixed Code Mode refusing valid scripts that start with a `{` block
- Fixed Code Mode refusing scripts that use both a top-level `await` and a top-level `return`
- Fixed an @-mentioned small file not being attached in Code Mode after a script had read or written it
- Fixed Code Mode offering `write()` and `edit()` to read-only subagents that can't call them
- Fixed Claude starting a turn by itself in Code Mode when Esc was followed by a command such as `/model`
- Fixed Claude in Code Mode not being told to run workflows only when you ask, or the workflow size you set in `/config`
- Fixed Remote Control repeating the same disconnect message, and telling you to retry a session that can't reconnect
- Fixed a waiting permission prompt being lost, and its answer ignored, when a remote session restarted while the service was slow
- Fixed cloud sessions resuming a cleared conversation after a rewind followed by `/clear`
- Fixed a remote session losing a turn's tool calls and results when its runner or worker was lost after a dropped model stream had been retried
- Fixed cloud and Remote Control sessions that just started, or have an @ in their title, being unreachable in cross-session messaging from a session with Remote Control on
- Fixed Claude being told that cloud sessions can never reply; it now learns when a reply can come and how else to get the result
- Fixed `/diff`, the Changes pane of Remote Control sessions and the diff beside an edit leaving out committed work after a command moved into another repository
- Fixed Remote Control not showing a running workflow's agents when a session run by an IDE extension or other SDK app is opened over an hour after the workflow last made progress
- Remote Control: Fixed an idle Desktop or VS Code session showing as running after Remote Control is turned on
- Fixed the model saying background agents were still running after an SDK interrupt had stopped them
- Fixed Send now in the desktop app and SDK hosts telling Claude that a stopped web search found no results
- Fixed Cmd+letter being typed into the prompt in terminals that report Cmd
- Fixed Ctrl+click opening a link twice in GNOME Terminal, side mouse buttons acting as clicks, and the first wheel notch in the other direction being ignored after a pause, in fullscreen mode
- Fixed Shift+Enter in Konsole outside tmux and ssh, and Alt shortcuts on non-Latin keyboard layouts in terminals that speak the kitty keyboard protocol
- Linux: Fixed pasting in other apps freezing while Claude Code is suspended with Ctrl+Z, when `xclip` or `wl-copy` is installed
- Linux: Fixed Ctrl+V missing the clipboard image, pasting an old one or hanging
- Fixed text copied in fullscreen mode including the quote bar, losing spaces at line wraps when a drag scrolled upward, or missing words under the "Jump to bottom" pill
- Fixed an image path pasted into a `!` command becoming an attachment
- Fixed Ctrl+C showing no exit warning while the `?` shortcuts list is open
- Fixed Ctrl+R search in fullscreen mode and the `/theme` color editor picking the wrong row when keys arrive together, and keys being dropped there and in the search of `/config` and `/plugin`
- Fixed wrong or missing colors inside GNU screen
- Fixed many background notifications cutting into the top border of open dialogs in fullscreen mode
- Fixed a message to a background agent showing a long file path in place of a pasted image
- Fixed `/goal` removing a skill's Stop hook, or ending early on another hook's result, when both had the same wording
- Fixed `/bug` saying cancelled after the report was sent
- Fixed Esc not dismissing the transcript share question for Pro and Max users
- Fixed `/hooks` losing your place when going back
- Fixed `/export` writing a file named `.txt` when the name was left empty
- Fixed `/terminal-setup` in Zed replacing a symlinked `keymap.json` with a plain file
- Fixed `/install-github-app` adding a code review workflow when asked to update the existing workflow file
- Fixed `/plugin` reopening a skill, or closing the open page, when a slow save or removal finished after you went back
- Fixed `/plugin` asking to uninstall the wrong plugin, or ignoring Esc, after leaving a plugin while a change was still running
- Fixed typing and arrow keys not working on the `/plugin` Installed tab after a search with no results or a click on the tab row
- Fixed holding Enter in `/plugin` turning off several installed plugins
- Fixed the `/usage` plugin total stopping at 2,000 tokens on 1M context models, and low token estimates in `/usage` and `/plugin` when no model is picked
- Fixed Esc on the Bedrock access keys step closing `/login` instead of going back
- Fixed `/exit` and Ctrl+D describing running work differently, and `/exit` warning about a workflow that had stopped
- Fixed Claude calling an artifact private after reading one in a shared folder or publishing to another organization's, and saying only named people can open one when its folder's people can too
- Fixed a plugin's toast sometimes showing another plugin's text
- Fixed a mod saved just after a turn began sometimes reloading mid-turn instead of at the turn's end
- Fixed one malformed `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` entry dropping the variable's other labels from metric points, events, and spans. Now only that entry is left off
- Fixed agent hooks running past their timeout while compacting after a request was refused as too large
- Fixed a crash at startup when `FORCE_COLOR` is set to a negative number
- Fixed a crash in secret masking when the machine is almost out of memory
- Fixed the Bash sandbox on Linux renaming `.git/HEAD` after each command when the branch name is not valid UTF-8
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed all running sessions being stopped when a proxy or web filter answered a poll with HTTP 200 and a body such as `{}`; the runner now retries such a poll
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed deletion of a kept clone's objects or refs, and of commits that existed only there, after a temporary disk error; that start now fails instead
- Fixed self-hosted runners stopping when their token ran out on a host whose clock is slow or was set back
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions with Anthropic-managed git losing git access to GitHub after a script or hook in the session ran `claude` again
- Fixed self-hosted runners with Anthropic-managed git being unable to fetch or push where the machine's git config sets `http.proactiveAuth`
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed a runner that exited without telling the server when setup failed after it had registered; it now

## What's Changed
* fix(core,cli): preserve literal `$` characters during template placeholder replacement by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30136
* feat(cli): add /stats heatmap subcommand for daily token usage by @jvargassanchez-dot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30135
* fix(core): prevent __GCLI_EXPAND_TARGET__ env collision in expandEnvVars by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30138
* chore(release): bump version to 0.69.0-nightly.20261104.g89e9d25d6 by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30140
* fix(cli): serialize AnsiOutput to text content in ACP tool call updates by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30141
* Changelog for v0.67.0 by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30145
* Changelog for v0.68.0-preview.0 by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30146
* fix(core): fix Windows PowerShell substitution false positives and policy handling by @duvanka-prasad in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30110
* fix(cli): preserve leading and trailing whitespace in @file references by @duvanka-prasad in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30150
* fix(core): prevent thoughtSignature-only turns and preserve multimodal tool responses  by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30153
* fix(cli): wait for piped stdin EOF and avoid destroying process.stdin by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30163
* fix(cli): preserve pending tool confirmation when escaping editor selection by @jvargassanchez-dot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30147
* feat(cli): support standalone theme.json configuration for custom themes by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30119
* fix(cli): normalize error payloads in headless CLI formatting by @jvargassanchez-dot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30117
* fix(core): require path-separator boundary in tildeifyPath by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30124
* fix(cli): validate model names and support direct arguments in /model command by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30137
* fix(cli): handle file watcher errors and permit FSEvents in macOS permissive sandbox by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30143
* fix(core): bound multi-part tool outputs and evict older multimodal inlineData by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30180
* fix(vscode): eliminate barrel import bundle bloat and redundant setContext calls by @ugorla-dev in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30181
* fix(acp): handle mid-stream retries to prevent text concatenation by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30165
* fix(core,cli): prevent silent multi-minute loading hangs on network failures by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30182
* fix(core,cli): prevent terminal model-turn 400s on resume and main-thread JSONL freezes by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30186
* fix(core): prevent multi-hour quota retries and notify ACP client on retry attempts by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30187
* fix(core): close orphan /dev/ptmx master FD leaked on macOS PTY spawn by @ugorla-dev in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30184
* fix(core,cli): allow overriding 60s API headers timeout across all auth modes (`model.requestTimeoutMs` / `GEMINI_API_HEADERS_TIMEOUT_MS`) by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30183
* fix(cli): use isSubpath for theme file home-directory check by @duvanka-prasad in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30160
* fix(cli): resolve folder trust before entering the macOS Seatbelt sandbox by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30164
* fix(cli,core): kill child processes, record cancelled tools, and preserve signal exit code on headless abort by @duvanka-prasad in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30204
* fix(cli): prevent recursive interactive gemini sessions in shell mode by @jvargassanchez-dot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30185
* fix(core): reject MessageBus.request() immediately when publish fails by @luisfelipe-alt in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30189
* fix(core): ensure read-many-files only inlines explicitly requested binary assets (#29045) by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30211
* fix(core): recognize TortoiseGitPlink as PuTTY-family SSH client (#29917) by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30214
* fix(core): prevent PDF inlineData and telemetry buffer memory retention by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30217


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/compare/v0.68.0...v0.69.0

items.sourceText:
[Previous release: 1.4.263](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.263) — Lighter chat startup, Hermes in Chat and browser extension side panels.

## Chat commands find their workspace ✨

This desktop patch corrects workspace selection when a Chat UI agent runs Orca commands from a folder outside its workspace.

- 💬 **Keep browser work with the chat:** When Orca can locate the chat, commands such as opening a browser tab use that chat's workspace, including folder workspaces, rather than the workspace currently in focus.

## Usage notes

If a chat's workspace cannot be resolved, browser commands without a target are refused. Run the command from the intended workspace folder or pass `--worktree`; commands acting on an existing page also accept `--page` using an ID from `orca tab list --json`.

---

## What's Changed

### 🧰 CLI & automation

*Resolve the chat's workspace for commands run outside it, and require an explicit browser target when resolution fails.*

* Target the chat's own workspace when its agent runs outside it by @helldweller in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44336
* Refuse unscoped browser commands from chat agents outside a workspace by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44237

## New Contributors

* @helldweller made their first contribution in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44336

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.263...v1.4.264

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.327：公式リリース
items.summary: 主な話題：安全性・権限管理、不具合修正、MCP・外部連携。キーワードに基づく日本語の暫定分類です。具体的な変更内容と提供条件は公式原文で確認してください。
items.why: MacとWindowsのAIエージェントに作業を委任する際の安全性に関わるため、優先して確認する価値があります。
items.try: 検証用リポジトリで現在の設定をバックアップし、権限・サンドボックス動作を更新前後で比較してください。
items.availability: プラン・地域・アプリ/CLIの対応条件は公式ページで確認が必要です。
items.sourceText:
## What's changed

- Added a confirmation before `/install-github-app` changes a repository
- Added `claude mcp add-json <name> -` to read the server's JSON from stdin, so tokens can stay off the command line; not available inside a Claude Code session
- Added a line when a resumed session's earlier messages can't be loaded
- Added a list in `/status` of broken agent, skill, command and output style files, keybinding errors, an unavailable sandbox, ignored permission settings and hook matchers that never match
- Added a note in `/config` when other settings override a row
- Added `x-claude-code-managed-settings-checksum` to the gateway hint headers; sent where managed settings set `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1`, including where they already do
- Added support for naming a session's billing group with the `attributionProject` setting, for Claude apps gateways that set `admin.billing_group_tag`
- Added `/tui classic` as the name for the non-fullscreen renderer; `/tui default` still works
- Remote Control: Fixed stopping the server in worktree mode deleting a running session's git-ignored files, such as `.env`
- Fixed self-hosted runners with `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` deleting a non-empty directory named by `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL` at startup: the runner now keeps it, ignores the variable and warns
- Fixed `claude mcp add` and `claude mcp remove` with project scope deleting other top-level keys from `.mcp.json`, such as `$schema` or another tool's `servers`
- Fixed `/export` overwriting an existing file without asking: the dialog now asks, and `/export <name>` keeps the file and says to run `/export`
- Fixed a command you had allowed still running after you pressed Stop, when the approval arrived after a restart, in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions with no feature flags loaded
- Fixed Enter closing `/teleport`'s load error screen
- Fixed a click followed by Enter in `/plugin` installing or disabling a plugin
- Fixed a half-typed `!` command running on an extra Enter after the usage limit menu
- Fixed some `--disallowedTools` rules with parentheses in their content
- Fixed auto mode ignoring some wildcard PowerShell allow rules that name a script with `.\`, such as `PowerShell(.\scripts\build.ps1 *)`
- Fixed a running Code Mode script in auto mode getting permission prompts and denials once Claude started a second script that auto mode also allowed
- Changed some pre-started background sessions to be discarded after an account change
- Changed a workflow paused at a usage limit in the terminal to stay paused after a login, until the earlier login returns or you type a prompt
- Fixed a nested `claude` with its own token being refused by `forceLoginOrgUUID`: commands that don't get the session's token no longer get its `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES`; set it on any that need it
- Fixed headless sessions losing stored messages on resume when a message was sent again with the same UUID after the process was killed
- Fixed cases where a session resumed after an empty reply or a killed command lost an answer, or brought back a rewound prompt, after another crash or a move to the background
- Fixed a remote session forgetting messages sent after Stop was pressed during a restart, if Claude Code then crashed
- Fixed tasks created after `/clear` being lost, and cleared tasks coming back, when a cloud or self-hosted runner session with no feature flags loaded resumed later
- Fixed a compaction right after a reply cut at the output token limit losing that reply's tool call and its result
- Fixed a settings change from `/config` and similar commands failing to save with no warning; a line under the prompt now says so
- Fixed `/rewind` closing without a word when some files could not be restored
- Fixed pasted images being dropped when the prompt starts with a file path such as `/tmp/a.txt`
- Fixed agents passed with `--agents` being lost once plugins loaded or reloaded
- Fixed a plugin's agent being dropped when resuming a session from the `--resume` picker
- Fixed Claude Code refusing to start when `https_proxy` or `HTTPS_PROXY` is a bare `host:port` and neither its input nor its output is a terminal (the desktop app, an SDK, cron)
- Fixed Claude Code on Linux sometimes returning to the shell while restarting itself at startup, such as after the first sign-in to a Claude apps gateway or when turning on Code Mode
- Fixed `claude -p` hanging before its first request when the fetch of a model's settings stalled, such as at a proxy; it now goes on without them after 10 seconds
- Fixed the screen staying blank or frozen after a brief out-of-memory error
- Fixed a rare display fault that could freeze the screen or end the session
- Fixed cloud sessions breaking when a program left thousands of connections open to the session's network proxy
- Fixed a turn hanging when a mod's `$.model.complete` or `$.model.classify` call met a usage limit: the call now gets the API's error at once; mods should handle that error
- Fixed stalls on a compaction reply with thousands of unclosed tags and on some very long WebFetch URLs; WebFetch now refuses a URL over 2,000 characters before any permission prompt
- Fixed a message with thousands of `@` mentions stalling before Claude replies; only the first 100 mentions are now looked up as files
- Fixed the prompt freezing after rejecting a write to a very large file; a rejected write now shows a short preview
- Fixed a crash when a burst of keys reached the search box in `/plugin`
- Fixed a false crash report and exit code when a suspended session resumes, or at exit, where a Linux security policy blocks a process from signalling itself
- Fixed remote MCP servers staying disconnected after a longer outage such as a VPN drop: most servers on other machines reached by hostname over https are now retried in the background for about a day
- Fixed Edit refusing with "File has not been read yet" after a compaction on unchanged files outside the project that Claude had already read in full
- Fixed Grep repeating or skipping results when paging with `head_limit` and `offset`; content and count results are now sorted by file path
- Fixed Read failing on Jupyter notebooks that contain an output of an unknown type
- Fixed NotebookEdit removing the notebook file's final newline
- Fixed the Read tool reporting 512KB instead of the real size when a file of 10 MB or more is too large to read at once
- Fixed the Bash tool's diff of changed files not naming files that are binary, too large or too many to show
- Fixed artifact publishes failing with "the source file changed between approval and publish" when a synced or remote-backed folder had only changed the file's timestamp
- Fixed a new artifact that you approved being refused in a cloud scheduled task's session, in organizations that require approval of each new artifact
- Fixed a new artifact being refused after an app built on the Agent SDK approved it, in organizations that require approval of each new artifact
- Fixed `/artifacts` showing part of your list, or "No artifacts yet", when a request for more of the list failed: it now tries again, then warns if it can't load the whole list
- Fixed in-process agent teammates on a different model from the lead compacting at the lead's context limit and on the wrong model; they now use their own limit and model, at that model's rate
- Fixed a finished subagent resuming on the model and effort of a sibling subagent that messaged it
- Fixed the main conversation not being told a background agent had finished when the subagent that started it ended by itself without reading the result, outside auto mode
- Fixed Claude reporting a background agent as still running when it had waited 30 seconds or more on a permission prompt in the desktop app, on the web and in the SDK
- Fixed Claude not being told in auto mode when a background agent's reply to a follow-up message was dropped, and reduced repeat wake-ups there from agents waiting on background commands
- Fixed the desktop app, Claude Code on the web and VS Code showing a raw task notification as a subagent's prompt after its background task woke it
- Fixed messages sent from another session with "later" priority joining the running turn, instead of waiting for it to end, in Remote Control and Claude Desktop sessions
- Fixed messages to cloud and Remote Control sessions being reported as failed with a stale address after a timeout or rate limit; Claude now says when a message may have arrived
- Fixed cloud sessions giving no error when a `UserPromptSubmit` hook blocks a message sent while Claude works
- Fixed failing hooks showing nothing: SubagentStop in background agents, SessionEnd at `/clear` and `/resume`, and CwdChanged and FileChanged in fullscreen
- Fixed a Stop hook that failed to run being shown as having reported a problem
- Fixed focus view keeping a finished reply hidden while a Stop hook was running
- Fixed Claude getting a long managed PostToolUse hook output twice when a mod added context to the tool call
- Fixed `/model` listing the wrong models in some terminal sessions when a project's `.claude/settings.json` sets `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` to an LLM gateway
- Fixed `/statusline` writing to `~/.claude/settings.json` when `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` points to another folder
- Fixed `claudeMdExcludes` patterns on Windows not matching a path whose drive letter is written in the other case
- Fixed `claude agents` and `claude rm` refusing to remove a fully pushed session ("The worktree has unpushed commits") when its worktree has a file or folder named `HEAD` at the top level
- Fixed long ListAgents results hiding most sessions on accounts with many cloud or Remote Control sessions: long lists now come in pages
- Fixed slow turns in resumed sessions for organizations with tens of thousands of connector tool permissions
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed `claude -p` started by a session's script or hook waiting out rate limits, because it inherited the session's own retry setting
- Fixed the spend limit menu reporting a changed limit when the server refused it
- Fixed a second `x` on a task's details in `/tasks` stopping the next task too
- Fixed Esc being ignored on a permission prompt that had just appeared
- Fixed lists that load their rows late sometimes ignoring Enter and the arrow keys
- Fixed `/autofix-pr` holding the keyboard after Esc while it stopped the cloud session; the dialog now closes at once, and a stop that fails is reported afterwards with a link
- Fixed a blank screen and stray mouse codes in the shell after quitting with ctrl+c just after ← opens the agents view
- Fixed Ctrl+C right after the trust question leaving the terminal in fullscreen
- Fixed the shell flashing on screen when ← opens the agents view in fullscreen mode
- Fixed terminal display faults: most scrambled scrollback in Ghostty on resize, link addresses hidden in Windows Terminal under old tmux and in VTE 0.50.0, and no selection highlight with 16 colors
- Fixed some garbled rows in tmux with `allow-passthrough` on inside kitty, Ghostty or iTerm2
- Fixed `/mcp` saying no servers were configured after one was added during a session or declined; it now says what to do
- Fixed `/hooks` leaving out hooks given by `--settings`
- Fixed the `/` menu listing a row for each skill of the same name, though every row ran the first
- Fixed `/teleport` showing no message when the chosen session failed to resume
- Fixed n and N in transcript search skipping matches
- Fixed cancelling a transcript search (ctrl+o, then /) in a long session landing far from where the search started
- Fixed up and down losing the cursor's column over a short or blank line
- Fixed Tab in shell mode filling in a file name after `&&`, `;` or `|`, where a command goes
- Fixed the selected session leaving the screen in `claude --resume` and `/resume` when branch names or folder paths are long
- Fixed the MCP tool list in `/mcp` and `/plugin` losing your place when going back from a tool
-

items.sourceText:
[Previous release: 1.4.261](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.261): Major performance improvements, Cursor Chat and a customizable + menu.

## Faster chat switching, lower memory use & git blame ✨

Keep more conversations open with less memory on macOS and Linux, and move between chats with less work happening in hidden views. This update also helps terminal sessions pick up where you left off and puts line history directly in the editor.

- ⚡ **Work across many chats:** Chat UI uses lighter helpers on macOS and Linux. Hidden chat views pause their updates while retaining your draft, reading position and editor state for your return; agents keep working.
- 🧹 **Reclaim disk space:** Settings → Workspace Cleanup can delete Orca, Claude Code and Codex chats from deleted workspaces. It is off by default; enabling it asks for confirmation and includes previously deleted workspaces. Deleted chats cannot be recovered.
- ⌨️ **Return to the same terminal folder:** Panes remember where you last changed directory across restarts, including in folder workspaces. Windows also fixes stray characters after returning to a busy pane.
- 🔍 **See who changed a line:** The Git blame status item shows the cursor line’s author and date. In repo workspaces, click it to open the commit; enable **Inline git blame** in Settings → Editor for annotations beside your code.
- 👤 **Make account switching clearer:** Name saved Claude and Codex accounts and see their last observed plans. When you accept Restart or use Always restart, busy Claude terminal sessions resume on the selected account without waiting for their current work to finish.

## Highlights

- **Set up an agent in one card:** Choose the agent, model and supported effort or Fast options together, then use **Open as chat** or **Open as terminal**. Where offered, **Default** effort lets the agent choose its own level.
- **Control interruptions:** Right-click a workspace to mute its notifications while keeping its unread dot. Sleeping workspaces stay asleep after relaunch, and the workspace-card preview lets you try different styles.
- **Use your language and plugins:** Discover community translations in Settings or onboarding. Plugin update reviews name the added access and can group approvals; eligible updates can be approved from their notification.
- **Save remote files for later:** Choose **Download…** on a remote file link to save it without opening another app. Windows also recognizes project folders on drive letters mapped to WSL distros.
- **Resolve a blocked Codex action:** Chat explains an automatic-review denial and offers **Approve once** for that action.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Codex history sharing:** With sharing enabled, accounts move to one conversation store before their next launch; this may delay the first launch, and busy accounts migrate later. Turning sharing off leaves shared history in place; long conversations started while sharing was on need it enabled to resume. After a Windows downgrade, additional accounts fall back to your default Codex sign-in until you update again.
- **Windows terminals:** Close and reopen existing terminals to pick up the stray-character fix.
- **Repo setup steps:** Earlier `orca.yaml` approvals now count as trust for future versions of that repo’s setup commands. VM creation and repos sharing an ID across hosts keep per-version approval.

---


## What's Changed

### 📱 Phone & mobile

*Phone chat and terminal settings, steadier downloads and keyboard, and Android installs that stay on the right store.*

* fix(mobile): remove regex lookbehind literals from the paired web bundle by @DomKing in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42582
* fix(mobile): label code fences without a language as "Code" by @radut in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42646
* fix(mobile): keep chat code blocks wrapped after tapping Wrap lines by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42908
* Rebuild phone snapshots only for workspaces whose inputs changed by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42934
* Approve a repo's orca.yaml hooks once on mobile by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42935
* feat(mobile): add chat text size, font and line spacing settings by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42952
* fix(mobile): make chat report buttons work in an isolated frame by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42954
* fix(mobile): keep the Copy menu for selected chat text on the phone's web pages by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42965
* fix(mobile): keep the Hide sidebar button tappable under long host names by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42994
* fix(mobile): resume an interrupted desktop page download instead of starting over by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43026
* feat(mobile): choose the terminal font, size, line spacing and weight by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43037
* fix(mobile): refuse to publish an Android APK carrying Play's license check by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43054
* chore(mobile): bump to 0.0.66 and Android versionCode 30 by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43066
* feat(mobile): steer GitHub installs outside mainland China to Google Play by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43080
* docs: lead Android links with Google Play, keep the APK as the fallback by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43084
* chore(mobile): bump to 0.0.67 and Android versionCode 31 by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43086
* fix(mobile): keep the Start from field above the Android keyboard by @giorgio-zamparelli in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43128
* fix(mobile): keep the keyboard open when the session mic is pressed by @giorgio-zamparelli in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43147
* fix(mobile): canonicalize WSL runtime host IDs read from workspace routes by @tiantiantianblue in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43165
* fix(mobile): update GitHub installs from GitHub, not Google Play by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43218
* ci(mobile): refuse a GitHub APK with any Play automatic-protection class by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43219
* fix(native-chat): show a pasted image inside its Claude prompt on the phone by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43256
* fix(native-chat): attach pasted images in the web client over plain HTTP by @fxsobr in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43356

### 💬 Chat & session history

*Lighter chats, faster switching, Approve once for Codex reviews and many smaller chat fixes.*

* fix(chat): show deferred Claude permission picks by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42217
* fix(chat): keep the reply before a mid-turn message visible in finished turns by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42335
* Clarify Session History search messages by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42519
* Keep chat composer state when its view reconnects by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42695
* Pause hidden chats to speed up switching by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42710
* Reduce native chat memory by replacing per-chat Electron supervisors by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42760
* fix(native-chat): repair main after the Codex async question move by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42835
* feat(native-chat): show Grok's /goal in the goal banner, with Resume and Clear by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42840
* fix(native-chat): start the working clock when "Sending…" clears by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42880
* fix(antigravity): accept free-text answers on question cards by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42894
* Finish superseded Claude replies without interrupting subagents by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42930
* fix(native-chat): show the reply before a background task hand-back in terminal chats by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42932
* fix(native-chat): keep a consistent gap above an answer's action row by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42942
* fix(native-chat): Skip and agent messages agree with the Codex question card by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42946
* fix(antigravity): offer every model in the managed Antigravity chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42950
* fix(acp): keep saved chats retryable after temporary restore failures by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42981
* fix(opencode): open copied OpenCode chats in the terminal without OpenCode 2's --standalone by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43003
* fix(native-chat): an upgrade no longer reopens closed chats or copies unchanged ones by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43007
* fix(native-chat): resend a subscriber's snapshot when its capture was abandoned by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43020
* fix(agent-session): end a subscriber's stream when a queued delivery fails by @haydenflinner in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43043
* fix(native-chat): send other agents' mail as a pointer and let the person approve a denied action by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43093
* fix(native-chat): point a refused WSL-folder chat at WSL hosts with a one-click path by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43109
* fix(native-chat): refresh the /mcp tray when the chat starts or /mcp is run again by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43188
* fix(native-chat): switch to Terminal when a chat command opens a TUI dialog by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43192
* fix(opencode): resume pre-account OpenCode sessions in their own store by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43243
* Let Send-now steer a queued message while an earlier steer is unechoed by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43293
* fix(agent-session): continue moved or copied Claude chats in Chat UI by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43325
* fix(native-chat): hide overlays of hidden chats and show the agy model by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43328
* fix(pi): install Orca's managed Pi extensions on native chat launch so subagent rows appear by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43332
* fix(native-chat): deliver other agents' messages to chat agents directly again by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43380
* fix(agent-status): show the approval card when Claude asks for permission in Chat UI by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43382
* perf(native-chat): an upgrade with an unchanged old chat journal only fills in missing baselines by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43563

### 🤝 Workers & coordination

*Find and read any agent from the command line, and steadier worker runs that keep their history small.*

* List and read any agent by its Orca session ID: orca agent list/show/read by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41815
* fix(orchestration): page chat worker reads before bounding and keep their fleet projection by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42707

items.sourceText:
## New Features
- Added WebRTC negotiation for realtime voice calls in the TUI. (#61172)
- Added automatically refreshed authentication headers for OpenTelemetry HTTP exporters. (#61028)
- Added experimental support for using identically named MCP servers across environments. (#60905)

## Bug Fixes
- Oversized WebSocket requests now fall back to HTTP without unnecessary retries. (#60840, #60841)
- Fixed MCP OAuth credential races during cancellation, login, and logout. (#60849, #60981)
- Improved automatic reconnection for Cloud conversations and preserved active recovery turns when clients reconnect. (#60969, #61014)
- Fixed Windows file replacement, sandbox permission preservation, and runtime registration recovery. (#60872, #60943, #60944)
- Fixed permission updates and child threads losing existing sandbox restrictions. (#60936, #61134)
- Removed duplicate file search results and fixed thread search snippets for queries containing whitespace. (#60845, #60846)

## Documentation
- Updated sandbox documentation to explain permission profiles and filesystem rules. (#61133)

## Changelog

## Security fixes

v2.5.0 fixes eight vulnerabilities in three servers. Upgrade `mcp-server-git` to 2026.11.18,
`@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` to 2.4.0 and `@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything` to 2.3.1.

| Package | Affected | Fixed in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mcp-server-git` | through 2026.11.11 | 2026.11.18 |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` | all versions before 2.4.0, and date versions 2025.1.14 through 2026.8.31 | 2.4.0 |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything` | through 2.3.0 | 2.3.1 |

### `mcp-server-git` 2026.11.18

* **A merge no longer starts Git's automatic maintenance.** A successful `git_merge`, a fast-forward included, ended in `git maintenance run --auto`, whose garbage collection runs the commands a repository's own `gc.recentObjectsHook` names, with the server's privileges. `maintenance.auto` is now `false` and `gc.auto` is `0` for every Git command the server runs ([GHSA-h2g3-rwxm-xfm3](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-h2g3-rwxm-xfm3))
* **Git never fetches a missing object by itself.** A repository's configuration could declare a promisor remote and name the program Git runs to fetch from it (`remote.<name>.uploadpack`, `core.sshCommand`), which a read-only tool then started when it needed an object that was not on disk. Lazy fetching is turned off (`GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1`), and a Git too old to honor that refuses a repository that declares a promisor remote ([GHSA-87qg-cmw8-jc5m](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-87qg-cmw8-jc5m))
* **Drivers are read again after a tool writes the working tree.** A repository's configuration can include a file that a merge or checkout creates, so a filter or merge driver could appear after the server had emptied the ones it found, and run during the `git merge --abort` that follows a conflict. `git_checkout`, `git_merge` and that abort now read the drivers again before any other Git command runs. **The `--repository` confinement check is not yet repeated after such a write** (#5599) ([GHSA-9vjp-x34c-xg6v](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-9vjp-x34c-xg6v))
* **A filter or merge driver with an empty name is emptied too.** Git accepts `[filter ""]`, selected by `filter=` in `.gitattributes`, and the server's list of a repository's drivers missed it, so its command ran ([GHSA-pm7p-vphh-2cg7](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-pm7p-vphh-2cg7))
* **Index entries that point outside the working tree are refused.** With `--repository`, a crafted `.git/index` naming a path such as `../outside/secret` made `git_diff_unstaged` and `git_diff` return that file's content, and `git_status` report whether it exists. The index is now checked from its top before any tool reads it, and the untracked cache, which can name a directory outside the working tree, is turned off ([GHSA-r2q8-f657-4r56](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-r2q8-f657-4r56))
* **A submodule's own configuration no longer runs programs.** With `diff.submodule=diff` in the repository's configuration, `git_diff` ran a nested diff inside each changed submodule under the submodule's own `diff.external` and textconv drivers, and `git_checkout` and `git_add` ran Git inside a submodule under its own configuration too. `diff.submodule` is now `short`, the drivers a checked-out submodule defines are overridden, and a Git older than 2.33, which would not pass the overrides into a submodule, is refused for a repository that has one checked out ([GHSA-8wv7-r664-7594](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-8wv7-r664-7594))

### `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` 2.4.0

* **Directory listings stay with the directory that was checked** (Linux and macOS). `list_directory`, `list_directory_with_sizes`, `directory_tree` and `search_files` now list a directory in place after checking it, so a directory swapped for a symlink between the check and the listing can no longer return the names of entries outside the allowed directories. **On Windows a listing is not yet anchored** (#5600) ([GHSA-rq2p-q7c4-6g27](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-rq2p-q7c4-6g27))

### `@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything` 2.3.1

* **`gzip-file-as-resource` treats a NAT64 address as the IPv4 address it carries.** The tool's private-address guard read addresses in `64:ff9b::/96` as public, so on a network with a NAT64 gateway a URL could reach a private IPv4 address through one. The embedded IPv4 address is now checked ([GHSA-38j4-j742-j7r3](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-38j4-j742-j7r3))

### Upgrading from a date-versioned npm release

The TypeScript servers moved from date versions (2025.x, 2026.x) to semantic versions in 1.0.0. Package managers rank 2.4.0 below every 2025.x and 2026.x version, so they won't offer it as an upgrade. If you are on a date version of `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem`, install 2.4.0 explicitly: `npm install @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@2.4.0`.

| `mcp-server-time` | `2026.11.18` | PyPI | **published** |

[Previous release: 1.4.262](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.262) — Faster chat switching, lower memory use and git blame.

## Lighter chat startup, Hermes in Chat & browser extension side panels ✨

Reopen workspaces full of chats with less memory use and less startup work. Restored chat interfaces load when first shown, and Orca no longer rewrites every saved conversation at launch. Opened chats keep their drafts and scroll position when you return.

- 💬 **Continue Hermes conversations in Chat:** Start Hermes from the New Tab menu, or choose **Resume in New Chat** on a Session History entry to continue a terminal conversation in its original workspace and profile.
- 🌐 **Keep extensions beside your page:** Chrome extensions that use side panels can now open in a resizable panel in Orca's browser. Click the extension's toolbar button to use its panel while browsing; extension popups also accept Paste, Copy and Select All.
- 🖥️ **Reach your remote work:** Managed SSH ports now have a **Forward** button. On Windows, projects opened through a mapped WSL drive letter can move onto their distro's WSL host.
- ⌨️ **Keep terminal output in view after a restart:** On macOS and Linux, a terminal whose shell stopped can restore its saved output with the new prompt below it. Windows keeps its existing restore behavior.

## Highlights

- **Connect Linear from the command line:** `orca linear connect` accepts an API key through stdin and connects the host you target, including a headless server. Each host keeps its own connection. Linear issue and project lists now return all results when you omit `--limit`.
- **Set up agents on Windows:** Claude and Codex chats offer **Install** when the agent is missing, then **Check again** to detect the installation. `orca agent installed` also lists enabled agent CLIs on the current host for scripts and launch setup.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Hermes:** Chat requires Hermes 0.23.0 or later on the machine running the workspace. Very long imports show recent messages while Hermes retains the full conversation. Chat is unavailable for SSH workspaces; a paired Orca server supports it. The first chat after Hermes' gateway stops can take a minute to start.
- **Browser identity:** **Native** is now the default, addressing the Cloudflare verification loop seen with the previous default. Explicit identity choices are preserved; change yours in Settings → Browser → Browser identity.
- **Phone updates:** The phone UI changes listed below require a corresponding mobile build. This desktop update does not update Android or iOS apps.

## Known issues

- **Sleep workspace instead:** The option can fail when another tab in that workspace is running a process.
- **`orca agent installed --worktree`:** The command errors on SSH and paired-server workspaces.

---

## What's Changed

### 📱 Phone & mobile

*Phone source changes for agent launch choices, text size, quoted replies, pairing and connections. These require a corresponding mobile build.*

* Preserve unchanged sections in large diffs by @kia378 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42893
* Refuse a desktop access link when pairing a phone by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43289
* Keep a slow link open through iOS network-change checks by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43314
* Quote a selected passage of an agent reply into the chat box by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43324
* Change chat and terminal text size from the session menu by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43334
* Choose Chat or CLI when starting an agent from the phone by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43340
* Say the host can't stream browser tabs instead of asking for a desktop update by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43361
* Size the terminal once when it starts with a bundled font by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43410
* Say "host" instead of "desktop" in phone copy and tell same-email Codex logins apart by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43804

### 💬 Chat & session history

*Hermes in Chat, suggested next prompts, steadier steering and restarts, and fewer stuck or lost conversations.*

* Keep Claude follow-ups in the current reply when their echo ID changes by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37925
* Run Hermes Agent in Chat over its ACP server by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42895
* Show Claude's suggested next prompt in the empty composer by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42907
* Keep Chat sends from merging with or stranding text in the agent's input line by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43141
* Setting to turn off spellcheck and autocorrect in the chat composer by @jagritvats in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43198
* Reopen Codex chats archived in Codex and never silently replace a used conversation by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43283
* Apply permission mode changes to the running chat by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43290
* Give Chat UI Claude in Chrome browser tools when "Enabled by default" is on by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43308
* Say a conversation was saved in another folder instead of offering a Retry that can't work by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43331
* Show Hermes sessions from state.db in Session History by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43343
* Show the usage-limit notice as one compact row by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43345
* Open a Hermes Session History row as a new chat by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43370
* Cmd/Ctrl+Enter steer shows as sent, not as a queued card first by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43392
* List agent models before the first chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43411
* Retain skill scopes in the slash picker by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43436
* Pass the chat's model to thread/fork so /btw side chats keep the selected model by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43438
* Ask for the summary context report so a resumed chat makes no token-count API calls by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43441
* Leave chats waiting on you in the restart list instead of auto-resuming them by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43474
* Reload a GitHub link preview when its account binding comes back by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43483
* A non-string host id no longer crashes the terminal workbench by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43499
* Send a queued Steer once the agent can take it instead of refusing by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43513
* Name agents that stay in the terminal when Chat UI becomes the default from the launch tip by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43544
* Recover journal writes after confirmed SQLite rollback by @PeterGuy326 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43560
* Continue moved or copied Grok chats in Chat UI by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43651
* Offer Claude and Codex Install on Windows hosts by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43857

### 🤝 Workers & coordination

*Guidance that points agents to Orca mail, faster delivery of worker reports to busy chats, and clearer worker cards on paired servers.*

* Send messages between agents through Orca mail, not terminal input by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43309
* Stop rebuilding sender history and resending orchestration rows on unchanged graph replies by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43458
* Show check --terminal syntax in terminal worker preamble by @helmipradita in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43502
* Steer other agents' mail into a running turn without waiting on earlier mail by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43694
* Name the receiving terminal in mail wake commands by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43726
* Show the agent on start cards for workers on a paired server by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43745

### 🤖 Agents, models & accounts

*Clearer model, usage and status handling across Antigravity, Kimi, Codex and Hermes, plus a command that lists installed agents.*

* Show remote Codex account usage in account rows by @gentslava in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41540
* Publish sessions across local-date boundaries by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42992
* Submit Windows Muse worker prompts held as pasted content by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43250
* Show Antigravity's empty-output retries as a retrying row by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43257
* List models in the agent picker from the account new chats use by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43363
* Reuse Codex launch preparation from every entry point by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43365
* Shorten usage pool labels and drop duplicate weekly row by @asunghong in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43457
* Add orca agent installed to list installed agent CLIs by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43505
* Don't flash the install screen when chats run the host's agy by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43507
* Drop child subagent lifecycle hooks so they don't complete the root pane by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43672
* Install OpenCode, Pi and Claude agent-view integrations only for agents in use by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43705
* Order effort levels lowest to highest in every selector by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43737
* Show a turn cancelled with Esc as interrupted by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43750
* Show the first prompt in a new Kimi pane as working by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43765
* Start the prompt cache countdown for remote terminals this window never opened by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43773
* Stop re-offering Install Orca's copy once it is installed by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43937
* Run chats on Antigravity ACP server 1.5.0 on every platform by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43938
* Let a healthy host agy serve chats despite a keyring-fallback marker by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43940
* Keep the selected agy account launchable after agy rewrites its login by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43941

### 🧹 Workspace cleanup & lifecycle

*Manual and Automatic cleanup sections with clear rule checks.*

* Manual and Automatic cleanup sections with clear rule checks by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42905
* Stop the terminal daemon and name the orca serve row by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43285

### 🗂️ Workspaces, windows & navigation

*Open Settings with ⌘, on macOS, steadier sidebar and project picking, and clearer delete and tab-bar messages.*

* Open Settings with ⌘, by default on macOS by @Lainaaa in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42778
* Preserve slash-separated workspace branch names by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43171
* Open project pickers beside the newest local project by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43244
* Keep a hidden project's worktrees under a shown folder workspace by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stabl

items.sourceText: # ChatGPT for iOS ### New features - Side chats are now saved on compatible paired computers, so you can reopen them later from the original task. - The new project picker lets you choose Cloud or select a paired computer and project when starting a task. - Toggle word wrap for individual code blocks and diffs in a task. - Start a new Codex task with Command + N on iPad. ### Improvements and bug fixes - The subagent indicator counts only agents that are still working or waiting. Open **Subagents** from the task menu to revisit finished agents and see which model and reasoning level each used. - Task search dismisses the keyboard when you open a result. Collapsed task list sections stay collapsed on iPhone. - Fixed the composer becoming unresponsive after opening a task from a completion notification. - Fixed transcripts jumping when reopening a task or returning to the app, and crashes when scrolling past or expanding inline videos. - Follow-ups no longer get stuck in the queue because an earlier turn still appears active. - Unsaved annotation text survives when you return to the app. Creating a worktree now preserves untracked files with names that include accented letters or quotation marks.

items.try: 更新版のCLIを検証環境で試し、既存のスキル・設定・MCP接続に影響がないか確認してください。

items.sourceText:
## What's changed

- Added support for turning on Code Mode while agent teams are enabled; if you already turned it on, sessions with teams on now start in Code Mode
- Added a startup warning when an `--allowedTools`, `--disallowedTools` or `--tools` value has an entry that doesn't look like a complete rule
- Added a message explaining why MCP servers stop loading when an administrator adds `managed-mcp.json` during a session
- Added a row to `/status` that says when your provider or an environment variable such as `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` turns features off
- Added a note in `/plugin` and `claude plugin list` when a malformed `plugin.json` field such as `author` or `homepage` is ignored
- Added Ctrl+O to show hidden startup notices
- Added a hint in the empty prompt that says what to do after a request fails
- Added an `esc to stop` footer hint in a subagent's view where Esc would stop it
- Added `OTEL_RESOURCE_INCLUDE_HOST` to include `host.name` and `host.id` in OpenTelemetry resource attributes (off by default)
- Added `overflowX="scroll"` on a mod's `Box`, and `maxLines` and `wrap="clip"` on its `Text`
- Fixed `cp` of a file being refused when only its source was covered by an `Edit` deny rule
- Fixed Bash commands that delete or overwrite files (`find -delete`, `cat a > b`, `sort -o`) being summed up in the transcript as a search or a read
- Fixed a misleading "Dangerous rm operation" warning in the Bash permission prompt on some commands with no rm that Claude Code can't read reliably
- Fixed background sessions losing the LLM gateway your shell exported after a crash, after a reopen from another folder, or when the background service lacks it: they now stop before any model request
- Fixed the background service ending your own processes, such as an SSH login, when a process number on its list had been reused by another user's process
- Fixed rules added in `/permissions` or at a main-conversation tool prompt, and `/add-dir` folders, looking saved when the settings file couldn't be written; the terminal now warns and names it
- Fixed a failed MCP `headersHelper`, or one not run in an untrusted folder, making other sessions start without that server, for most servers with no stored OAuth refresh token
- Fixed managed settings with certain key names stopping Claude Code from starting or affecting other managed files
- Fixed settings files with values nested thousands of levels deep crashing Claude Code or applying only some of the time; values past 64 levels are now dropped with a warning
- Fixed a settings file saved with an error mid-session being skipped silently; a warning now names the file
- Fixed the subagent model set in managed settings not applying in Claude Desktop's Code tab; it now overrides your own, as in a terminal, unless those settings also pick a provider or gateway
- Fixed sandboxed commands failing to start on Linux when the home or config directory is reached through a symlink into `/net` and sandbox settings deny reads of it
- Fixed empty placeholder files, including `.git/config.lock`, sometimes being left in the project on Linux when Claude Code was stopped during a sandboxed command
- Fixed Up then Enter answering Yes at the folder trust prompt shown under an already trusted parent folder
- Fixed an extra Enter at the end of setup accepting the offer to make auto mode the default
- Fixed a message typed over the startup auto mode offer being lost, and its Enter accepting the offer
- Fixed a note typed on a permission prompt being sent to Claude after Tab had hidden it
- Fixed PreToolUse hooks in managed settings leaving no OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` event or `permission_denials` entry when they refused a direct tool call
- Fixed letters typed over `/sandbox` or a delete question in `/permissions` moving the selection
- Fixed resumed sessions losing recent turns after a crash when the previous turn ended with an empty reply
- Fixed resumed sessions losing earlier conversation history when Claude Code ran low on memory
- Fixed a re-sent file overwriting Claude's changed copy in Remote Control and cloud sessions on Linux with no feature flags loaded: the copy moves to a `.kept-` folder, or the new file isn't saved
- Fixed a background session being killed and its request lost when you opened, stopped or removed the older session whose conversation it had resumed
- Fixed `claude purge` hiding its prompts when stdout is redirected, where one unseen Enter could delete a project's data; they now show on the terminal
- Fixed the spend limit menu removing the monthly limit without asking when Backspace and Enter were pressed as it opened
- Fixed `/rewind` restoring only some files after running `/branch` twice while a slow backup copy was still running
- Fixed `/rewind` saying "No code changes" when a shell command changed files it can't restore; a turn whose changes weren't tracked now reads "Code changes unknown"
- Fixed `/rewind`: Esc now cancels its summary, its list shows more than one past prompt in fullscreen, and a long prompt no longer hides its warning about losing later file changes
- Fixed Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D twice in `/skills` quitting Claude Code and dropping changes; it now saves and closes the panel
- Fixed the usage limit menu erasing your draft and opening while you were typing
- Fixed pasted text and images being dropped when ↑ recalls a draft cleared with Esc Esc
- Fixed an edited typed answer to Claude's question sending the old text when you moved on without pressing Enter
- Fixed going back to a question you answered from its list putting the cursor on the first option, where Enter replaced your answer
- Fixed `/feedback` and `/bug` sending the report when you typed a space on the confirmation screen, and losing the typed report after Ctrl+O or Ctrl+Z
- Fixed a prompt typed after `--add-dir`, `--allowedTools` or another list option being dropped without a message
- Fixed `/plan <description>` ignoring the description when plan mode was already on
- Fixed valid PDFs being dropped from the conversation after the API rejected a different PDF read in the same batch
- Fixed a session ending after a single failed memory allocation while drawing the screen
- Fixed compaction on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry, and with telemetry turned off, sometimes replying to one of your messages instead of summarizing, or leaving Claude's last reply out of the summary
- Fixed image-heavy sessions on Vertex AI getting stuck on a 400 error about the request size exceeding a 30 MB limit, instead of compacting and retrying
- Fixed an error when `max_tokens` exceeded the model's limit: Claude Code now retries the request with the maximum the Anthropic API reports
- Fixed `grep` in the Bash tool silently skipping some text files
- Fixed a crashed Node or Python hook showing only the first line of its stack trace; the error is now shown, and Ctrl+O shows up to 10,000 characters of the output
- Fixed `/goal clear` or a new `/goal` not sticking when typed while Stop hooks were running and background work was still in progress
- Fixed the automatic session recap being sent after a reply billed to usage credits; `/recap` still works
- Fixed auto mode staying on its local classifier, which counts toward usage, because of a stale saved value, such as one from an older Claude Code
- Fixed "Sign in with your Console account" in `/login` replacing your Claude subscription login when the browser sign-in used your Claude plan instead of a Console organization
- Fixed `/login` ending on "Login successful" while an approved `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` was still used; it now says requests still use the key
- Fixed "Not logged in" staying after turning on the API key in `/config`; "Not logged in", `/login` and `/status` now name an unused `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`
- Fixed `claude auth logout` leaving credentials behind, and token refresh failing, when only a Console profile's credentials are on a drive that rejects folder timestamps
- Fixed a past conversation resumed from agent view being sent on the background service's sign-in when the service doesn't have the terminal's API key or token
- Fixed model requests failing on a one-off authentication error (401) in Claude Desktop's Code tab: they are now sent once more first
- Fixed `forceLoginOrgUUID` and `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` startup errors telling you to sign in again when a network block page (HTTP 403) was the cause
- Fixed `claude auth login` not showing a pasted sign-in code, so a wrong paste couldn't be seen or corrected before Enter
- Fixed `/login` and `claude setup-token` showing nothing after you submit a pasted code; they now show "Finishing sign-in…"
- Fixed Esc doing nothing while the first-run sign-in waits for the browser or a pasted code; it now goes back one screen
- Fixed `/logout` in fullscreen mode exiting without leaving the logged-out message on screen
- Fixed the shell prompt being drawn over the last screen after quitting with Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D at a sign-in or first-run step
- Fixed Ctrl+C twice doing nothing on the first-run theme choice, and freezing the terminal on setup screens or a background session at its startup question
- Fixed your OFF answer to the updated terms being replaced when keys were typed while it was saving, at startup and in `/privacy-settings`
- Fixed the `/privacy-settings` toggle sometimes saving the opposite of what the screen showed on a quick double press, changing your setting on keys pressed after Esc, and not saying when a save failed
- Fixed `/privacy-settings` saving your choice on the wrong account after signing in to a different account in another terminal
- Fixed `/privacy-settings` saying "set to true" when you picked OFF right after ON
- Fixed skills and slash commands failing to load in Code Mode under auto mode when an inline `!` command needs approval; Claude is now asked to run it
- Fixed background subagents started in Code Mode failing when they preload a skill with an inline `!` command
- Fixed mods being unable to use Bash, Read and other tools through `$.tool.call` and `$.tool.check` in Code Mode
- Fixed parallel MCP tool calls reading another call's saved result when two long results arrived in the same millisecond (anthropics/claude-code#105138)
- Fixed tool search sometimes loading another MCP server's tool when asked for a tool by its exact name; you may be asked again for that tool
- Fixed MCP prompts disappearing when two servers have nearly identical names
- Fixed a tool call to an MCP server that an SDK host had just removed reconnecting to it, or reporting that it needs authentication
- Fixed Claude not being told that a remote MCP server's question was declined when the server then failed the tool call
- Fixed MCP tools with a root `anyOf` or `oneOf` showing Claude only the first branch's form of an argument; text such as `42` can now arrive as a number where another branch takes one
- Fixed Claude not being told when an approved MCP resource tool was unavailable after a cloud session's worker was replaced
- Fixed `/mcp` not showing why a local (stdio) MCP server failed to start
- Fixed Esc doing nothing while an MCP server reconnects: Esc, or Ctrl+C pressed twice, now closes the wait and the reconnect continues in the background
- Fixed Enable in `/mcp` showing no progress for a slow server, and a second Enter disabling it again

# Hermes Agent v0.23.2

**Release Date:** November 16, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~1,989 PRs merged since v0.23.1 into a stable release for the GitHub release (CLI and installers), the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.24.0.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## About this release

Measured at commit `ae2a81ccc00`, the window since v0.23.1 contains **7,918 non-merge commits** across **5,211 changed files** (+239,733 / −22,788), **1,989 merged PRs** and **940 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: durable subagents that survive a gateway restart or crash and can be continued on their own conversation, one prompt-cache clock per session, `hermes fallback check` for fallback-chain readiness, `hermes update --force` to stop gateways at once instead of draining, one-time browser_vault codes entered from Telegram and Discord, opt-in shared Telegram DM threads, the Gemini Interactions API by default for Gemini 3 and later plus Gemini 4 Carbon, fast mode for Claude Mythos 5.2, per-job cron options (`wrap_response`, a fresh thread per run), new plugin APIs (`ctx.fork_session`, `ctx.redact_text()`, `ctx.register_idle_task`), compatibility shims so updates work across module moves, a slimmer macOS bundle that installs Chromium on first use, and a large batch of new plugin-catalog entries.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.24.0**, which will document everything from v0.23.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Fixed in the release candidate

- Desktop chats created by an August build with a bare `custom` provider can send again after updating (#156545).
- A Desktop or TUI reply that streamed beside a todo or memory call now settles instead of leaving the Stop button up (#156553).
- A crash mid-stream on Telegram and other edit-streaming chats no longer shows a duplicate "Recovered reply"; a word holding a key prefix mid-word (`program_id`) is shown on time again (#156546).
- Desktop no longer loses or scrambles what you type while it starts and resumes your last chat (#156615, #156642).
- After a reconnect mid-reply, Desktop shows the reply once and in full, attachments included (#156611).
- In the Webapp, opening Hermes Cloud agents while this install isn't signed in to Nous Portal now tells you to sign in to Nous Portal instead of sending you to the Webapp login (#156652).
- Exiting the CLI while its startup update check is waiting on GitHub no longer leaves `git` running (#156616).

## Security

- Fixes [GHSA-p22p-9ph6-gmrh](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/security/advisories/GHSA-p22p-9ph6-gmrh) (`CVE-2026-130164`, High): when Bot Desktop runs inside a `docker` or `ssh` terminal backend, its screen `env` file is now allowlisted and validated, and values from a backend-hosted screen are no longer merged into processes started on the agent machine (#154487).

## Updating

- Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
- Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: [v0.23.1...v0.23.2](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v0.23.1...v0.23.2)

Choose Astra for your hardest projects, such as implementing and testing a change across an existing codebase or turning a report into slides that follow your template. Pro $200 subscribers can use GPT-6.2 Sol in Ultrafast mode. Pro $500 subscribers can use Ultrafast with both GPT-6.2 Sol and GPT-6.2 Astra.
