items.sourceText:
[Previous release: 1.4.259](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.259) — Major performance improvements, automatic cleanup and focused subagent views.

## Major performance improvements, Cursor Chat & a customizable + menu ✨

Orca 1.4.261 makes busy Chat workflows more responsive and releases memory from browser pages you haven't used in hours. Cursor joins Chat, and a customizable + menu puts your preferred ways to open tabs within reach.

- ⚡ **Move between busy chats with less waiting:** Long conversations load their history in pages, and background replies do less work in the sidebar and hidden chats when you switch conversations.
- 🌐 **Keep browser tabs without keeping every page loaded:** Memory Saver frees eligible pages after four hours out of view by default, then reloads them when you return. Sites using session cookies can also keep you signed in across restarts.
- 🤖 **Use Cursor in Chat:** Start with the Cursor sign-in on your computer, choose a model, effort and Fast, approve commands, and reopen the conversation later.
- ➕ **Make the + menu yours:** Use the gear beside the new icon row to reorder actions, hide unused choices and set shortcuts. Hidden actions remain available through search and their shortcuts.
- ⌨️ **Carry terminal work forward accurately:** Copy Context, Fork and Continue preserve spaces drawn by terminal programs. Edit → Paste targets the split pane that actually has focus.

## Highlights

- **More room for active work:** Memory Saver also applies to browser tabs on an updated `orca serve` host. Desktop tabs retain their title, history, cookies and saved site data. Settings → Browser lets you change the idle interval or turn Memory Saver off.
- **More agent choices:** Antigravity Chat works on Windows, and Pi Chat shows subagents. Ordinary Orca CLI commands avoid Electron startup on supported Macs; macOS 13.4 retains the existing launcher.
- **Workspaces at a glance:** Experimental workspace cards show activity, unread results, failures and offline hosts. Choose Classic or Experimental from Workspace options. Agents whose panes are asleep keep showing Done.
- **Phone navigation:** The paired phone interface gains desktop project groups and a shared browser preference for chat and terminal links, including Ask each time. On desktop, Take back all returns control of phone-driven browser tabs. 

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Chat history:** Existing chats convert to the new store in the background or when first opened. Original chat files stay in place in this release. After downgrading and upgrading again, chats continued in the older version are recovered; a previously converted conversation can appear beside its newer version as a second chat.
- **Browser reloads:** Freed pages reload in place; scroll position and page-only memory can reset. Desktop Memory Saver leaves pages loaded when it detects unsaved edits or cannot safely assess them. Savings depend on which pages qualify.
- **Android:** The legacy app directs users to install the new `dev.orca.app` separately; it cannot update into the new package. This desktop release does not install a phone app.
- **Finished agents:** Rows leave workspace cards, the Agents list and dashboard when the process exits or its SSH host disconnects. Sleeping panes retain their Done status.

---

## What's Changed

### 📱 Phone & mobile

*Phone chats, links, browser hand-back, project groups and the Android app move.*

* fix(files): opening a file from the phone no longer switches the desktop's view by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42212
* feat(mobile): send old Android app users to the new Orca app on Google Play by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42285
* feat(mobile): ship Android as dev.orca.app on Google Play and GitHub with one Play-signed build by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42295
* chore(mobile): bump to 0.0.65 and Android versionCode 29 by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42551
* fix(mobile): prevent extra space above the session header on iPhone Duo by @justinfjx in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42375
* fix(mobile): take back phone-driven browser tabs with Take back all by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42785
* feat(mobile): one link setting for chat and terminal links, with Ask each time by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42802
* feat(mobile): show the desktop's project groups in the workspace list by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42457
* feat(mobile): scroll a chat reply to its start from the ↑ under it by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42583
* feat(mobile): return to a chat tab where you left its transcript by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42584
* fix(mobile): apply home tab bar safe area natively by @niconicohu in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41970
* feat(mobile): add Take back all to the phone-driven browser banner by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42821
* feat(mobile): manage MCP servers from /mcp in chat by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42224

### 💬 Chat & session history

*Chat agents, the new SQLite chat store, subagents, composer and saved-chat recovery.*

* Make SQLite the source of truth for native chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/39256
* Keep original chat journals until a later update by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42479
* fix(native-chat): keep chats an older Orca saved after a downgrade by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42783
* fix(native-chat): import tables whose rowid is an INTEGER PRIMARY KEY by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42630
* fix(native-chat): import profile rows whose chat record the old store already removed by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42693
* fix(native-chat): open chats saved by journals that predate later tables by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42696
* feat(native-chat): run Cursor in Chat over its ACP server by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42193
* feat(native-chat): show agent sign-in requests as a card in chat by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42219
* feat(native-chat): manage MCP servers from /mcp in Claude and Codex chats by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42222
* feat(pi): show subagents in Pi native chat by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42448
* feat(native-chat): mark forks with a Fork prefix and a Forked from pill by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42370
* fix(native-chat): /fork during a reply forks through the newest finished response by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42215
* fix(native-chat): /new starts a fresh Codex conversation like /clear by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42445
* fix(native-chat): Claude steers interrupt foreground work and stay in the same turn by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42520
* fix(native-chat): show a Codex chat with an open async question as waiting on you by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42459
* fix(native-chat): reopen an OpenCode chat in the folder OpenCode moved it to by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42590
* fix(native-chat): match Claude banner model to its exact point release by @Luoqiu1 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42287
* fix(native-chat): keep the answer visible when a Stop hook fails by @Bensonluo in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42508
* fix(native-chat): show Claude's error under Details when a chat fails to start by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42524
* fix(acp): show a form's intro message once instead of on every question by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42571
* fix(native-chat): list installed Antigravity skills in the slash picker by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42572
* fix(native-chat): show plugin skills as chips before the first reply by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42754
* feat(native-chat): preview image files a reply links to by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42227
* fix(native-chat): preview pasted images whose link target has no extension by @bubu-dudu-52hz in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41984
* Show the current chat model and effort in the composer tooltip by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42278
* fix(native-chat): make Shift+Enter start a new paragraph in the composer by @uphy in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42607
* fix(native-chat): move macOS Ctrl+A/Ctrl+E to the caret's line across Shift+Enter breaks by @uphy in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42409
* fix(native-chat): stop the Add to chat offer from blocking composer focus by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42729
* Keep question previews inside the focus ring by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42317
* fix(native-chat): offer Submit on the last question step after skipping by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42268
* fix(native-chat): keep a subagent's last tool on its row between calls by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42514
* Tidy native chat text typography by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42359
* perf(native-chat): reuse stable pane identity during streaming by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42529
* perf(native-chat): isolate sidebar and hidden-pane subscriptions by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42546
* perf(native-chat): batch background reply status publications by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42550
* Preserve unopened chat statuses during eviction by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43061

### 🤝 Workers & coordination

*Worker dispatch, orchestration commands and automations.*

* fix(orchestration): closing a chat worker's chat ends its Dispatch by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42509
* fix(orchestration): make agent-facing CLI hints point to commands that work by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42745
* fix(orchestration): add --run to orchestration inbox by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42747
* feat(automations): unify Automations pages (option D) by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41620
* fix(automations): keep a run's Started time after its terminal is cleared by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42226

### 🤖 Agents, models & accounts

*Agent launch, model choices, sign-in, status and usage reporting.*

* Enable Antigravity Chat on Windows by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41021
* Fix two Antigravity defects found in #41021's post-merge review by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42896
* fix(antigravity): show effort choices for non-running model families by @jiahaoChen in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42282
* fix(antigravity): skip the hook script and python3 outside an Orca pane by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42790
* fix(pi): accept --model/--effort for Pi agent launch and worker-start by @lucas-wu-wakakak in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42255
* fix(notes): keep idle Orca-launched Pi tabs selectable in Send notes to by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42797
* Skip unchanged managed Codex launch preparation by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42225
* Give OpenCode the component fixtures MCP server by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42208
* fix(rate-limits): show a Codex individual sp

items.sourceText:
## Major performance improvements, automatic cleanup & focused subagent views ✨

Orca 1.4.259 improves performance across crowded sidebars, long chats and terminal restoration, and keeps Git reads moving while new workspaces are created. New cleanup controls help you manage the workspaces left behind.

- ⚡ **Smoother busy workspaces:** Crowded sidebars and long chat tool runs render only the visible rows, reducing rendering work and chat memory use. Terminal history restores without blocking the window on disk reads.
- 🧹 **Clear finished work on your terms:** Settings → Workspace Cleanup lets you review matching workspaces, enable automatic cleanup and inspect its activity. Give individual projects their own rules.
- 💬 **Follow one subagent at a time:** Open its task, live steps and final answer in a dedicated view, then return to the main conversation where you left off.
- 🤖 **Use Kimi Code in Chat:** Start a conversation with Kimi’s model picker, permission controls, questions and `/compact` support.
- 🎙️ **Watch dictation take shape:** Nemotron 3.5 now streams live text; Parakeet Unified EN adds an English-only streaming option. Optional AI cleanup handles punctuation and spoken corrections before insertion.
- 📱 **Find the phone tab that needs you:** The tab bar shows the open tab, a count and an add button. Tap the count for a grouped view of all tabs, including those waiting for your answer.

**Previous release: [1.4.258](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.258)** — Smoother workspaces, restored phone scrolling and Copilot Chat.

## Highlights

- **Keep working while agents use tools:** Agent-created terminal splits keep your keyboard where it was. Browser popups and new-tab links opened by agents stay in the background. A server agent’s new browser tab can open on your paired desktop; without a paired desktop, it stays on the server.
- **Organize without stopping work:** Hide a project from the sidebar while its agents, terminals and automations keep running. Find it again under **Hidden projects**. On a shared paired server, hiding its project applies to everyone connected there.
- **Inspect long runs:** Expanded tool runs draw the visible rows while preserving Find, copying and keyboard navigation. Subagent rosters show each agent’s model, current work and result.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Cleanup is opt-in:** Rules start off. Review the deletion preview before enabling them; matching workspaces may be deleted within seconds of confirmation. Archive controls are not available.
- **Kimi Chat** requires Kimi Code **2.5.0+** and sign-in.
- **Voice:** Download Parakeet Unified EN in Voice settings to use it. AI cleanup is off by default and asks before sending dictated text, vocabulary and instructions to your selected agent. Failure or timeout inserts the original words. With simultaneous dictations, only one streams live.
- **Phone:** These changes include desktop-served phone pages; this desktop update does not install a native phone app. If prompted to **Update mobile**, update the phone app and reconnect.
- **Source Control:** The merged-workspace cleanup notice and its Delete Workspace action were withdrawn; earlier review-refresh and sleeping-workspace behavior is restored.

---

## What's Changed

### 📱 Phone & mobile

*Phone tabs, touch input, remote controls and mobile rendering.*

* fix(mobile): send chat with Cmd+Enter in desktop Mac browsers by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41330
* feat(mobile): show only the open tab, with a tab count and a sheet of every tab by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41345
* fix(mobile): show an error when closing a session tab fails by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41404
* Clarify mobile pairing access and lost-device revocation by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41453
* fix(mobile): exclude overlay permission and clear removed-host diagnostics by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41455
* Allow hosts to disable mobile push delivery by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41456
* fix(browser): a tab taken back from the phone returns to desktop size at once by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41501
* fix(mobile): shrink chat photos to 2000 px before upload by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41514
* fix(mobile): return to Agents in one Back from an agent opened on Home by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41522
* fix(mobile): convert Android HEIC photos to JPEG when picked for chat by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41626
* feat(mobile): floating answer card, queued messages above it by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41611
* fix(mobile): place a failed queued row by the queue's current order by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41633
* perf(renderer): drop the mobile-driver overlay's backdrop blur by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41557
* Improve bug report template for desktop, remote, and mobile by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/11140
* Open linked worktree directories in mobile chat by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36078
* Open launched agents from mobile AI actions by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35235
* fix(mobile): forget queued-row heights for messages that left the queue by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41802
* perf(mobile): build all-tabs sheet rows only while the sheet is shown by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41819
* fix(relay): re-ask the director when phone data attaches keep failing; close coordinator recovery gaps by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41991
* fix(mobile-relay): bounded resolve on persistent 4404, widen a timed-out resolve, rate-limit deferral logs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41994

### 💬 Chat & session history

*Chat agents, subagent views, conversation rendering and saved-session discovery.*

* fix(native-chat): send Claude images over 5 MB instead of refusing the message by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41333
* fix(native-chat): refresh skills when reopening the picker by @Luoqiu1 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41023
* fix(native-chat): keep branch hover beside its label by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41340
* Skip rename migration owner lookups for chats without aliases by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41355
* fix(native-chat): send images over 5 MB to Pi 1.5.1 and newer by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41391
* Stop chat-host lookups from duplicating approval watches by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41390
* fix(native-chat): send images up to 20 MB inline to ACP agents instead of as a file path by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41400
* fix(native-chat): keep Send's round size while Cmd/Ctrl previews steer by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40820
* fix(native-chat): attach SVG, BMP and ICO as files instead of refusing the message by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41394
* fix(native-chat): keep Claude's context ring after compaction when responses carry no usage by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41507
* feat(plugins): host API 1.9 — agent session history, resume past sessions, task titles by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41542
* perf(chat): decode OpenCode transcript messages once per page by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41575
* feat(native-chat): answer card as separate option tiles by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41602
* Antigravity settings: flatten into agy terminal and Chats cards by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41531
* fix(native-chat): Enter on the chosen answer confirms instead of deselecting by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41635
* fix(native-chat): keep final reply spacing consistent by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41440
* fix(native-chat): continue a usage-limited chat on the account you switch to by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41665
* Keep OMP background work alive during native chat idle cleanup by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41491
* feat(native-chat): run Kimi Code in Chat over its ACP server by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41661
* Honor user rules in managed Antigravity chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41504
* Antigravity chat setup: install from Chat UI settings, sign in from the chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41506
* fix(native-chat): preview GitHub PR links in chats without a GitHub repo by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41359
* Improve Chat UI tips by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41666
* Name the terminal's Orca ID item Copy Orca Session ID, matching chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41725
* perf(native-chat): draw only the visible rows of an opened tool run by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41552
* fix(opencode): attach @-mentioned files to OpenCode chat prompts by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41932
* fix(native-chat): an older browser run's Show button opens its own page or none, never the latest by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41939
* fix(native-chat): the browser Show button says why when the page can't be opened by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41956
* fix(native-chat): keep a Claude chat's start going when the laptop sleeps, instead of rejecting the message by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41965
* fix(native-chat): /compact runs while a Claude chat's background subagent works by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41945
* feat(native-chat): show each subagent's model, current tool and result in the chat by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41766
* feat(native-chat): open a subagent in its own view with its prompt, steps and reply by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42066
* perf(native-chat): avoid per-commit journal fsync by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42162
* fix(native-chat): forget a chat tab's open subagent when the tab closes by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42254

### 🤝 Workers & coordination

*Worker prompts, coordination, messaging and remote run management.*

* perf(orchestration): stop coordinator check and worker-list from rescanning Run history by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41293
* perf(orchestration): back off idle remote relays and pull only pending peer replies by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41311
* fix(orchestration): label follow-up worker cards, gate remote-owned start cards on ready by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41377
* feat(orchestration): let coordinators approve worker permission prompts (opt-in) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41306
* fix(orchestration): hide approve from help; approval follow-ups by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41403
* perf(orchestration): read released worker output from its original instead of a saved copy by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41374
* fix(orchestration): point a terminal-only pane at its own direct mailbox by @MsCNotes404 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29925
* perf(orchestration): end a paired server's mail pull loop once nothing here needs it by @Jinwoo-H in https://g

items.sourceText:
## What's changed

- Fixed a security issue in how zstd-compressed responses are decoded
- Added a spinner tip in VS Code and similar integrated terminals about re-running a notebook cell, shown once Claude has read or edited a Jupyter notebook
- Added a line under the error shown when your organization's policy blocks a request, saying how to continue: run `/rewind` and change the message, or run `/clear`
- Added a note for Claude when a sandboxed `git checkout`, `git stash` or autostash pull cannot update protected files such as those in `.claude`
- Fixed `/security-review` and skills' inline git commands stopping with an error in worktrees of bare repositories, `--separate-git-dir` checkouts and Android `repo` checkouts
- Fixed subagents with their own model being moved to the plan-mode model when the model setting is `opusplan` or `haiku`
- Fixed subagents on a different model sizing file reads and MCP results with the main session's model
- Fixed sessions on many third-party gateways and Foundry stopping with a context length error on every turn instead of compacting
- Fixed recent turns sometimes going missing from a resumed session after Claude Code stopped without a clean exit
- Fixed shell commands running in the launch directory after the working directory was deleted; the command now fails with a message and can be re-issued
- Fixed an approved plan edit being lost when the `plansDirectory` folder can't take it: the plan is now saved in the default plans folder, and a warning says where and why
- Fixed a saved `sonnet[1m]` model setting being rewritten on a new install to a model id the API rejects
- Fixed focus view hiding the reply to your prompt when a scheduled task replied after it
- Fixed the prompt sometimes missing from a background subagent's view when fullscreen is off
- Fixed long options in lists and permission prompts being partly overwritten when they wrap, and first-run screens losing lines on narrow terminals
- Fixed startup warnings about permission rules and the "N MCP servers need authentication" notice being recorded as seen when they were scrolled out of view
- Fixed the welcome header showing control characters or splitting across lines when an agent's name or the working folder contains them or a line break
- Fixed the red error shown when Claude tries a command only you can run: a dim line now says it runs only when you type it at the prompt
- Fixed `/stats` showing an Active days total that was one day too high
- Fixed `/insights` saying a report was ready when no session qualified for analysis, and writing two values into its HTML report without escaping them
- Fixed `/voice` saying voice mode changed when managed settings, `--settings`, or the project's `.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.local.json` kept it as it was; it now says what holds it
- Fixed the IDE welcome dialog showing Cmd+Esc for Quick Launch on Windows and Linux
- Fixed Slack app tips showing when your organization's policy denies cloud sessions
- Fixed `claude purge` hanging silently when there is no terminal to read keys from, and its project picker and `-i` prompts ignoring the keyboard when stdin is piped
- Fixed `claude plugin eval --output-dir ''` writing the report into the current folder; it now exits with an error
- Fixed `claude -p` text output on a terminal passing control sequences other than text styling; pipes and files are unchanged
- Fixed leftover `.oauth_refresh.lock.owner.tmp.*` files piling up in the config directory
- Fixed `/fast` saying "Fast mode has been disabled by your organization" under the keyless Console sign-in, where Claude Code had not asked the server
- Fixed `/model` saying that your organization restricts a model when Claude Code could not check that, for example with no network
- Fixed "Sign in with your Console account" in `/login` replacing your existing login when you pressed Esc right after the browser step
- Fixed the browser showing the sign-in success page in some cases where sign-in failed or was canceled
- Fixed `claude auth status` and other short commands leaving a lock behind on a Console profile, which made the next session hang for about a minute
- Fixed background sessions started on your claude.ai login using (and billing) an API key or token from the shell that started the background service
- Fixed more cases of a session moving to another sign-in in the background; these moves are now refused, with a message saying what works
- Fixed a second Enter in the exit dialog stopping background work after the move to the background was refused
- Fixed token counting on Amazon Bedrock sending the conversation to Bedrock when the `allowedProviders` managed setting does not allow it
- Fixed AWS `credential_process` helpers and Google Cloud default credentials failing when Claude Code is started without a `HOME` environment variable
- Fixed a session sometimes going back to an earlier permission mode after a subagent's plan was approved
- Fixed one invalid value in an Agent SDK `applyFlagSettings()` call silently discarding all settings from earlier calls; a call that would do this is now refused with an error
- Fixed sessions showing as waiting for input when a finished pull request only needed your own review or merge
- Fixed an unrecognized `teammateMode` settings value being ignored without a warning: `claude -p`, the startup warning and `claude doctor` now list it as a skipped entry (still not applied)
- Fixed `--worktree` skipping a `WorktreeCreate` hook from a plugin in `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR` on the first run in a new home directory
- Fixed brief-mode sessions, such as Dispatch, sending a reply again after the turn had already replied
- Fixed Claude saying a working Atlassian, Asana or Sentry connector had failed in cloud sessions when a plugin listed it at a different URL
- Fixed Claude Desktop and SDK sessions listing a folder's own MCP servers (`.mcp.json`, local) as host-added or not at all, and not connecting WebSocket ones, after a folder move or pre-warmed start
- Fixed `/mcp` still listing a plugin's MCP server after a plugin reload removed it while it was connecting
- Fixed an MCP server staying "needs authentication", and its `mcp_tool` hooks being skipped, after a token refresh that was refused only for a moment
- Fixed MCP elicitation requests being cancelled without asking in headless mode after a server's connection was replaced during a tool call
- Fixed MCP tool calls from an SDK host answering "Not connected" after a tool call had reconnected the MCP server
- Fixed an MCP task getting stuck after its question was closed with Esc or asked again: the footer now says it needs your input, and Enter in `/tasks` shows the question again
- Fixed background MCP tasks that stopped updating after another call to the same server lost the connection, when a later call reconnects
- Fixed a background MCP task's question opening over a message you were still typing; it now waits until you send or clear the draft, and the spinner and turn timer keep running
- Fixed `worktree.sparsePaths` and sparse plugin and marketplace clones leaving out the repository's root files on older git versions, such as 2.34
- Fixed self-hosted runner sessions with several repositories being unable to use a repository added mid-session
- Fixed Claude asking for permission before reading your own artifact or its data
- Fixed deny and ask permission rules and hooks for the Artifact tool not applying in some cloud sessions
- Fixed Code Mode scripts ignoring a worktree entered with `EnterWorktree`, writing `~` paths into the project, and leaving `/mcp` showing an MCP server as connected after its sign-in expired
- Fixed words typed with a Yes at a permission dialog or plan approval not reaching Claude in Code Mode
- Fixed Claude starting work by itself when you resumed a session that ended during a Code Mode script; it now waits for your next prompt
- Fixed a missing OpenTelemetry `user_prompt` event for a message sent while tool calls run. The event has `delivery.mode: "mid_turn"` and the running turn's `prompt.id`
- Fixed the OpenTelemetry `user_prompt` event leaving out earlier messages' text when queued messages merged into one turn in VS Code, or when one message had an image
- Fixed a slash command's `allowed-tools` grants applying to background agents woken during or after its turn
- Fixed `/feedback` and `/bug` to upload other sessions only when they were recorded by the signed-in account or organization
- Fixed relative deny and ask permission rules (e.g. `Read(./.env)`) no longer covering the project after a `cd`; they now also apply in added directories
- Fixed deny and ask permission rules starting with `mcp__plugin_*_` missing a plugin's MCP server or tool spelled in another letter case
- Fixed deny rules not being applied to a permission approval that arrives after Claude Code restarts, in self-hosted runner and `claude remote-control` sessions
- Fixed a case where a committed `.claude/settings.local.json` could be treated as the user's own when Claude Code was started in certain subfolders of a repository
- Fixed some deny and ask rules not applying to certain Bash commands
- Fixed a gap in Bash permission checks where some compound commands could run without asking; these now ask for permission
- Fixed a case where a Bash allow rule could run a different program than the one it names
- Fixed a connector tool's approval prompt in cloud sessions being answered automatically while plugins were still loading
- Fixed some subagents changing an artifact that people outside your organization can see, or uploading files to it, without asking first when an allow rule is set or uploads were approved earlier
- Fixed some artifact publishes skipping the confirmation for pages that people outside your organization can see when "don't ask again" had been chosen for Artifact
- Fixed auto mode judging only the first change to an artifact that people outside your organization can see; its yes now covers that change alone
- Fixed a managed `strictPluginOnlyCustomization` lock on agents and skills not taking effect in sessions that were already running
- Fixed sandboxed commands being able to write to the native updater's download folder in some cases
- Fixed a case where the Bash sandbox did not fully protect a worktree's settings and hooks
- Fixed a case where the Bash sandbox did not fully protect a linked worktree's shared git folder
- Fixed `/teleport`'s stash choice in some unusual git states: it now stops and says what to do
- Windows: Fixed a start-up stall that could last about a second when a PATH entry sits under a folder your account cannot open
- Fixed `/resume` on Windows refusing or hiding sessions whose folder was recorded with a different drive-letter case or slashes
- Fixed an in-session `/resume` on Windows dropping a project's saved trust when the session was recorded with a different drive-letter case
- Linux: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands failing with `bwrap: Can't create file` when the working directory was below an `allowRead` folder inside a `denyRead`, such as under a symlinked home directory
- Fixed Claude Desktop's third-party deployments staying on "Stopping" until a token renewal finished (once it includes this version)
- Improved subagents cut off at the output token limit: they are now asked for the whole answer again, more briefly, instead of returning only its end
- Improved startup with a keyless Console sign-in or other Anthropic profile login: a token that is still valid is read without waiting for the credentials lock
- Improved the account email check: it now also refuses your email as a client's identity in scripts a command runs, file writes, web fetches and MCP calls
- Improved the `HTTPS authentication failed` message for private plugin marketplaces: it now says git's terminal prompts and askpass programs are disabled, and it also appears with newer git versions
- Improved the add-mark

details.basis: 公式原文からの抽出とルールによる試し方案。実測結果ではありません。
details.change: 主な話題：安全性・権限管理、不具合修正、モデル対応。キーワードに基づく日本語の暫定分類です。具体的な変更内容と提供条件は公式原文で確認してください。
details.before: 旧版の具体的な挙動は取得した本文だけでは確認できません。比較結果は未確認です。
details.after: 「Claude Code v2.1.325：公式リリース」で案内された範囲が対象です。機能・提供条件は下の公式出典で照合してください。
details.workflow: 空の検証フォルダで、許可した操作と確認・拒否されるべき操作を一つずつ実行し、ダイアログと実行結果を比較する。対象は「Claude Code v2.1.325：公式リリース」。この更新が必要な操作に影響するかを切り分けるための提案です。
steps: 現在の製品名・バージョン・ログイン方法を控え、公開データを使うテスト用フォルダを用意する。
空の検証フォルダで、許可した操作と確認・拒否されるべき操作を一つずつ実行し、ダイアログと実行結果を比較する。同じ入力・同じ依頼を保存する。
公式ノートの対象バージョンに切り替え、同じ依頼を再実行する。成功可否・手直し回数・出力差分を記録する。
details.benefit: この作業で再現した場合に限り、やり直しや手動確認が減る可能性があります。速度・品質の改善率は測定していません。
details.environment: プラン・地域・アプリ/CLIの対応条件は公式ページで確認が必要です。
details.limitations: ChatGPT Plus / Claude Pro / Google AI Proの契約からAPI利用権や他製品の機能を推定しません。CLI・アプリ・Webの提供差に注意してください。

items.sourceText:
## What's Changed
* Give the start failure reason when the remote desktop runtime has an unexpected error by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8906
* Animate the theme change in the mobile app by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8909
* Show the tax ID field on the payment page from the start by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8910
* Keep the language header that a site sets on its own request by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8911
* Give a new Pi process more time to answer its first request by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8913
* Show a provider account as signed out when an agent start finds no login by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8923
* Prepare shorter parts when a reply is read aloud at a higher speed by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8928
* Say that the server did not accept the sign-in when its token step refuses it by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8853
* Tell the user when a chat does not fit a local model's window by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8846
* Start a new hosted server on a ready Leaseweb machine, and on boat when the pool has none by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8879
* Tell the user when Gemini cannot open an account's settings file by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8849
* Show "Using credits" when a ChatGPT plan limit is used and credits remain by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6633
* Throttle browser tabs that nobody sees or uses by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8940
* Give Grok agents the correct name for a deferred OpenBot tool by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8942
* Name the MCP server in the notice for a declined request by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6513
* Permit the storage access request of a frame from a different site in the browser by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8944
* Name the frame when a secure input field is in a frame of another origin by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8950
* Give an agent its correct permission level when it reads its setup by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8943
* Show an arrow pointer on the empty agent display of a server by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8939
* build(nix): install OpenBot 0.70.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8967
* Remove the iOS build warnings of the mobile app and sign with the Synthetify team by default by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8958
* Add a live provider test that runs by hand on the Mac mini runner by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8838
* Tell the agent that a memory is gone when it changes one that is not in the store by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8971
* Prepare OpenBot mobile v1.4.10 by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8975
* Read a failed model list again after a provider CLI update by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8977
* Run the activity label light on the compositor by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6669
* Stop an ACP turn that repeats the same failed tool call by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8980
* Start a new OpenCode session when a local model cannot compact a chat by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8978
* Recover an OpenCode chat after a model refuses an image it cannot read by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8992
* Give an agent the page text of its earlier visual reply in history_read by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8984
* Show why a channel request waits by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8934
* Stop a routine run from the Routines canvas by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8986
* Let an agent end quietly when a teammate answers a quiet routine run's request by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8996
* Show an agent's answer when the chat keeps a stale streaming copy by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8995
* Use the client metadata document when a server refuses each redirect address by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/9021
* Delete the member threads with a channel's history by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/9034
* Open the Claude sign-in page from OpenBot on Windows by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/9040
* Follow an MCP sign-in redirect to the server's own www host by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/9041
* Keep the microphone open at the end of a voice conversation turn by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/9069
* Tell agents to write a path with no local file as plain text by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/9075
* Show an uploaded image at once on a joined server by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/9078
* Replace a Gemini session that the Antigravity CLI cannot read by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/9079
* Let the empty right side panel be resized by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/9091
* Give each pool VPS the neutral reference pool and let a move select a free VPS by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/9104
* Show a GitHub Copilot model that the user adds while Copilot runs by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/9105
* Say that agents can read the API key files of other agents by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/9106
* Run a thread's empty turn of a teammate result again by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/9115
* Always turn off Codex plugin install suggestions by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/9120
* Let a pinch zoom the app around the pointer by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/9135
* Let chat videos from a joined server seek and play to the end by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/9136

items.sourceText:
## What's changed

- Added Code Mode, an experimental opt-in in which Claude writes JavaScript to call its tools; see https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode to turn it on, or to turn it off for an organization
- Added `engines["claude-code"]` to `plugin.json`: plugins outside their stated Claude Code version range are not installed, updated or loaded, and install and update pick the newest version that fits
- Added type checking of a plugin's TypeScript hooks module to `claude plugin validate`; each finding is a warning, and `--strict` fails on it
- Added to `claude plugin validate` the `$` nouns a mod's `engine.create` hook adds, withholds or replaces
- Added support for `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL` in managed settings for Claude Desktop sessions on third-party providers (takes effect once Claude Desktop includes this version)
- Added an options menu (stop, switch to usage credits, upgrade) when a model needs usage credits that are turned off or used up
- Added a progress heartbeat every 30 seconds while hooks run long in `claude -p` and SDK sessions, so a host such as Claude Desktop won't end the turn as hung (once it includes this version)
- Added `.docx` support to Artifact tool asset uploads
- Added a `/diff to close` hint to the diff panel, and the keys that focus and close a panel to the `?` shortcut guide
- Added a start-up warning for Bash allow rules with a `*` in a variable's value, such as `Bash(PORT=* npm run dev)`
- Added a warning when a plugin's language server can't start, naming the server and what to check
- Added a one-time startup notice naming `CLAUDE_CODE_PERFORCE_MODE` when Perforce settings are found and the mode is off
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_PROGRESS_SUMMARIES` (available since 2.1.318): set it to `1` to turn off subagent progress summaries and the requests that write them (anthropics/claude-code#86879)
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_HINT_COMMAND`, which a program that starts Claude Code can set to have the exit hint name its own resume command
- Added `unsetOptionCount` to the `claude plugin install --json` result: how many `userConfig` options are not yet set
- Added `isPromptCovered` to the props a mod's pane is drawn with, telling it when a dialog or a field above the prompt covers the prompt
- Fixed running `/compact` again, or after a command such as `/context`, summarizing away a message that Claude had not answered yet
- Fixed a resumed session joining your next message to an old interrupted message that was not resumed
- Fixed a memory spike at the next prompt after Claude changed a very large file
- Fixed a setting saved in a running session undoing a hand edit made to `settings.json` moments earlier; a settings file you delete during a session now stays deleted
- Fixed `claude plugin` commands and `claude mcp list` signing you out of a Console profile when they ended while the token was being renewed
- Fixed Edit and Bash running out of memory on certain `/proc` files, and Edit hanging or running out of memory on devices and named pipes
- Fixed Claude Code failing to start, or to clear stored credentials at sign-out, when saving its configuration file failed with "Out of memory"
- Fixed requests sent without streaming failing on errors that streamed requests recover from, such as a rejected image, thinking block or beta header
- Fixed `ExitWorktree`, the worktree exit dialog and `/resume` leaving the session in the wrong folder when the folder the shell was in before entering the worktree had been deleted
- Fixed accents and other combining marks sometimes landing left of the text, leaving stale copies on screen, or silently disappearing when text wraps
- Fixed the last key of a key chord, such as Enter in ctrl+x enter, acting on a dialog's text field when the chord's own action isn't available there
- Fixed `ps` processes piling up when the process listing Claude Code runs before stopping a command takes too long
- Fixed subagent transcripts and large tool results being saved apart from the session's transcript after entering a worktree created by a `WorktreeCreate` hook or belonging to a nested repository
- Fixed a session on a named Anthropic profile moving to another sign-in when `/fork`, the Left arrow or `--bg` continued it in the background; reopen any session that was open during the update
- Fixed a background session sending a conversation under another sign-in when its named Anthropic profile is missing, changed or overridden; it now stops and says so
- Fixed a session on an API key, auth token or workload identity from its shell (not a setup token) moving to another sign-in in the background; it now stops and says so
- Fixed MCP tool calls ending in the sign-in server's error, such as `TOKEN_EXPIRED`, instead of asking you to sign in again
- Fixed an expired claude.ai login showing "Credit balance too low" when a saved Console key or `ant auth login` profile without credit was used instead
- Fixed a session on a named Anthropic profile being handed to an older background service that could not keep its sign-in; it now says to restart the service
- Fixed a background session's sign-in leaving the previous account's login or other credentials in place; it now clears them for every session on the computer, and a refused sign-in can leave no login
- Fixed background sessions moving between a profile and the stored login when an update restarted them
- Fixed sessions opened before a sign-in keeping signed-out feature flags after the sign-in
- Fixed sessions that kept failing after a Claude apps gateway sign-in expired: once you sign in again with `/login` in another terminal, they carry on at the next message
- Fixed the billing notice naming your `ant auth login` organization when a custom `X-Api-Key` header is set
- macOS: Fixed "Not logged in · Please run /login" coming back right after a successful `/login` or a token refresh when the keychain was slow to answer
- Fixed turns failing in Claude Desktop when an organization's gateway answers an expired token with 403: Claude Code now asks Desktop for a fresh token and retries
- Fixed the error shown when Amazon Bedrock refuses your account a model: it no longer says to refresh your AWS credentials, it says to enable the model
- Fixed the `awsAuthRefresh` or `gcpAuthRefresh` command sometimes running twice for one request when three or more sessions needed a fresh sign-in at once
- Fixed the `claude -p` warning about an ended claude.ai login to say that `claude auth logout` also removes saved MCP server logins and plugin secrets
- Fixed Bash permission prompts offering "don't ask again" for commands that write to sensitive paths such as `.git` or `.claude`, where the saved rule did not stop the next prompt
- Fixed a case where some `lsof` commands ran without a permission prompt
- Fixed Bash commands that write a file with `cat > file <<EOF` being shown as "Read 1 file"
- Fixed a case where Bash permission checks judged an `rm` from the wrong folder and skipped the dangerous-removal prompt under bypass permissions or a Bash allow rule
- Fixed `--permission-mode auto` or a settings `defaultMode: auto` starting in a mode that could allow more when auto mode was unavailable. It now starts in Manual mode, which asks first
- Fixed plan files sometimes being written outside the project when `plansDirectory` is set; a write that can't be shown to stay inside the project is now refused
- Fixed a permission prompt when Claude read the output of its own background command or agent after entering a worktree
- Fixed a case where Bash permission checks missed part of a command
- Fixed a case where the Bash sandbox could switch off during a session
- Fixed Bash allow rules with an attached wildcard, such as `Bash(ls*)`, skipping the permission prompt in some cases; a rule that names a variable, such as `Bash(NODE_ENV*)`, now asks
- Fixed auto mode running behind a gateway at `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` on a model whose gateway name contains "haiku"; such a model, other than `claude-haiku-5-5`, is now refused, as Haiku 4.5 is
- Fixed Bash deny and ask rules missing some commands run through `sudo`, `env` and similar wrappers
- Fixed Bash allow rules written with combined `sudo` flags skipping the permission prompt in some cases
- Fixed `sandbox.excludedCommands` letting a command that it does not name run outside the sandbox in some cases
- Fixed a case where the Write and Edit tools could write to a path covered by a `Read` deny rule
- Fixed a case where a Bash command ran without a permission prompt for zsh users with certain non-default shell options set
- Fixed the Bash sandbox not fully protecting Claude Code's own config on installs still using the legacy config file
- Fixed a permission prompt from a mod's `tool.check` hook naming every plugin hooked on the tool instead of the one that asked
- Fixed sandboxed commands being able to read Claude Code's file checkpoint copies under the config directory
- Fixed a rewind sometimes changing your permission mode
- Fixed project settings sometimes being read through a symbolic link that leads to a different folder than the one Claude Code checked
- Fixed HTTP hooks failing with HTTP 500 on Linux when `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB` is set and `sandbox.enabled` is off
- Fixed `claude -p` and the Agent SDK running Bash unsandboxed when `--settings` or SDK settings that turn the sandbox on fail validation; Claude Code now stops at start-up and names the invalid setting
- Fixed `/export` silently stopping early after a long run of calls to an MCP tool that is no longer loaded
- Fixed earlier MCP tool calls missing from a resumed conversation, and lines repeating in scrollback, when the server connects late
- Fixed `claude mcp add --help` splitting long example commands across lines in narrow terminals and pipes, so a pasted example ran without its header
- Fixed plugins with `defaultEnabled: false` staying off in a claude.ai chat's cloud session after you turn them on in claude.ai
- Fixed `/fast on` and `/fast off` on Vertex not asking a plugin's `config.set` hook, as the `/fast` menu does
- Fixed documents created through the Claude Docs connector not opening in your browser when you work in a terminal
- Fixed the misleading "not cached" error for a plugin only a repository's settings enable: it now says it isn't installed, gives the install command, and shows in text and stream-json `-p` runs
- Fixed mods being able to reword Claude Code's own confirmation questions
- Fixed a mod's hot reload sometimes ignoring a file created just after a failed reload
- Fixed marketplaces named `npm`, `pip`, `uv`, `cargo`, `github` or `gh` being refused as reserved names
- Fixed a stopped MCP call, or a stopped shell command in fullscreen, reading as "Called" or "Ran" in a collapsed tool group: it now says no result was recorded and shows its input
- Fixed load errors of plugins enabled by managed settings going only to the debug log in SDK and Desktop sessions: `init.plugin_errors` now lists them
- Fixed plugin installs hiding what a plugin's install command wrote to stderr when that command succeeded, such as a note that the plugin has no skills yet
- Fixed one malformed entry in a plugin marketplace's `renames` map making Claude Code ignore the marketplace's other renames
- Fixed `claude --bg --safe-mode` sessions stopping at startup to ask about project MCP servers that safe mode never starts
- Fixed MCP link prompts offering Accept for non-http links without saying the link wouldn't open
- Fixed `/mcp` and `/plugins` opening an MCP server's page with the cursor on "Disable" when the server needs authentication but still holds its sign-in; the page now offers "Reconnect" and opens on it
- Fixed plugins with a version list in `enabledPlugins` staying off with no message: `/plugin` and `claude plugin list` now say why
- Fixed plugins and marketplaces failing to install on Windows when the path of a cloned file reaches 260 characters
- Fixed a Stop

details.basis: 公式原文からの抽出とルールによる試し方案。実測結果ではありません。
details.change: 主な話題：不具合修正、モデル対応、MCP・外部連携。キーワードに基づく日本語の暫定分類です。具体的な変更内容と提供条件は公式原文で確認してください。
details.before: 旧版の具体的な挙動は取得した本文だけでは確認できません。比較結果は未確認です。
details.after: 「Claude Code v2.1.323：公式リリース」で案内された範囲が対象です。機能・提供条件は下の公式出典で照合してください。
details.workflow: 読み取り専用のテスト用コネクターを一つ接続し、最初のターンと再接続後に同じツールが使えるかを確認する。対象は「Claude Code v2.1.323：公式リリース」。この更新が必要な操作に影響するかを切り分けるための提案です。
steps: 現在の製品名・バージョン・ログイン方法を控え、公開データを使うテスト用フォルダを用意する。
読み取り専用のテスト用コネクターを一つ接続し、最初のターンと再接続後に同じツールが使えるかを確認する。同じ入力・同じ依頼を保存する。
公式ノートの対象バージョンに切り替え、同じ依頼を再実行する。成功可否・手直し回数・出力差分を記録する。
details.benefit: この作業で再現した場合に限り、やり直しや手動確認が減る可能性があります。速度・品質の改善率は測定していません。
details.environment: プラン・地域・アプリ/CLIの対応条件は公式ページで確認が必要です。
details.limitations: ChatGPT Plus / Claude Pro / Google AI Proの契約からAPI利用権や他製品の機能を推定しません。CLI・アプリ・Webの提供差に注意してください。

items.sourceText:
## What's Changed
* Open the sign-in view on a server after a saved login fails by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7649
* Show a member only the Library files of the agents that they can see by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7651
* Find the Gemini verification link in each text format by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7652
* Stop a Codex marketplace update failure from showing as a provider error by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7654
* Show a notification while a provider downloads for the first time by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7656
* Tell the agent why a named provider has no models by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7657
* Read the next history page from the chat of its cursor by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7667
* Open the browser when Sign in follows a refused MCP sign-in by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7664
* Show one chat row when a skill is installed for many agents by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7673
* Move Apple apps to mcp-icloud 2.1.4 so Apple Mail emails open by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7687
* Show the model in the model picker when a provider has more than one account by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7682
* Keep the chat's latest message as the agent preview during a routine run by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7677
* Show the found models of a custom provider in a menu with a search field by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7685
* Move a signed-out Claude turn to a backup model by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7698
* Complete a channel task whose result was posted before its turn failed by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7702
* Stop the shared OpenCode process before a deleted agent's folder goes on Windows by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7728
* Name the MCP server that stopped a Gemini turn by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7726
* Wait after a failed usage read also in the usage limit check by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7731
* Compact an OpenCode chat at 80% and show a correct error for a refused free model by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7738
* Add Teach a task: record browser steps and send them to the agent as a skill request by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7732
* build(nix): install OpenBot 0.68.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7745
* Make the agent browser load more sites with a bot check, and upgrade Electron to 45.3.0 by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7735
* Give the release Docker build a mirror address when the runner cannot resolve it by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7751
* Give a custom endpoint 30 minutes of silence before its turn ends by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7755
* Make the message input a pill with cards that come out from behind it by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7740
* Read older history from a message ID in history_read before by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7756
* Add Mute agent and Unmute agent to the agent menu by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7766
* End a usage limit hold after a reset outside OpenBot by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7767
* Let agents find the WhatsApp place list in a tool search by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7771
* Install a local skill revision when the copy has no unsaved edits by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7768
* Run OpenBot tools without a card for a Workspace only Grok agent by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7779
* List the built-in MCP servers in the agent's MCP tools by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7781
* Tell OpenCode agents to find MCP tools with search in execute by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7795
* Make OpenBot start faster and start the default provider first by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7792
* Keep Codex approvals with the user when auto review is on by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7800
* Keep the pictures of a joined server's agents while the server is offline by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7808
* Tell the user what to do when Gemini refuses a request by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7822
* Let an agent read a connected chat by name in a routine or the user's chat by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7809
* Say when the processor of the computer cannot run a provider by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7821
* Move the server menu to the page rail and give each page one top row by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7830
* Steer a working agent by default, and give a teammate's request its own turn by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7826
* Tell the agent when an installed app keeps its own key by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7829
* Ship Computer Use driver 0.41.3 so agents can read macOS file pickers by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7833
* Keep OpenBot's MCP server when Antigravity has one with the same name by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7836
* Start Marketplace npx apps with the managed Bun runtime by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7835
* Move a Claude turn with spent usage credits to a backup model by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7841
* Tell the user to install OpenBot again when a program file is damaged by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7831
* Keep the controls that hang over other content solid in the transparent window by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7844
* Keep a hidden agent at work by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7825
* Add a clear Close button to settings pages and the full browser view by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7849
* Keep the files that OpenBot did not write in the Vault key folder by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7851
* Keep a new chat request through a routine run in its own session by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7845
* Add a switch to turn off the WhatsApp "Working on it…" message by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7856
* Run routines on time after the computer clock is corrected by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7859
* Let Space move the workflow board after a click on a card button by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7862
* Complete the shutdown when the main window closes on Linux and Windows by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7867
* Tell agents how to fix a GitHub refusal while GitHub is connected by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7886
* Keep the unread line in place when an agent replies in the open web chat by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7901
* Pool the accounts of a provider by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7891
* Place hosts on a near Signal machine and add San Jose and Sydney homes by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7900
* Let a channel routine run end quietly when it has nothing to report by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7875
* Keep OpenCode instructions when an idle session opens again by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7873
* Show browser forms that have a field named hidden or inert by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7911
* Show a generated image one time in the chat by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7879
* Add folders to the Library, and the Library to the web client by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7914
* Tell the agent when a local skill or revision does not exist by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7930
* Let an operator move a hosted server from boat to a Leaseweb VPS by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7926
* Let users and agents pin messages, and open an old pin at its message by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7927
* Show custom provider models as a table and fill their limits from the model catalog by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7878
* Start a stopped server on this computer again by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7945
* Set who gets each MCP server: agents and roles by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7872
* Start new OpenCode agents on the fastest free model by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7943
* Show the Gemini quota in the usage ring again by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7940
* Keep a channel result that comes after a background job by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7950
* Connect Discord, Slack and Telegram on a server on this computer by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7953
* Show when a saved Gemini key replaces Account 1, and add Disconnect for it by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7942
* Read Italian replies aloud with the Italian voice by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7956
* Keep the web loading screen until the sidebar is ready by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7957
* Keep the app responsive after a restart with many task threads by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7964
* Leave out an MCP server whose tool schema Gemini refuses by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7966
* Use the openbot:// link for an MCP sign-in after both loopback names fail by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7974
* Mark the mobile app 1.4.9 available on iOS and Android, and turn on its cloud servers and browser flags by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8197
* Reuse Leaseweb pool machines after a plan ends, and show the pool in OpenPanel by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8208

items.sourceText:
**Previous release: [1.4.257](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.257)** — Smoother long chats, saved browser feedback and better dictation.

## Smoother workspaces, restored phone scrolling & Copilot Chat ✨

Orca 1.4.258 cuts pauses when opening large workspace collections, moving windows and changing the layout. Local usage updates do less work on the process handling your keystrokes, helping Chat UI and terminal users keep working while usage refreshes.

- 📱 **Scroll phone chats again:** On chat pages served by the desktop, swipe through messages and sideways through wide code blocks. Pinch with two fingers to resize chat text without zooming the whole page.
- 💬 **Use GitHub Copilot in Chat:** Choose **Launch chat** to stream replies, inspect tool output and review file diffs in a conversation you can reopen after restarting Orca.
- ⌨️ **Start Pi with your chosen model and thinking level:** The terminal launcher applies your model choice and offers reasoning effort before you send the first prompt.
- 🗂️ **Add projects with fewer steps:** Browse a folder, clone a URL or create a project directly from **Add project**. Switch machines inside the menu; from **New worktree**, it starts with your selected **Run on** host.

## Highlights

- **Keep conversations moving:** Usage-limit **Hand Off to Another Agent** includes the full saved conversation. Generated images stay beside the final answer, and closing a window with a replying chat uses the running-work confirmation. Answer worker permission prompts from the coordinator, with pending requests above the composer and receipts in conversation order.
- **Browse, review and open files:** Extensions are enabled by default in **Settings → Browser**. Git Graph reduces repeated work while scrolling and paging; idle editors stop polling copy hints. Unsupported document tabs offer **Open with default app**, downloading a copy first for SSH or paired-host files.
- **Switch Claude accounts remotely:** Under **Ask**, a phone or CLI switch resumes terminal sessions on the selected account without a desktop dialog. Busy sessions finish their turn first; **Never restart** still keeps them as they are.
- **Read clearer phone code and history:** Phone pages gain syntax colours, pinned diff gutters and PR-state icons. Session History finds compressed Codex archives, OMP profiles and larger OpenCode 2 sessions.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Copilot Chat:** Requires Copilot CLI **1.0.88+** and sign-in. Models appear after starting; plans without a model choice use **Auto**. Session History import into Chat is not supported yet. Avoid switching a chat’s session to allow-all in an external terminal: that permission setting persists when reopened, even if Orca shows **Ask**.
- **Phone updates:** The desktop supplies updated phone web pages; it does not replace the installed native app. New native iOS builds from this source require **iOS 16.4+**. If a tab says **Update mobile**, update the phone app and reconnect.

## What's Changed

### Workspaces, performance & desktop UI

*Large-profile saves, workspace startup, project admission, localization and desktop layout changes.*

* perf(persistence): window moves and UI edits no longer re-save the whole profile by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40627
* Avoid repeated repository hydration during large workspace startup by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41088
* Avoid sorting all folders when resolving one workspace host by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41248
* fix(activity): keep quiet agents with an open terminal listed as No recent update by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40952
* style(menus): roomier rows, lighter icons, solid surface by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40000
* style(new-workspace): icon-only Create From tabs and shorter Create button by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41036
* style(onboarding): compact icon-only Color mode picker and shorter copy by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41079
* fix(sidebar): persist activity bar position across restarts by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40891
* fix(window): restore native fullscreen after a restart by @yohangwak in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40540
* fix(tab-group): keep a window-drag handle when tabs fill the strip by @mousepotato03 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33988
* fix(workspace): name the GitHub link when it cannot be resolved by @BeamNawapat in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24465
* fix(renderer): preserve Windows paths with spaced folders by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24809
* fix(computer-use): only SW_RESTORE minimized windows on Windows by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41253
* fix(settings): flatten Worktree hooks into rows inside one card by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40976
* fix(worktrees): prevent overtaken worktree scans from pruning mid-scan lineage by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41284
* feat: combine localization and status-bar formatting by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40456
* Run local usage services in a supervised backend process by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40792
* feat(project-admission): open menu-first Add project flow with synced host header by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41303

### Chat UI & session history

*Conversation startup, image placement, full-history handoffs and session discovery fixes.*

* fix(chat): show an image sent mid-turn in place instead of stuck under Claude's reply by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40975
* fix(native-chat): show when a Codex usage limit resets, like Claude by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40992
* fix(native-chat): let the first chat in a new worktree send and pick models while it starts by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40912
* fix(native-chat): show session skill argument hints in the picker by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40788
* fix(native-chat): open or reveal folder links, labeled "Open folder", instead of doing nothing by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41040
* fix(session-history): discover OMP profile session dirs by @duck1eee in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40264
* fix(session-history): index Codex rollouts archived as .jsonl.zst by @Aboysky in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40593
* fix(native-chat): show Claude/Codex startup dialogs as a chat card and lock Send while one is up by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41083
* fix(native-chat): usage-limit Hand Off gives the new agent the chat's full history by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41096
* fix(ai-vault): index OpenCode 2 sessions with large saved tool data instead of skipping them by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41101
* fix(ai-vault): show the recorded folder workspace on session history chips by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41053
* Keep agent details when chat startup fails by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40901
* fix(ai-vault): Session History Hand Off gives OpenCode chats their full history by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41236
* fix(chat): keep generated images visible with the final answer by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40935
* fix: warn before closing a window with a busy native chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40953
* fix(native-chat): lower unframed single-line paste threshold to 512 bytes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41280
* fix(ai-vault): show renamed terminal tab title in Session History on matching host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41281
* fix(native-chat): infer interrupt after acknowledged Escape on chat Stop by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41285
* fix(native-chat): hide sent [Image #N] prompt markers in user messages by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41288
* Refresh cached chat titles only when their saved inputs change by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41242
* fix(native-chat): refuse a startup card choice when the terminal highlight moved, and add the multi-server MCP card by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41216
* fix(native-chat): hold an automatic continue until the chat's account has usage again by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40412
* fix(native-chat): import Claude auth env vars from their moved module by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41312
* fix(native-chat): repair Claude auth environment owner import by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41310

### Agents, models & accounts

*Copilot Chat, model choices, account usage and agent-specific launch and status fixes.*

* fix(agent-status): show each OpenCode tab's own session, not every busy session in its folder by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41002
* fix(pi): start Pi terminal launches on the model picked in the launcher by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41005
* feat(pi): offer a thinking level for Pi terminal launches by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41006
* fix(agent-status): stop Cursor's tab and sidebar title flickering while it works by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40996
* fix(agent-status): a skipped Codex async question no longer stays pending by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41013
* fix(kiro): keep the Kiro session when kiro-cli reports status over OSC 7501 by @LDH1103 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40568
* fix(cursor): list your account's Cursor models in the agent launch picker by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41046
* fix(agent-status): skipping a Codex async question clears it on SSH panes too by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41031
* fix(claude-accounts): restart sessions after a phone or CLI account switch instead of asking on the desktop by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41064
* fix(agents): point DeepSeek Harness install link at the dsh-TUI it launches by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41069
* fix(kimi): start Full access in Never Ask mode (--auto) instead of --yolo by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41080
* fix(agents): deliver new-workspace prompts to dsh-TUI 0.19, which runs as dsh-tui by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41086
* fix(agent): match AGY acronym to Antigravity in new worktree and new tab by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41128
* fix(droid): stop installing the unsupported PermissionRequest hook by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40612
* fix(opencode): send the first prompt on OpenCode 2.0.13 to 2.0.18 by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41109
* Settings and launch menus list your account models by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40175
* fix(usage): stop Orca usage totals dropping when a worktree is deleted by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41218
* fix(cursor): list your account's Cursor models in the Settings default-model menu by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41219
* fix(jcode): keep the Jcode agent row and show its turn on Linux by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41103
* fix(omp): resume a profile's history session under that profile by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41221
* fix(jcode): keep swarm helpers' hooks off the main agent's row
