items.sourceText:
## New Features

- The opt-in terminal workspace supports multiple side-chat tabs. Switch between them with the keyboard or mouse, and reopen saved local side chats after restarting Codex. (#59784, #60152, #60181)
- Search older tasks from the agent command center by name, prompt preview, or working directory. (#60286)
- Turn on **Collapse turn details** in the full-screen transcript to fold completed activity beneath each prompt while keeping answers visible and tool output searchable. (#60554, #60555, #60556, #60557)
- Add or edit custom model providers from the terminal. With custom gateway onboarding enabled, you can create a provider during sign-in and use a device code for supported gateways over SSH or without a local browser. (#59779, #60009, #60186, #60486, #60662)
- Press `Ctrl+S` in the terminal report editor to save a diagnostic ZIP locally, even when uploads are disabled. (#60542)
- With the opt-in Cloud connection on macOS and Linux, send images, choose a model and reasoning effort, and archive or restore Cloud conversations from the terminal. (#59828, #60061, #60635, #60651)

## Bug Fixes

- `codex exec` keeps project configuration and MCP servers disabled in untrusted directories, even with `--sandbox workspace-write`. Use `--trust` with `codex exec` or `codex review` to explicitly save project trust. (#60041)
- **Yes, clear context and implement** now hands the full approved plan to the fresh session and keeps the current session open if the handoff fails. (#60763)
- Fixed Windows sandbox handling for quoted `cmd.exe` paths and for PowerShell sessions whose working directory has an unreadable parent. (#60624, #60647)
- Pasted images on macOS retain their intended orientation and use native PNG or JPEG clipboard data when available. (#60455)
- The terminal no longer stays busy waiting for MCP servers that a shared app server did not report. (#60280, #60622)
- Interrupted turns now close cleanly, and delayed aborts or file approval cancellations no longer interrupt a later turn. (#59910, #60700)

## Documentation

- Updated the `openai-docs` skill to focus on Codex and ChatGPT Work questions and first-time API setup, with dedicated guidance for configuring Codex across a team. (#59944, #59949)
- Documented how app-server clients can list models or authorize a gateway for a configured provider without changing the default provider. (#59776, #59819)

## Chores

- Updated bundled SQLite to 3.54 to pick up write-ahead log fixes. (#60432)
- Plugin marketplace upgrades can reuse Git objects already on disk, reducing repeat downloads. (#60528)

## New Features

- Browse model providers under Sessions → Model providers and choose the default for new chats. (#59541, #59722)
- Enable `features.tui_workspace` to view a side conversation beside the main chat. Drag the divider to resize the panes or press `leader z` to zoom the focused pane. (#58992, #59527, #59595)
- Attach recordings when using an audio-capable model. Codex skips confirmed rejected recordings on later turns and uses clip duration to keep more short recordings in context. (#59234, #59268)
- Enable `features.image_generation_animation` to generate or edit animated GIFs with optional frame count and timing controls. (#59073)
- Fullscreen Codex displays image previews and pets in tmux on Ghostty and Kitty with `allow-passthrough all`. (#59579, #59580)
- Set `tui.notification_method = "osc777"` for terminal notifications. Approval notifications show longer command previews and distinguish terminal input from network access requests. (#59256)

## Bug Fixes

- Local TUI history and resume pickers filter newly created threads by the signed-in ChatGPT account. (#58918)
- Open and resumed chats use their saved model provider after you change the default for new chats. (#59503)
- The TUI renders replies interrupted by tool calls as a single Markdown message and restores reasoning summaries when replaying a conversation. (#59698, #59700)
- Steering messages reach running turns when sent during the final transcript save or after switching back to a long-running chat. (#58877, #58998)
- Fuzzy file search gives filename matches more weight so matching parent directories are less likely to crowd them out. (#59709)
- Idle local MCP servers on Windows leave filesystem I/O available to the rest of Codex. (#59726)

## Documentation

- The app-server reference covers listing model providers, creating custom gateways, and updating gateway, Bedrock, and GCP settings. (#58845, #58876)

## Chores

- Codex warns when `features.multi_agent` is explicitly configured and points to `agents.enabled` for disabling subagent tools. (#59479)
- Contributors can run Bazel CI jobs locally without BuildBuddy credentials. (#59055)

details.workflow: 空の検証フォルダで、許可した操作と確認・拒否されるべき操作を一つずつ実行し、ダイアログと実行結果を比較する。対象は「Codex rust-v0.168.0：公式リリース」。この更新が必要な操作に影響するかを切り分けるための提案です。

公式ノートの対象バージョンに切り替え、同じ依頼を再実行する。成功可否・手直し回数・出力差分を記録する。
details.benefit: この作業で再現した場合に限り、やり直しや手動確認が減る可能性があります。速度・品質の改善率は測定していません。
details.environment: プラン・地域・アプリ/CLIの対応条件は公式ページで確認が必要です。
details.limitations: ChatGPT Plus / Claude Pro / Google AI Proの契約からAPI利用権や他製品の機能を推定しません。CLI・アプリ・Webの提供差に注意してください。

items.sourceText: New Features The opt-in terminal workspace supports multiple side-chat tabs. Switch between them with the keyboard or mouse, and reopen saved local side chats after restarting Codex. ( #59784 , #60152 , #60181 ) Search older tasks from the agent command center by name, prompt preview, or working directory. ( #60286 ) Turn on Collapse turn details in the full-screen transcript to fold completed activity beneath each prompt while keeping answers visible and tool output searchable. ( #60554 , #60555 , #60556 , #60557 ) Add or edit custom model providers from the terminal. With custom gateway onboarding enabled, you can create a provider during sign-in and use a device code for supported gateways over SSH or without a local browser. ( #59779 , #60009 , #60186 , #60486 , #60662 ) Press Ctrl+S in the terminal report editor to save a diagnostic ZIP locally, even when uploads are disabled. ( #60542 ) With the opt-in Cloud connection on macOS and Linux, send images, choose a model and reasoning effort, and archive or restore Cloud conversations from the terminal. ( #59828 , #60061 , #60635 , #60651 ) Bug Fixes codex exec keeps project configuration and MCP servers disabled in untrusted directories, even with --sandbox workspace-write . Use --trust with codex exec or codex review to explicitly save project trust. ( #60041 ) Yes, clear context and implement now hands the full approved plan to the fresh session and keeps the current session open if the handoff fails. ( #60763 ) Fixed Windows sandbox handling for quoted cmd.exe paths and for PowerShell sessions whose working directory has an unreadable parent. ( #60624 , #60647 ) Pasted images on macOS retain their intended orientation and use native PNG or JPEG clipboard data when available. ( #60455 ) The terminal no longer stays busy waiting for MCP servers that a shared app server did not report. ( #60280 , #60622 ) Interrupted turns now close cleanly, and delayed aborts or file approval cancellations no longer interrupt a later turn. ( #59910 , #60700 ) Documentation Updated the openai-docs skill to focus on Codex and ChatGPT Work questions and first-time API setup, with dedicated guidance for configuring Codex across a team. ( #59944 , #59949 ) Documented how app-server clients can list models or authorize a gateway for a configured provider without changing the default provider. ( #59776 , #59819 ) Chores Updated bundled SQLite to 3.54 to pick up write-ahead log fixes. ( #60432 ) Plugin marketplace upgrades can reuse Git objects already on disk, reducing repeat downloads. items.sourceText: New Features Browse model providers under Sessions → Model providers and choose the default for new chats. ( #59541 , #59722 ) Enable features.tui_workspace to view a side conversation beside the main chat. Drag the divider to resize the panes or press leader z to zoom the focused pane. ( #58992 , #59527 , #59595 ) Attach recordings when using an audio-capable model. Codex skips confirmed rejected recordings on later turns and uses clip duration to keep more short recordings in context. ( #59234 , #59268 ) Enable features.image_generation_animation to generate or edit animated GIFs with optional frame count and timing controls. ( #59073 ) Fullscreen Codex displays image previews and pets in tmux on Ghostty and Kitty with allow-passthrough all . ( #59579 , #59580 ) Set tui.notification_method = "osc777" for terminal notifications. Approval notifications show longer command previews and distinguish terminal input from network access requests. ( #59256 ) Bug Fixes Local TUI history and resume pickers filter newly created threads by the signed-in ChatGPT account. ( #58918 ) Open and resumed chats use their saved model provider after you change the default for new chats. ( #59503 ) The TUI renders replies interrupted by tool calls as a single Markdown message and restores reasoning summaries when replaying a conversation. ( #59698 , #59700 ) Steering messages reach running turns when sent during the final transcript save or after switching back to a long-running chat. ( #58877 , #58998 ) Fuzzy file search gives filename matches more weight so matching parent directories are less likely to crowd them out. ( #59709 ) Idle local MCP servers on Windows leave filesystem I/O available to the rest of Codex. ( #59726 ) Documentation The app-server reference covers listing model providers, creating custom gateways, and updating gateway, Bedrock, and GCP settings. ( #58845 , #58876 ) Chores Codex warns when features.multi_agent is explicitly configured and points to agents.enabled for disabling subagent tools. ( #59479 ) Contributors can run Bazel CI jobs locally without BuildBuddy credentials. items.sourceText:
## What's Changed
* Stop the Computer Use driver after the agent service at quit by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7167
* Fail passkey requests at once in the macOS built-in browser by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7191
* Stop the Windows agent dock from slowing the whole computer by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7197
* Keep agent browser pages drawn on Linux while the main window is hidden by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7202
* Let a person's request use person-only tools while teammate answers wait by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7207
* Keep agents from opening OpenBot issues outside the issue form by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7208
* Show the answer after the messages that waited for a usage limit by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7200
* Do not draw the Computer Use rim on a window the agent does not use by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7214
* Tell agents that sidebar folders can hold folders by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7227
* Start a sleeping hosted server when a webhook routine gets a delivery by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7232
* Keep the browser on the next page when the current page still loads by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7243
* Show the thinking of Codex agents by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7242
* Give Claude agents the tools of an MCP app right after its API key by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7247
* Show an error when Grok ends a turn with a blank answer by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7248
* Show the agent the fields of each ask_ui card type by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7269

items.sourceText:
**Previous release: [1.4.256](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.256)** — Easier on-device dictation setup and earlier long-chat performance improvements.

## Smoother long chats, saved feedback and better dictation ✨

Orca 1.4.257 reduces freezes when several long Chat UI conversations stream at once. If you keep multiple agents working in conversations with a lot of history, this update cuts the work Orca does as their replies arrive.

- 🌐 **Keep your browser feedback across restarts:** Unsent text notes on pages in Orca’s browser now return after a reload or restart. Closing a tab with unsent notes asks before discarding them, so you can leave feedback and come back to it later. Agents running on your desktop can read those notes with `orca tab annotations` before you press Send.
- 🎙️ **Give yourself time to think while dictating:** In **Settings → Voice → Input → Stop After Silence**, choose 30 seconds, one minute, two minutes or Off. Dictation can wait through a longer pause while you compose a message or terminal command. The same settings page adds a **Test** button to record and play back your microphone, with a transcript when your speech model is ready.
- ⌨️ **Paste while a terminal connects:** A command pasted into a starting or reconnecting terminal now waits for its shell instead of being dropped. This covers local, SSH and remote terminals for pastes up to 64 KB; larger pastes still need a connected terminal.
- 🗂️ **Automate folder workspace routines:** Configured setup scripts now run when you create a folder workspace, including through the CLI. Archive scripts run before removal. Use them to prepare the project and run its cleanup routine; these scripts operate in the shared project folder.

## Highlights

- **Find what belongs in a split pane:** Press `/` in an empty split pane to search for an agent or file. Use the arrow keys and Enter to open your selection without leaving the keyboard.
- **Keep your chosen Claude model:** The Chat UI picker keeps your latest selection when replies from an earlier turn arrive, rather than snapping back to their model.
- **See the images you asked Codex to make:** Generated images remain visible after a turn finishes, without expanding its tool details. For remote chats, update both the host and client to get this behavior.

---

## What's Changed

### Native chat & agents

*Keep long chats moving, preserve model choices and make chat results easier to find.*

* fix(native-chat): Continue in Chat UI on an unsent Claude fork brings back the chat it came from by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40551
* fix(claude): keep a model picked mid-turn over that turn's later replies by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40546
* fix(native-chat): scale chat tables with the text size setting by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40396
* Keep chat navigation focused on human messages by @gentslava in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33403
* fix(native-chat): highlight the slash item whose name best matches the typed query by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40487
* fix(native-chat): keep the gap under response actions when a left-side item follows by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40639
* fix(chat): show actions on latest reply by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40668
* fix(native-chat): preview issue links that are pull requests by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40674
* fix(native-chat): end chat streams that stop delivering instead of leaving them silent by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40691
* Keep Claude chat identity native-only and enforce its launch boundary by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40548
* fix(chat): show readable Cloud Code Assist error messages by @mancunianez in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40765
* fix(native-chat): stop main freezing when many large chats stream at once by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40874
* fix(native-chat): keep Codex generated images visible after the turn finishes by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40893
* fix(native-chat): show Codex's model list when the Codex command points at a file in the project by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40897
* fix(codex): stop native chat running Orca's Codex status hooks, which fail on Windows with Store PowerShell by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40904
* fix(chat): apply window material to Chat UI backgrounds by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40535
* fix(native-chat): browser run's Show button opens its own chat's page, not another agent's by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40910
* Keep Chat UI model selections from snapping back to older replies by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40906

### Agents & accounts

*Improve model discovery, account refresh, launch readiness and agent status.*

* fix(agent-picker): preserve model discovery across queued waits by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40545
* Fix false Codex worker readiness after startup by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40246
* fix(claude): keep each account's newest groveChoiceSeenAt during profile state sync by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40381
* Fix account usage reset display by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40613
* fix(agent-status): accept OpenCode 2 hooks after OSC reports opencode by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40759
* fix(agent-status): keep a finished Codex turn done while its background terminal runs by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40839
* fix(cloud-auth): keep users signed in through transient auth errors by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40837
* fix(cloud): send the refresh token as proof when creating a linked cloud profile by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40713
* fix(codex): deliver handoffs when Codex's status line paints nothing by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40888
* fix(acp): retry OpenCode's model list when session/new fails while providers are opening by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40894
* fix(claude): preserve each account's runtime state during refresh by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40558
* fix(claude): only offer theme sync when Claude Code CLI runs in a terminal by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40916
* fix(omp): show the picked model's own thinking levels before the first chat message by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40933
* Remove the per-repo agent folder trust prompt by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40934
* fix(droid): keep the mission's session as the tab's resume target when sub-droids report by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40947
* fix(settings): list the host's models in agent settings by @qq2144 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38764

### Dictation & voice

*Test microphone input, choose the silence timeout and organize Voice settings.*

* feat(settings): test the microphone in Voice settings and see what the model heard by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40493
* feat(dictation): choose how long silence lasts before dictation stops by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40530
* feat(settings): group Voice settings like the other panes, with setup states in their own rows by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40652
* feat(dictation): offer the speech model update in the dictation pill by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40686

### Phone & paired devices

*Improve phone workspace history, downloads, previews and paired workspace updates. Phone app changes require the corresponding phone update.*

* Create a worktree per repository from an empty folder workspace on the phone by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40139
* Show a Fast-only speed as the Fast mode switch on mobile by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40523
* feat(mobile): show working agents on Feed in an Active section by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40587
* fix(mobile): show the bytes that cross the wire on the download screen by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40594
* perf(mobile): let newer phones fetch their language catalog from the desktop instead of downloading all of them by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40519
* fix(mobile): only subscribe to window focus/blur AppState events on Android by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40615
* Show phone option previews as thumbnails with a full-height viewer by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40569
* Update paired workspace snapshots without copying unrelated records by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40553
* fix(mobile): show and resume a server workspace's own session history by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40829
* fix(mobile): serve the phone page after a Linux package update replaces a running Orca by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40863
* fix(mobile): save the downloaded desktop page on Android 7 by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40878
* fix(mobile): say which WebView to install when Android's is too old to open a workspace by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40907

### Terminals & performance

*Keep startup pastes, improve terminal ownership and reduce repeated work during agent and workspace updates.*

* perf(activity): reuse tab indexes across agent status updates by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40536
* perf: avoid unused workspace reference work on store updates by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40554
* perf(daemon): stop scanning launched agents' output for command-finished by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40599
* fix(terminal): scope parking and output coverage to each workspace by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40331
* fix(daemon): gate reportFocusLost by daemon protocol and bump to v56 by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/39821

items.sourceText:
## What's Changed
* Select subagent models by task in the release skill by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7121
* Report if a message from an agent steered the running turn by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7112
* Hide the driver's cursor tools from Computer Use agents by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7123
* Stop sending a bot User-Agent from the MCP sign-in proxy by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7153
* Accept zip files with no Unix type so Gemini installs on Windows by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7161
* Prepare the v0.67.1 release by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/7168


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/compare/v0.67.0...v0.67.1

items.title: OpenBot v0.67.0：公式リリース
items.summary: 主な話題：安全性・権限管理、MCP・外部連携、エージェントの作業・設定。キーワードに基づく日本語の暫定分類です。具体的な変更内容と提供条件は公式原文で確認してください。
items.why: MacとWindowsのAIエージェントに作業を委任する際の安全性に関わるため、優先して確認する価値があります。
items.try: 検証用リポジトリで現在の設定をバックアップし、権限・サンドボックス動作を更新前後で比較してください。
items.availability: プラン・地域・アプリ/CLIの対応条件は公式ページで確認が必要です。
items.sourceText:
## What's Changed
* build(nix): install OpenBot 0.66.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5980
* Add OpenBot as a co-author of agent git commits by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5981
* Keep agent browser pages drawn while the Windows window is minimized or hidden by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6009
* Tell Muse users why Muse has no models or refuses a model by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6001
* Detect AWS WAF only on its interstitial page by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6020
* Keep the sidebar folder name when the window loses focus by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6048
* Read Pi history on a short process without MCP servers by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6043
* Show the Dynamic Island on the primary display when no display is built-in by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6030
* Let joined servers delete history and reset channel context by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6052
* Keep OpenBot open when a macOS update cannot install from a read-only location by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6038
* Show a white switch knob in light mode in Settings by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6035
* Return refused channel tool calls to the agent with the reason by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6057
* Name OpenBot Codex threads in the Codex app list by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6068
* Keep Claude sign-in settings in workflow conditions and other calls without tools by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6072
* Continue stopped work on the model the agent left when its limit ended by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6078
* Fill saved authenticator codes into code fields with no one-time-code mark by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6092
* Stop full sidebar restyles while the agent list scrolls by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6098
* Open large groups from remote clients: send only the tasks a page needs by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6099
* Tell the requesting agent when a teammate turn ends with no result by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6101
* Show your own messages as yours in the agent dock chat by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6087
* Tell the agent why list_models has no models for a provider by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6116
* Show a new model version in the picker before the model catalog has it by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6115
* Continue a stopped subtask when a channel message says "continue" by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6114
* Show a plain message when Grok ends a turn with only reasoning by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6124
* Play the next spoken reply without a pause in voice conversations by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6125
* Tell why an app does not connect on a joined server by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6127
* Show all Kiro models after a cold start by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6143
* Show the MCP Sign in card when a server lists its tools without a sign-in by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6148
* Show the agent dock and the Dynamic Island on Linux by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6145
* Give agents from another computer a workspace on this computer by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6153
* Add a server on another computer with one command by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6174
* Fix the Android release build: let R8 continue without Dav1dDecoder$Natives by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6210
* Add fast mode for Claude agents by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6261
* Measure the storage of a hosted server against its plan by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6264
* Let agents choose a model that only their provider account serves by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6483
* Fail a WhatsApp post that the server refuses by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6484
* Do not make a deleted agent again when a teammate answers it by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6487
* Open the API key form again for a key that the Vault has by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6490
* Answer byte ranges for chat attachments so videos play to the end by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6492
* Tell agents when GitHub hides a private repository from the OpenBot app by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6502
* Remove the broken earlier copy that a Windows reinstall leaves in the default folder by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6512
* Keep each skill of an agent import when two skill names give the same slug by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6511
* Mark the mobile app 1.4.8 available on Android, and turn on its cloud servers and browser flags by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6527
* Do not give a teammate request from an external chat to a channel by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6515
* Keep the voice reply when a sound with no words interrupts it by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6521
* Keep a routine run at its start in the main chat by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6496
* Use localhost for an MCP sign-in again after the browser did not come back by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6519
* Show MCP confirmation requests to Claude agents by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6536
* Run a changed step again when a workflow run starts after it by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6538
* Count only the agent's chat in its sidebar number by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5993
* Discard a Hermes lost turn so the agent answers again by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6542
* Count the browser tab limit per chat, as the agent sees its tabs by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6541
* Keep a channel with instructions over 2,000 characters working by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6549

items.sourceText:
## Smoother performance, easier dictation, saved phone drafts & clearer workspace controls ✨

Long chats stay more responsive while agents stream tool output, reasoning and subagent work, with less background processing during terminal and tab updates. This update also makes dictation easier to set up and use and makes agents and cloud workspaces easier to manage. Phone-specific improvements below require the matching phone app update.

- 🎙️ **Dictate with less setup:** Voice settings suggests an on-device model for your language and offers one setup button. Add personal or repository vocabulary, remove filler words, and use Auto mode to hold the shortcut or tap to toggle. On-device dictation inserts phrases as you pause, and you can dictate into fields in Orca's browser.
- 📱 **Pick up where you left off:** Chats show their saved recent messages after a phone relaunch while reconnecting. Commit messages, PR descriptions, comments, review notes, tasks and new-workspace drafts survive closing the app.
- ⌨️ **More control from your phone:** The terminal key row gains Shift, Ctrl and Alt latches and an optional Smart rail with agent actions. A floating dictation pill lets you keep speaking while moving to another screen in the app.
- 🤖 **Get agents ready from chat:** Supported missing agents offer installation and sign-in guidance where you start a chat. OpenCode subagents appear in their own cards and keep their chat active while they work; Codex replies can be forked after a rewind.
- 🧭 **Find the controls you need:** The browser groups its tools into an Annotate button and one menu. Settings is easier to scan, and recipe-backed VM workspaces show their lifecycle with Suspend and Resume actions.

## Highlights

- **Voice & dictation:** Speech-model updates are offered in the dictation pill when you start dictating, with download progress, cancellation and retry. Language-based setup suggestions, model quality information, a Use GPU switch, personal and repository vocabulary, and support for OpenAI-compatible transcription services. The dictation pill shows committed and pending words; failed recordings can be retried. Pressing Send or Enter while dictating waits for the words before sending.
- **Phone & recovery:** Saved chat messages and draft text return after a relaunch. Home opens with last-known workspaces, visited terminals stay mounted for quicker switching, and page assets load on demand. Folder workspaces have Source Control on the phone, and large-file diffs retain unchanged lines.
- **Chat & agents:** Copy and other reply actions stay visible on the latest response, while older replies reveal them on hover or keyboard focus. Account usage shows Used, Left and time until reset. Claude chat names use the CLI's titles, questions can show option previews, Codex failures give actionable advice, and a New divider is available in Settings. Usage-limited chats that are due can continue in one pass, with automatic retries stopping after five consecutive failures.
- **Workspaces & remote hosts:** Setup-script import understands more existing repository configurations. VM workspaces show creation progress and failures, and suspended VMs can be resumed from their workspace controls. Paired-server connection failures are detected when the host stops answering.
- **Browser, editor & everyday fixes:** Browser annotation, drawing and element capture share one control, with zoom and viewport state in the address field. Inline or side-by-side diff choice is saved. Linear search and issue lists include the project, and agent speed menus offer the speeds supported by the selected model.

**Dictation upgrade note:** Existing local speech-model downloads may need an update before dictation works again. Complete the download from the dictation pill or Voice settings before relying on dictation offline.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.255...v1.4.256

---

items.sourceText:
## Security fixes

v2.4.0 fixes six vulnerabilities in three servers. Upgrade `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` to 2.3.0,
and `mcp-server-git` and `mcp-server-fetch` to 2026.11.11.

| Package | Affected | Fixed in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` | all versions before 2.3.0, and date versions 2025.1.14 through 2026.8.31 | 2.3.0 |
| `mcp-server-git` | through 2026.11.4 | 2026.11.11 |
| `mcp-server-fetch` | through 2026.11.4 | 2026.11.11 |

### `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` 2.3.0

* **Reads stay with the file that was checked** (Linux and macOS). The read tools and file resources now open a file relative to the directory that was checked, as writes already did, so a directory swapped for a symlink between the access check and the read can no longer return a file from outside the allowed directories. A FIFO, socket or device is refused rather than read. **On Windows this narrows the race without closing it**, as for writes (#5260) ([GHSA-p9cv-8g75-4xcg](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-p9cv-8g75-4xcg))
* **`move_file` moves only the source it checked.** A move within one device first takes the source out of its own checked directory under a fresh name, so a source directory swapped for a symlink can no longer bring an outside file into the allowed directories, where it would become readable ([GHSA-7m4x-rv66-mxhh](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-7m4x-rv66-mxhh))

### `mcp-server-git` 2026.11.11

* **A repository's own Git configuration can no longer make the server run a program.** A read-only call such as `git_status` on an untrusted repository used to run a command named in its `.git/config` (`core.fsmonitor`, `diff.external`, hooks, filter and merge drivers, signing) with the server's privileges. Every Git command now overrides those settings, and a Git older than 2.31, which would ignore the overrides, is refused ([GHSA-6hqx-gqrx-c5r2](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-6hqx-gqrx-c5r2))
* **`--repository` confinement covers alternate object stores, linked worktrees and links in the Git directory.** A repository inside the allowed one could read another repository's objects through `objects/info/alternates`, or pass a linked worktree's Git directory off as the allowed repository's. Both are refused, as is a symlink in a Git directory that leads outside the allowed repository. **On Windows a directory junction is not yet covered** (#5520) ([GHSA-q74p-4wrc-q7w6](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-q74p-4wrc-q7w6))

### `mcp-server-fetch` 2026.11.11

* **IPv6 site-local addresses are private.** The private-address guard read `fec0::/10` as public. It is now refused, and so is any IPv6 address outside global unicast (`2000::/3`) that does not carry an IPv4 address ([GHSA-3rxj-6jhw-qfv7](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-3rxj-6jhw-qfv7))
* **robots.txt is matched against the path the site will resolve**, as well as the path as written, so `//private` or `/x/../private` can no longer get past `Disallow: /private` ([GHSA-f9hh-cmx9-2f23](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-f9hh-cmx9-2f23))

### Upgrading from a date-versioned npm release

The TypeScript servers moved from date versions (2025.x, 2026.x) to semantic versions in 1.0.0. Package managers rank 2.3.0 below every 2025.x and 2026.x version, so they won't offer it as an upgrade. If you are on a date version of `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem`, install 2.3.0 explicitly: `npm install @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@2.3.0`.

## Packages

| Package | Version | Registry | In this release |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything` | `2.3.0` | npm | **published** |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` | `2.3.0` | npm | **published** |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/server-memory` | `2.1.1` | npm | **published** |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking` | `2.1.1` | npm | unchanged |
| `mcp-server-fetch` | `2026.11.11` | PyPI | **published** |
| `mcp-server-git` | `2026.11.11` | PyPI | **published** |
| `mcp-server-time` | `2026.11.11` | PyPI | **published** |

## What's Changed
* Changelog for v0.67.0-preview.0 by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29990
* Changelog for v0.66.0 by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29992
* docs(readme): clarify Gemini CLI scope, limitations, and tool landscape by @LyalinDotCom in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29995
* fix(cli): bound inline history re-render after terminal width changes by @jvargassanchez-dot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29904
* fix(ui): handle surrogate pairs when truncating in sanitizeForDisplay by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29993
* fix(core): make isWithinRoot case-insensitive on Windows by @duvanka-prasad in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29999
* fix(core): recognize dotted Gemini 3 models in supportsMultimodalFunctionResponse by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29982
* feat(cli): add extension validation command and evaluation tests by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29980
* fix(core): normalize leading slashes in file search query for @ autocomplete by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29987
* fix(vscode-ide-companion): register all extension disposables in context.subscriptions by @jvargassanchez-dot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29994
* fix(core): list Auto in /model when dynamicModelConfiguration is enabled and preview access is disabled by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29998
* fix(core,cli): fix instances of incorrect \n escape behavior by @ugorla-dev in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29989
* fix(core): use PowerShell CIM fallback for Windows IDE process lookup by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30006
* fix(cli): surface 429 rate limit cool-down and countdown in loading indicator by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30012
* fix(cli): anchor .git suffix removal to end of repo URL by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30013
* fix(ci,sdk): run SDK tests in PR CI and fix AgentLoopContext mock in session.test.ts by @duvanka-prasad in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30023
* fix(core): prevent $-pattern corruption in LLM prompt templates by @duvanka-prasad in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30035
* fix(cli): Fixes unexpected truncation and toggle behavior in Expandab… by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29965
* refactor(cli): decouple ToolGroupMessage from internal type guards and payload structures by @ugorla-dev in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30041
* fix(core): gate background log stream initialization on execution lifecycle transition by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30031
* fix(core): honor .git/info/exclude and core.excludesFile in shadow repo by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30034
* fix(core): flush pending SSE event buffer at stream EOF in CodeAssistServer by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30050
* fix(core): handle Windows libuv zero-device stat reporting in readSecureFileBuffer by @jvargassanchez-dot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30044
* fix(cli): serialize concurrent extension installs with per-extension lock (#29036) by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30039
* fix(core): resolve symlinked paths canonically in GlobTool by @ugorla-dev in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30042
* fix(cli): add missing active and focus keys to custom theme ui schema by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30032
* fix(core,cli): preserve selected model across transient fallback, cancel, and rewind by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30059
* fix(core): prevent interrupted Whisper model downloads from being treated as installed by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30058
* fix(cli): handle stream failures during extension release downloads by @duvanka-prasad in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30100
* fix(core): preserve explicit gemini-2.5-flash model in dynamic model resolution by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30057
* fix(hooks): support SubagentStop event mapping and merge hook definitions by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30111
* fix(cli): await history replay before responding to ACP session/load by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30112
* fix(sandbox): supply --userns=keep-id for rootless podman by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30118

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.321：公式リリース
items.summary: 主な話題：不具合修正、モデル対応、エージェントの作業・設定。キーワードに基づく日本語の暫定分類です。具体的な変更内容と提供条件は公式原文で確認してください。
items.why: 現在使っているコーディングエージェントの操作性・信頼性に関わる更新です。MCPやCLIと組み合わせた作業への影響を確認できます。
items.try: 更新版のCLIを検証環境で試し、既存のスキル・設定・MCP接続に影響がないか確認してください。

items.sourceText:
## What's changed

- Added Claude Fable 5.2 (`claude-fable-5-2`), now the default Fable model — 1M context, $8/$40 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads
- Added `--settings <file>` to `claude remote-control`, which applies a settings file to every session it starts; if the file changes, no new session starts until you restart `claude remote-control`
- Fixed MCP OAuth requests sending secrets such as refresh tokens to another host when a server redirected them
- Fixed a case where a read-only Bash command ran outside the sandbox without a permission prompt
- Fixed a case where Bash permission checks judged a file write from the wrong folder and didn't prompt
- Fixed deny rules and protected-file prompts not applying to the file that a `cp` or `mv` into a directory writes
- Fixed the "Draws from usage credits" note showing after a switch to Fable on Enterprise seats whose plan includes Fable
- Fixed the fallback model sometimes declining a request or mentioning a stopped response when the first model was blocked before replying
- Fixed `claude mcp login` printing a SEP-2352 issuer warning each time you sign in again to a server that Claude Code registered with
- Fixed `NotebookEdit` deleting or overwriting a notebook's first cell when the call named no cell, on network paths (UNC shares, WSL folders, `/net` mounts)
- Fixed Edit changing the first of several matches, replacing a whole file on an empty `old_string`, or editing a notebook as text, on network paths (UNC shares, WSL folders, `/net` mounts)
- Fixed `/config` showing Manual as the default permission mode when new sessions start in auto mode; pressing Space on "Auto (default)" now saves Don't Ask, not Plan
- Windows: Fixed `FileChanged` hooks stopping for paths set through `watchPaths` after the first shell command, when the session's working directory had a lowercase drive letter
- Fixed `--plugin-dir .` and `--plugin-dir ./builtin` writing generated type files for Claude Code's built-in plugins into a `builtin` folder
- Fixed context usage estimates overcounting tool definitions when exact token counts are unavailable
- Fixed `/compact` showing twice in Remote Control on web and mobile
- Fixed plugin auto-updates and `/plugin` marketplace updates downloading a plugin again for each worktree or folder of a repository
- Fixed auto mode losing a background subagent's report that had started a turn when the conversation was compacted before Claude answered it
- Fixed project skills, commands and agents staying missing after their folder was removed and came back mid-session, such as with `git stash`, including after entering a worktree
- Fixed `claude -p` sometimes telling Claude that background commands get 30 minutes when they are stopped after 10
- Fixed `pkill`, `pgrep` and `pidwait` in cloud sessions matching the session's own parent processes
- Fixed Claude in Chrome and computer use server processes staying alive after their parent exits behind a proxy that stalls connections
- Fixed a large hook output pointing Claude to a file that held another hook's output from the same tool call
- Fixed apps that embed Claude Code getting their own PreToolUse hook's `ask` reason instead of another hook's when both asked
- Fixed a PreToolUse hook's `ask` being lost when another hook's `defer` finished first and could not be honored
- Fixed a rare crash on permission prompts and background tasks
- Fixed project skills, commands and agents disappearing from the menu in SDK and desktop sessions after Claude entered a worktree
- Fixed `/desktop` on macOS saying Claude Desktop is not installed when it is in `~/Applications`
- Fixed OpenTelemetry repository attributes (`vcs.*`) missing from Claude Desktop sessions that start on a pre-started process
- Fixed WebFetch passing "No response from model" to Claude as page content when the model reading the page returned no text; the call now fails with a clear error
- Fixed screen reader mode delaying the prompt at startup when the system clock moved back while Claude Code was starting
- Fixed a command's panel sometimes not coming back after a dialog closed, leaving no panel or prompt on screen until the next redraw
- Fixed a project's MCP server being disconnected after the first message in a Claude Desktop Code tab session when the desktop app has an MCP server or extension of the same name
- Fixed a turn ending with "API Error: EPROTO: The TLS handshake failed" when the connection broke partway through a reply; the partial reply is kept or the request is retried, as before 2.1.302
- Fixed high memory use in long sessions that repeatedly read single lines from large files
- Fixed fast mode losing replies, switching models or retrying for minutes when fast serving is rate-limited, overloaded or failing; it now tries standard speed on the same model first
- Fixed one request carrying far more background agent reports than intended after Claude was stopped while several were waiting
- Fixed messages from a Claude Desktop Code tab session to your other sessions staying paused after you typed while Claude was still working
- Fixed `claude agents` ignoring `--permission-mode`, `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, `--model`, `--effort` or `--agent` typed before `agents` when a flag such as `--verbose` was also on the line
- Fixed a case where Remote Control showed as off with "login expired" in the desktop app while its connection was still up, because the app was briefly unable to hand over a sign-in token
- Fixed a Remote Control message sent with "Queue for later" reaching Claude in the middle of the running turn
- Fixed the git status given to Claude at session start reading as clean when git status failed; it now reads as unavailable
- Fixed the git status given to Claude at session start showing the first listed file as staged when its changes were not staged
- Fixed a hang or out-of-memory crash when a connector in a cloud session lists resources with very long names
- Fixed Remote Control showing as connected after its connection closed for good while the session's history was still uploading
- Fixed screen reader mode turning off when you return to a conversation from agent view
- Fixed screen reader mode y/n questions taking as yes a stray "y" at the end of text typed as the question opened
- Fixed cloud sessions telling Claude that a host is probably not allowed when it is allowed and the network proxy could not connect to it
- Fixed an MCP server sometimes showing as connected with no tools after it was reconnected or the session's directory changed while its tools were still loading
- Fixed Bash commands sometimes running in the wrong folder when Claude sent several at once and an earlier one changed folders
- Fixed files Claude sends from cloud and Remote Control sessions failing at once when an upload gets an HTTP 507 from a proxy; the upload now gets a second try
- Fixed new messages not being saved, and `claude -p`, SDK and VS Code sessions hanging, when memory ran out while the transcript was being read
- Fixed sign-in, token refresh and logout waiting indefinitely when something on the network accepts the connection but never answers the TLS handshake
- Fixed a sent file showing under a different name in the Claude apps when its name hid text-direction or control characters; Claude now refuses to send such a file
- Fixed sub-agent progress summaries running a request to its end after the model replied with a tool call
- Fixed Bash reads such as `grep -r foo "$PWD/src"` asking for permission when the same command with the path typed out runs without asking
- Fixed Claude apps gateway refusing to start when a `desktop` setting holds a field newer than the gateway, such as a managed MCP server's `oauth.omitResource`; it now warns and serves it
- Fixed Bash commands coming back empty for zsh users whose `.zshrc` sets `KSH_OPTION_PRINT`
- macOS: Fixed "Unable to read managed policy settings" at startup when a valid MDM profile was slow to read: the read is retried once, and a timeout is now reported as a timeout
- Fixed agent view erasing another agent view's saved input text when it restarted for an update with nothing typed
- Fixed remote sessions giving no reply after a restart when a `UserPromptSubmit` hook blocked a replayed permission answer; these hooks no longer run on that replay
- Fixed `claude remote-control` accepting a `y` typed without Enter at its first-run question when the terminal's input ended
- Fixed Claude Desktop not showing spend limit warnings behind a Claude apps gateway whose policy has no `code:` rules
- Fixed fullscreen sessions with some plugins ending with an error when a tool result that had got shorter scrolled off the top of the screen
- Fixed prompt suggestions making extra API requests when the model replied with a tool call
- Fixed `PreToolUse` `mcp_tool` hooks on stdio and HTTP MCP servers being skipped when their answer was over 16 MiB; the tool call is now refused
- Fixed skill and command names holding a Bamum letter that some fonts draw as blank: they are now refused
- Fixed `claude -p` on Linux exiting 0 in silence when a full NFS export or a used-up NFS quota lost transcript lines: it now prints an error and, in text and json output, exits 1
- Fixed background agents being reported as stopped by the user, and refused a resume, when a service interrupted a cloud session and nobody pressed Stop
- Fixed NotebookEdit reporting success to hooks and telemetry when the edit failed, for example when the notebook changed while the permission prompt was open
- Fixed a blank screen or no answer at startup, and empty `claude mcp list` output, when a stored MCP sign-in record was null
- Fixed the Artifact tool telling Claude to add filters when an artifact's database collection is too large to sort; it now says to read the collection page by page and sort the results
- Fixed a restarted cloud session dropping a message with a large image when the restart came before Claude's first reply to it
- Fixed a restarted cloud session leaving a subagent's message to the main conversation unanswered
- Fixed Claude not being told when you stop or pause a running workflow, so it no longer says the workflow is still running
- Improved the `/model` picker: "More models" is now an unnumbered row below every other, and older models open under it without renumbering the rest
- Gateway: Improved spend limits on a busy replica, which now skips fewer checks and records spend sooner
- Improved the Claude apps gateway's sign-in limit messages in Claude Code and on the `/device` page: they no longer name gateway settings, which the gateway's own log still names
- Improved `claude install` and the install scripts: they finish 2 to 4 seconds sooner
- Improved how soon a Remote Control session whose process crashed can pick up a new message
- Windows: Improved startup and first-command time by finding programs on PATH without starting a helper process
- Improved auto mode in headless sessions, the desktop app and VS Code: reports from background subagents that wait together are answered in one model call, as in the terminal
- Improved the agent view's row for a `claude --bg --worktree` session that couldn't set up its worktree: it now shows the error from its beginning, not an internal tag or its last 200 characters
- Improved the messages shown when an artifact is in another organization: `/login` is offered only if it's one of yours, and Claude now says where a copy may be after an account move
- Improved sessions with more images than fit in one request: Claude is told whether it has already seen a dropped image, and repeat reads of an unchanged image are limited
- Improved `claude remote-control`'s messages for an unanswered first-run question: each now says what to do next
- Improved start-up time by loading trusted TLS certificates faster
- Improved Claude apps gateway error messages to show the gateway's address without any user name or password
- Improved the Claud

items.sourceText:
## What's Changed
* build(nix): install OpenBot 0.65.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5697
* Fix "Delete history" of an agent chat by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5702
* Do not show a save error after a color change of a remote agent by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5710
* Follow the macOS 24-hour time setting by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5682
* Let agents reach MCP servers of revision 2026-07-28 through the sign-in proxy by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5723
* Show the What's new notes in the app language by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5725
* Stop false Codex errors and repeated settings errors by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5724
* Do not freeze the window when a settings menu reports its value again by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5727
* Add a record-demo skill and a dev:automation record command by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5716
* Load the home page text for the download hub page by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5733
* Show the provider reason when a Muse or ChatGPT sign-in fails by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5735
* Let workflow outputs post into OpenBot channels by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5572
* Show the icon-only sidebar wait chip as a round badge by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5736
* Keep the start animation on the full window and play it one time by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5739
* Let the mouse wheel move the suggested agents on the New agent page by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5741
* Keep numbers and lists in Kimi tool_call arguments by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5749
* Show the models of the Mistral account in the model picker by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5750
* List only the loopback address in the MCP client metadata document by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5754
* Close a pending question when the user writes in the same chat by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5753
* Show the Gemini service message when a proxy returns an HTTP status line by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5760
* Start a new agent with its own welcome question by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5773
* Show the whole update ring before a restart, and for an automatic download by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5774
* Add a search field to the agent menu of the Tasks composer by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5779
* Make the task panel resizable, and add voice to its message box by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5780
* Keep OpenBot's tools in a Cursor chat that OpenBot reads after a restart by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5781
* Let agents send bug reports and ideas to the OpenBot team by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5785
* Make channels feel like chats and run channel turns beside the own chat by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5790
* Send a Codex MCP server under its own key when the user's Codex file has the name by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5791
* Show a pasted file in a sent message without an extra "@" by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5792
* Add a color split, an edge bend and lit borders to the theme ring by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5793
* Do not count agent messages in side threads as unread by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5797
* Call the Settings page "Your settings", and add a search to server settings by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5799
* Connect Composio with a sign-in, and keep the API key as a second way in by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5798
* Send a result for each request that joins a running turn by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5809
* Do not stop the main process when another browser tab has a crashed page by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5813
* Name the workspace skills of a Codex agent in its instructions by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5816
* Show email addresses to the agent in its memories and history by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5826
* Show the reason that ElevenLabs gives when it refuses a key or a voice by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5850

items.sourceText:
# Hermes Agent v0.23.1

**Release Date:** November 9, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~618 PRs merged since v0.23.0 into a stable release for the GitHub release (CLI and installers), the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.24.0.

**What this patch ships for plugin users:** since the plugin catalog's site deploy on November 9, the published `plugin-catalog.json` was larger than the 2 MiB cap clients accept, so every install silently fell back to the catalog it shipped with. `hermes plugins install <name>` could not find plugins added since your last update, installed the pin your release shipped instead of the current one, and missed newer `removed` entries. This release raises the cap to 16 MiB, so the live catalog is used again ([#151860](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/151860), fixes [#151856](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/issues/151856), thanks @100yenadmin). Installs that stay on v0.23.0 or older keep falling back until they update.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## About this release

Measured at commit `3b421578588`, the window since v0.23.0 contains **2,578 non-merge commits** across **2,781 changed files** (+151,690 / −62,595), **618 merged PRs** and **409 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: Esc backtrack in the TUI and classic CLI (replacing the rewind list picker), group chats that run on a gateway without Desktop and can seat bots from other computers, saved gateway connections shared by Desktop and the Webapp, signing the in-app browser in with your real browser profile and filling saved logins from its address bar, `hermes gateway attach` for local clients, `hermes clipboard image --json`, new plugin API (session-scoped environment values, plugin JSON-RPC methods and events, `llm.oneshot` auxiliary tasks, a compression-stable `conversation_id`, an `on_session_open` hook in the gateway, a `post_curator_run` hook), faster transcript and handoff reads, and a large batch of new plugin-catalog entries.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.24.0**, which will document everything from v0.23.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Updating

- Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
- Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: [v0.23.0...v0.23.1](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v0.23.0...v0.23.1)

## Git Graph, on-phone dictation & side questions in chat ✨

- 🌳 **See the whole repository:** A new Git Graph tab shows local and remote branches and tags, with each commit's details and changed files. Folder workspaces now get Source Control, with a card for each attached repo, and the branch name in Source Control switches or creates a branch in place.
- 💬 **Ask without derailing a chat:** In Chat UI, `/btw` asks a side question in a fork beside the chat while the original keeps running, and `/fork` branches from the latest response. Chats that open or push to a pull request show a short line when its CI passes or fails.
- 🎙️ **Dictate from anywhere:** Phones can turn speech into text on the device (iPhone on iOS 26 or later, and Android), with the computer as fallback. The computer, phones and web client can dictate at the same time, and on-device dictation runs in its own process, so a speech engine crash or hang no longer takes Orca down.
- 📱 **A phone that holds on to your work:** Chat sends queue while the desktop is unreachable and go out in order when it's back. Chat drafts, attachments, unsaved file edits and automation drafts survive the app being killed, and screens reopen from what the phone already has.
- ⌨️ **No more typing lag from Codex accounts:** Typing could lag across Orca while it linked Codex history between accounts. That work no longer blocks the app. Remote terminals also send a lone keystroke right away and read compressed output from remote hosts.
- 🔐 **Safer pairing and trust:** A pairing code stops working once the device that used it saves its own sign-in, desktop and CLI connections to remote servers use the newer encryption, and `orca serve` refuses connections from public internet addresses unless there's a reason to allow them. Orca asks once per new repo before trusting it for agents.
- 🎨 **Make Orca yours:** Import your own app icon, let theme plugins play a looping background video and ship their own fonts, and read Settings in titled cards. Claude Code can match your Orca terminal theme if you say yes.
- 🤖 **Better agent support:** Antigravity chats can run on the host's own agy, including Full access chats, and Muse shows its subscription quota in the status bar.

## Highlights

- **Chat:** `/btw` asks a side question in a fork and `/fork` forks from the latest response, with a spinner while the fork opens. Chats show CI results for the pull requests they opened or pushed to, and every waiting message, command and steer now sits in one ordered queue you can move, delete or send from.
- **Phone:** Send while the desktop is offline, keep drafts, attachments, file edits and automation drafts across app kills, and see the workspace list, session tabs and Review from memory while they refresh. Large folders load 500 entries at a time with Search all, Review prefetches the next and previous file, and a thin line under the header shows when cached data is refreshing.
- **Dictation:** Phones can transcribe on the device, and every device can dictate at once. On desktop the speech model loads before your first dictation (a new setting chooses when to unload it), dictation stops after a minute of silence and keeps what you said, dictated text gets a space before it, and text that can't be inserted is copied instead. The paired web client can dictate through the host.
- **Source control & editor:** Git Graph, Source Control for folder workspaces, and an in-place branch picker in the Source Control header. Wholly new and deleted files show one clean tint, Markdown keeps its syntax colors under plugin themes, HTML previews open in the editor's own tab group, and Copy as PNG says when an image is too large instead of claiming it copied.
- **Agents & accounts:** The Codex account-history typing lag is fixed. Antigravity chats can run on the host's agy when it's signed in, Antigravity sessions in AI Vault can reveal their artifacts folder, and Muse shows its quota and keeps panes working while background subagents run. The new-tab launch menu is simpler, the agent picker finds models from its submenus, and after a restart agents are told to finish the original task.
- **Remote hosts:** Remote terminals respond to keystrokes sooner, desktop chats on remote hosts stream only the new text, and polling slows down while the Orca window is visible but not focused. Managed SSH servers recover after a slow ProxyCommand login and in more dead-server cases, and automations for a managed SSH host go to its own Orca server.
- **Look & feel:** Import a custom app icon, use themed menus and clearer segmented controls, and use web fonts and looping background videos from plugins. Theme plugins can also style chat text and selection, which is now easier to read in dark mode. File and browser tabs fit their titles, so more fit before the tab strip scrolls.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Claude Code theme matching:** Orca can now match Claude Code's theme to your Orca terminal theme. It is off for everyone, including new profiles. The next time Claude Code runs, Orca asks once in a toast. Nothing in `~/.claude/settings.json` changes unless you accept, and you can change it later in Settings › Appearance › Terminal.
- **Search shortcut:** New Mac profiles open search with Cmd+K and have no default shortcut for clearing the terminal. New Windows and Linux profiles use Ctrl+K. Existing profiles keep their shortcuts, including custom and disabled ones.
- **Agent folder trust:** The first time you start an agent in a new repo, Orca asks whether to trust the repo or let each agent ask for itself. Repos you already use keep working as before, with no prompt. You can change the answer in the repo's settings.
- **Single-use pairing codes:** When an updated phone, browser or Orca pairs with an updated desktop, it switches to its own sign-in and the QR code or link it used stops working. Devices on older apps keep working, and Settings marks devices that still use the original pairing code or older encryption so you know which to update.
- **`orca serve` and public addresses:** `orca serve` accepts localhost, LAN and Tailscale connections by default and accepts public internet addresses only when there's a reason to. Existing setups keep connecting.
- **Speech model memory:** With voice on, Orca now loads the on-device speech model ahead of your first dictation. Use the new Unload Speech Model setting in Settings › Voice to free that memory sooner. Desktop dictation now also stops by itself after a minute of silence.
- **Windows terminal font weight:** Terminal text on Windows now uses the font's Regular weight by default instead of Medium, which Windows drew as SemiBold. macOS and Linux are unchanged.
- **New-tab launch menu:** Permissions and Arguments are no longer in the new-tab agent launch menu. They still come from Agent settings.
- **Onboarding:** The Antigravity Install button in onboarding is gone. Antigravity has the same Install instructions link as every other agent.

---

## Faster session search, agents on your phone & smoother chat switching ✨

We shipped two releases in quick succession: 1.4.254 yesterday and 1.4.255 today. See the [1.4.254 release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.254) for Git Graph, chat forks, on-device phone dictation, more resilient mobile work, and pairing and trust improvements.

A little less waiting, a little more flow. This update makes large session histories easier to search, brings your agents together on your phone, and smooths out the everyday work of switching accounts, models and workspaces.

- ⚡ **Find past work without slowing down:** Session History searches run off the app’s main thread, keep results visible while you type, and show your last list immediately after a restart while it refreshes. Search also works on SSH and remote-server hosts.
- 📱 **Your agents, together on your phone:** A new Agents tab lists agents across your connected desktops. Mark them read or clear them from the list, with activity status supplied by the desktop. Saved task lists and host labels appear sooner when you reopen the app.
- 💬 **Keep your chat moving:** Switching Codex accounts moves your open Codex chats to the account you choose. Forks preserve the chat’s history, pasted rich text keeps its links, and queued messages resume after a restart.
- 🎛️ **A clearer way to choose your setup:** Agent speed is now one button, model setup opens with your current choice highlighted, and searching for “codex” puts the Codex agent ahead of other agents’ Codex-named models—including when you press Enter.
- 🌳 **Do more from where you are:** Check out, cherry-pick or revert commits from Git Graph. Open the branch picker directly from the branch name under your chat composer, and choose your next action from a simpler empty split pane.

## Highlights

- **Session History & performance:** Large histories stay responsive while search runs in a worker. Workspace and Project filters query their own sessions, unchanged history rows avoid extra rendering, and search indexing and profile saves do less disk work.
- **Chat & agents:** Open Codex chats follow account switches, newly installed skills appear in Codex’s `$` menu before your first message, and Antigravity Chat shows installed skills. OpenCode 2 starts with the model you picked. Clearing a chat hides the old transcript immediately, and a failed model or effort change affects its message rather than the whole chat.
- **Phone & remote hosts:** The Agents tab brings activity across desktops into one place. Pages open sooner through prewarming, Review refreshes branch comparisons when Git changes, and the file-preview restore bar stays above the keyboard. A stalled LAN reconnect can fall back to Relay, and resumed VMs keep their device pairing when the host key is unchanged.
- **Workspaces & source control:** Git Graph gains checkout, cherry-pick and revert actions. You can preserve eligible child workspaces when deleting a parent, create a worktree for each repository from an empty folder workspace, and clone into a separate folder when a repository name is already taken. The sidebar divider resizes the sidebar reliably.
- **Browser, editor & terminal:** Remote browser tabs show site favicons, website links open in new tabs, and the CLI can list and reload installed browser extensions. PDFs fit the preview pane’s width. Terminal panes explain when another window is holding their size and offer a way to undo it.
- **Everyday polish:** Long Settings lists use searchable pickers, older chat messages show dates, and live agents stay visible in the unread filter. This release also fixes stale browser, Linear toolbar and usage-tooltip displays, plus the first Enter keypress after turning off Japanese IME.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.254...v1.4.255
