items.sourceText:
## What's Changed
* Fix races in implicit state machines by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5349
* Open files that a chat message names on mobile by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5356
* Keep no server rail space in a chat window by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5360
* Manage browser profile proxies in the mobile app by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5342
* Let mobile users order and unpin the server drawer tools by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5363
* Refuse cookie banners in agent browser tabs by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5366
* Start a new Claude session when Claude Code cannot find the saved one by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5368
* Let a server admin log in the server's Codex with an OpenAI API key by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5374
* Control the computer's desktop from the mobile app by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5372
* Let the iOS share sheet send a message with the share by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5330
* Show the Pi session cost on the Usage page by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5377
* Let the mobile chat back button work after a swipe back that does not finish by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5382
* Open large channels from remote clients: fit the channel page in one frame by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5383
* Show the home when the selected server does not answer at start by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5384
* Add the desktop provider options to the mobile app by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5385
* Keep the Models section mounted when a model switch changes by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5361
* Let custom provider models accept images and PDF, and fill values from the model list by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5389
* Put mobile Server settings on one page with row icons by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5393
* Keep a removed server removed and end the stuck loading screen by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5394
* Fold consecutive completed routine runs into one row on mobile by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5400
* Ping the Discord user that a new OpenBot post mentions by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5401
* Build the transparent window with its blur on macOS by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5403
* Keep the channel memories setting on a joined server by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5405
* Stop the whole window restyling when a chat adds an element by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5408
* Add GitLab to the Apps marketplace by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5411
* Show the steps of a turn with no answer, and let a thread tab load older messages by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5409
* Make grok-4.7 the default Grok model by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5417
* Show the chat scroll rail as ticks with a message card by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5415
* Write one event per streaming channel message, not one per update by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5418
* Ping the Slack user that an OpenBot post mentions by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5421
* Show the openbot.run home, Teams, Pricing and Contact pages in Polish by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5381
* Show a color wave for theme changes and a ring for the update button by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5426
* Continue work on a backup model after a spent provider quota by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5423
* Register offline_access with the MCP sign-in scope by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5428
* End a Pi turn when a short saved password is in its id by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5429
* Read the composer scroll position only when a list redraws a draft tag by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5433
* Show the Slack and Discord return button when the site bundle does not load by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5434
* Open a chat with a very large message on remote clients, and fold long messages by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5432
* Accept a file of any type as a chat attachment by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5431
* Add Omnisend to the Apps marketplace by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5443
* Stop Claude from making a title for each new session by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5445
* Raise the Grok Bot and Hermes import limits to 2 GB and 50,000 files by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5444
* Add ElevenLabs to the Apps marketplace with client metadata document sign-in by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5446
* Show a provider's MCP server failure as that server's, with a link to MCP settings by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5451
* Open the sending conversation from an agent link in a teammate message by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5453
* Refuse an agent reply to an unknown message ID, so a side-thread answer is not sent to the main chat by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5456
* Retry a held Windows transfer folder rename, so a message with a pasted image does not fail with a permission error by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5463
* Make a hosted server ready sooner after a wake by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5386
* Send the agent list before the providers start by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5412
* Leave bundled libraries out of the app archive by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5420
* Give each Codex server request its own id, so two Codex accounts do not share approval cards by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5467
* Let submit_secret take a Proton Pass login id by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5482
* Send the time of each startup step by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5468
* Start a hosted server after a stop that left an xauth lock by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5478
* Add Marketplace agents on a server on this computer by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5488
* Read Proton Pass logins after a restart without a reconnect by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5494
* Fill a Proton Pass login with no password as no-secret, not as a failed read by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5496
* Give each Gemini session a process of its own on Windows too by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5499
* Keep a reopened agent chat from scrolling back to an old message by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5504
* Stop compacting a chat that each compaction leaves at 70% to 79% by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5506
* Ping the Telegram and WhatsApp user that an answer mentions by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5509
* Let the web app download and send files up to 100 MB by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5510
* Show the run place switch of a routine on a joined server by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5511
* Add an agent dock at the edge of the screen by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5508
* Ask to hold Cmd+Q only while an agent works by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5513
* Show agent progress updates and add a Natural response style by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5464
* Send a teammate message without a reply id back to the asking Slack thread by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5522
* Stop a messaging request that is still starting by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5523
* Show "Running a command…" while an agent runs a shell command by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5515
* Show agent titles in the skill agents dialog by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5535

items.sourceText:
## What's Changed
* Let users choose the spoken replies model: Supertonic, ElevenLabs or xAI by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5555
* Show which workflow branch has no answer at a model join by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5561
* Start dev builds with the Dynamic Island and agent dock off by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5562
* Add a setting to turn off the hold to quit on a Mac by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5566
* Use API credit for Claude agents on an Anthropic API key by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5571
* Open an agent page in the side panel and quote text from it by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5570
* Let users choose a chat background for Light and for Dark by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5577
* Give notifications a new look by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5576
* Make the chat send and the message box move as Grok Bot does by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5578
* Add "Delete history" to the agent and channel settings by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5579
* Add Mistral as a built-in provider through Mistral Vibe by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5582
* Show the selected sidebar row with a grey fill in the light theme by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5585
* Use one registry for side panel panes by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5587
* Open channel file links to files outside the agent workspace by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5588
* Add Groq Whisper as dictation models by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5586
* Put the Workspace only sandbox in the Claude settings file by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5597
* Make the agent browser use fewer turns by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5589
* Register MCP sign-in again with localhost when 127.0.0.1 is refused by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5599
* Let Codex live voice work with agents on joined servers by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5592
* Keep agent browser pages drawn while the macOS window is minimized or hidden by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5604
* Scroll the agent dock when it has too many agents by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5605
* Add a Library page to the window rail by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5606
* Hide the agent dock from window switchers on macOS by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5607
* Keep the AppImage updater beside a self-hosted server by @Absterrg0 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4341
* Make the triage skill rate UX impact for casual users by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5608
* Connect the host to Signal again when its socket does not answer by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5611
* Run the OpenCode canary case on a fake model on loopback by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5609
* Complete Gemini turns that end silently after output or optional reply by @matheustx017 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5596
* fix(pi): send developer instructions to the Pi CLI in a file by @huajar in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/3777
* Ship Noto CJK fonts in the Docker image so the embedded browser renders CJK text by @sarequl in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4442
* Show a white root on the agent display of a server by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5613
* Send memories and section-mates with the turns for ACP, Muse and Pi by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5573
* Keep the named browser profile when an agent is duplicated by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5619
* Turn off Claude Code features that OpenBot agents cannot use by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5616
* fix(routines): let a routine run list routines (#4406) by @sarequl in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4542
* Keep the reported cost and the token counts of a custom agent in usage by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5620
* Stop the Local scripts settings page from locking the window by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5621
* Reconnect remote servers soon after the network returns by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5622
* Resume routines when the wake event never arrives by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5623
* Fail the Gemini turn when Google asks to verify the account by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5625
* Send fewer prompt tokens in each Pi agent request by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5629
* Send fewer prompt tokens in each OpenCode agent request by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5632
* Make Grok agent requests smaller by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5634
* Show the error of a failed tool step in the turn steps by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5635
* Add an Inception Labs key for dev harness tests by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5636
* Reduce the Hermes prompt tokens in each request by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5638
* Make the compact sidebar list fade longer at its edges by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5639
* Correct the text of the steer setting by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5626
* Keep agent progress updates in a channel by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5624
* Read progress updates aloud in a voice conversation by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5628
* Add Send now for queued messages of agents that cannot steer by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5633
* Send fewer tool and prompt tokens in each Claude and Codex request by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5642
* Send fewer repeated memory and turn context tokens by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5645
* Send fewer tokens in background model calls by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5649
* Send Codex memories and section teammates with the turns by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5647
* Send smaller browser and GitHub tool results to agents by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5652
* Continue an agent turn that ends on more next-step phrases by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5656
* Send fewer prompt tokens to Codex, and add web search for agents with no search of their own by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5658
* Stop island and agent dock motion while the user is in other apps by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5664
* Show one Attach files item in the message box menu by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5655
* Open Shared/… file chips from the shared folder by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5659
* Fill saved logins in text fields that the page masks as passwords by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5669
* Keep a browser tab open when its first page does not load by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5670
* Move Cursor agents to their backup model when the plan is used up by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5671
* Use less memory in tabs, provider processes and app windows by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5672
* Show agent dock replies while the OpenBot window is hidden by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5687
* Tell agents about saved logins that arrive after their chat started by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5694
* Prepare the v0.65.0 release by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5696

## New Contributors
* @Absterrg0 made their first contribution in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4341
* @matheustx017 made their first contribution in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5596
* @huajar made their first contribution in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/3777

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/compare/v0.64.0...v0.65.0

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.319：公式リリース
items.summary: 主な話題：安全性・権限管理、不具合修正、モデル対応。キーワードに基づく日本語の暫定分類です。具体的な変更内容と提供条件は公式原文で確認してください。
items.why: MacとWindowsのAIエージェントに作業を委任する際の安全性に関わるため、優先して確認する価値があります。
items.try: 検証用リポジトリで現在の設定をバックアップし、権限・サンドボックス動作を更新前後で比較してください。

items.sourceText:
## What's changed

- Changed auto mode with telemetry or feature flags off, including behind LLM gateways: calls the server can't check are asked about or denied, with no fallback to the built-in classifier; set `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` to keep using it (Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged)
- Changed auto mode behind an LLM gateway: `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` turns on the server-side check even with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` set; if managed settings set the latter, they must set the `1` too
- Added support for MCP tasks in the terminal: when an MCP server runs a tool call as a task, Claude Code moves it to the background right away and tells Claude the result when it finishes
- Added the `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASK_BACKGROUND` environment variable to make Claude Code wait for an MCP task inside its tool call instead of moving it to the background right away
- Added `permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting` setting: a tool call that would wait on a permission prompt is denied and the turn continues, in terminal sessions, subagents and teammates
- Added `/claude-api latency-optimize` to find where your Claude API code makes people wait and try faster settings against your eval
- Added the `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEATURE_FLAGS` environment variable, which stops feature-flag fetching without turning off telemetry; every flag then uses its built-in default
- Added spend for today, this week and this month to `/usage` for developers behind a Claude apps gateway who have no spend limit, when the gateway runs this version or later
- Added `admin.pooled_conflict_rule` and `admin.pooled_priority_order` to the Claude apps gateway, to set which pooled group budget pays first for a developer in several groups
- Added an optional `login_notice` setting to the Claude apps gateway that shows an operator-defined message on the gateway's browser verification page and on Claude Code's sign-in screen
- Added `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_LOG_FORMAT=json` to the Claude apps gateway: operational log lines become JSON with `severity`, `time` and `message`, for log collectors that read the level from a field
- Added a Claude apps gateway boot warning for a case where another policy's `availableModels` also allows a custom model id that one policy lists by name
- Added start-up warnings to the Claude apps gateway for policies with no `desktopHome` that rely on `coworkTabEnabled: false` or `chatSessionRetentionDays`, ahead of Claude Desktop's November 10 change
- Added a warning when your claude.ai login ends and Claude Code continues on the sign-in from `ant auth login`, which bills usage to your Claude Console organization
- Added a line at startup naming the Claude Console organization that is billed in a case where Claude Code uses the sign-in from `ant auth login`
- Added an "Earlier in this session" row to `/tasks` that lists finished subagents, so you can reopen one and message it even after it leaves the list or you restart
- Added a note to `/loop` confirmations in cloud sessions that a timer stops with its container, with an offer of a loop that survives
- Fixed MCP servers on the older handshake failing to connect, or returning empty results, because Claude Code declared an extension that it only uses with newer servers
- Fixed a long-running MCP tool call on a claude.ai connector sometimes never reporting its result after `--resume`
- Fixed a session's diff failing to load on claude.ai and the mobile apps when the folder Claude Code runs in has a file or folder named `HEAD`
- Fixed `/diff` showing "Diff unavailable" when a git repository has a file or folder named `HEAD` at its top level
- Fixed the `/diff` pane opening blank in sessions where 64 or more turns edited files
- Fixed slash commands typed after a leading space, tab or newline being sent to Claude as plain text instead of running
- Fixed a request that kept failing with a 401 refreshing your login on every retry and causing 401s in your other sessions
- Fixed `/context` sending its full visual grid to Claude on every later turn; Claude now reads only the table
- Fixed `claude -p` exiting 0 in auto mode when its actions were refused because no safety check was available: text and JSON output now exit 1
- Fixed a case where Claude Code listed every project file at start on Linux for projects on a network file system (NFS, SMB, Lustre and similar)
- Fixed a case where auto mode was wrongly refused when a client sent a model change and a request for auto mode back to back
- Fixed `/status` showing "Auto mode server: Enabled" when the server-side review isn't reaching the session, for example behind an LLM gateway that drops it
- Fixed Claude-drafted feedback, surveys and `/feedback` continuing to appear after the server refused feedback for your organization
- Fixed Claude drafting feedback on third-party gateways, where it can't be sent
- Fixed auto mode refusing actions without saying why when permission rules or `autoMode` settings are very large: it now explains and, unless `autoMode` deny rules are set, asks you in the terminal
- Fixed a case where Bash deny and ask rules missed commands written with quoted words
- Fixed subagent hand-back reports showing an internal marker and provenance note when expanded outside verbose mode
- Fixed `claude -p --resume` with a prompt losing a deferred tool call when its MCP server is missing: the run now exits 1, keeps the call and refuses later input
- Fixed a case where text was dropped from informational messages sent to SDK clients
- Fixed a case where Agent SDK hosts got a generic exit-code error instead of a failed run's own error message when the disk was full
- Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` re-running a turn that was interrupted in plan mode when the session resumes in another permission mode
- Fixed edits to a settings file being ignored when made within a few seconds of Claude Code writing that file
- Fixed a config file left at the legacy name hiding your setup with no warning: Claude Code now says on stderr when a home holds two config files, and which is in use
- Fixed `~/.claude.json`, settings and edited files ending up empty or cut off when the disk fills during a save in a read-only folder or to a bind-mounted file (one session saving at a time)
- Fixed Write ending the turn as a refusal when it couldn't read the file to overwrite
- Fixed background Bash commands that finish almost instantly losing their output while being reported as completed
- Fixed the Bash tool's diff of changed files missing a file that the command wrote just before it ended
- Fixed a mistyped model name, such as `opus-5-5`, telling you to update Claude Code instead of suggesting the model you meant
- Fixed a case where `NotebookEdit` changed the wrong cell when the notebook changed while a permission prompt was open
- Fixed a ~0.5s hang after pressing Enter on the `/login` success screen: the dialog now dismisses immediately and the post-login refresh runs in the background
- Fixed Ctrl+G not opening the external editor while typing an "Other" answer to a question in screen reader mode
- Fixed Monitor's WebSocket watch failing with "could not resolve" behind a proxy when `CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS` is set and the machine has no DNS of its own
- Fixed `claude plugin eval` warnings suggesting `max: 0` for a tool that must not be called, which could never pass
- Fixed background plugin auto-update not installing a dependency added by the updated plugin version
- Fixed Cmd+click not opening links in Ghostty over tmux in sessions opened from the agents view
- Fixed a mod's hot reload in `.claude/skills` missing a file that was deleted just after it appeared, and missing its return
- Fixed `/rewind` failing with "No files were restored" when restoring code to a checkpoint from before `/branch`
- Fixed the `/claude-api` skill saying Console web settings don't apply to Managed Agents sessions, and tightened its credential and permission examples
- Fixed needless permission prompts for read-only commands wrapped in a plain `timeout DURATION`, such as `timeout 30 rg foo`
- Fixed WebFetch describing claude.ai shared-chat links as empty pages; it now says shared chats can't be read and to paste the conversation instead
- Fixed Artifact database calls being re-sent to artifacts without a database; errors now say whether republishing helps
- Fixed a case where artifact database reads that save to a folder (`out_dir`) were refused
- Fixed detailed beta tracing not presenting `CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_CERT` to collectors that require a client certificate
- Fixed the OpenTelemetry `claude_code.session.count` metric counting Agent SDK `prewarm()` processes that were never claimed; a pre-started process now counts once, when it is claimed
- Fixed `/clear` killing running commands of background agents, teammates and workflows that keep running, and foreground subagents of background agents and teammates
- Fixed a terminal whose Claude apps gateway sign-in had expired sending telemetry and managed-settings requests that the gateway refused and logged as `invalid_token`
- Fixed the agents view appearing to send a reply to a background session waiting on a permission prompt; the reply now stays in the box with a hint to open the session and answer
- Fixed agent view removing a draft saved by another agent view in the same directory when exiting
- Fixed a case where agent view came back with another agent view's input text after restarting itself for an update
- Fixed the agents view preview cutting off long commands, results and status lines without an ellipsis, and dropping `**`, backticks and tags from commands waiting for approval
- Fixed Claude in Chrome reporting the extension as not connected when the connection dropped mid-action; Claude now checks the page before repeating an action that may have run
- Fixed Remote Control sessions still showing "Limit reached" on other devices after a usage limit was lifted outside the session
- Fixed the file card sometimes missing in the Claude iOS app when Claude sent a single file
- Fixed self-hosted runner sessions failing with no explanation when the server keeps refusing to renew model access: the runner now retries sooner and posts a warning in the session
- Fixed `/permissions` in cloud sessions replying only that it isn't available; it now says where the session's rules live and how to change them
- Fixed cloud sessions losing session-scoped deny and ask permission rules, such as those a PermissionRequest hook adds, when the session moves to a new worker
- Fixed mod hot-reloading turning off for the session when you typed three messages instead of answering its question in a cloud session
- Fixed background tasks that keep running after `/clear` disappearing from the task list in Claude Code on the web until another task started or ended
- Fixed hidden commands appearing in the slash command menu of cloud sessions on mobile and web
- Fixed a case where `/rewind` could restore or delete a file through a directory symlink
- Fixed a case where a `sed` command could skip the permission check in accept-edits and auto mode
- Fixed a case where `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` in managed settings was ignored behind an LLM gateway when the gateway's URL is set only there and server-managed settings can't be fetched
- Fixed a Bash permission bypass where a crafted environment prefix could hide part of a command from permission checks
- Fixed a case where deny and ask rules, hook matchers and `disallowedTools` entries written with a claude.ai connector's terminal name (`mcp__claude_ai_Slack`) were ignored in Claude Desktop (takes effect once Claude Desktop includes this version)
- Fixed a sandbox escape when creating a worktree
- Fixed self-hosted runners: `--trust-workspace false` now also stops hooks in the repository's settings files and skills from running
- Fixed a case where idle background sessions started through a shell-exported LLM gat

items.sourceText:
## Fork chats from any reply, Plan mode & a faster phone ✨

- 📱 **A smoother experience on your phone:** The phone opens and reconnects sooner, scrolls and streams chats more smoothly, reads Markdown and math better, and keeps unsent chat, review and Tasks text across reconnects.
- 🗂️ **Organize workspaces across machines:** Nest workspaces under a folder workspace, including workspaces on other machines.
- 🌿 **Do more with Chat UI:** Fork any finished response to try another direction while the original chat stays as it was. In Claude or Codex chats, type `/plan` to switch to Plan mode, which persists when you reopen the chat.
- 🖥️ **A more reliable terminal:** Terminal panes keep their zoom and restored scrollback, copied files paste as full paths, and busy terminal output takes less work to render.
- 🤖 **Better agent support:** Open running subagents from chat, see proposed files and diffs in Codex approvals, answer OpenCode choice questions, and sign in to Antigravity Chat with Gemini Enterprise.
- 🎙️ **Better dictation:** Pick your dictation language, keep the first and last words, see Listening while the model loads, and get on-device text back about a third sooner.
- 🧭 **Know where a chat runs:** The chat composer shows the machine, workspace and branch, and chats show a card for each pull request the agent opens.
- ⚡ **Snappier desktop chats:** One chat's status change no longer wakes every chat, the model picker opens without walking every worktree, and long replies stream without re-rendering.

## Highlights

- **Chat:** Fork from any finished response, use Plan mode in Claude and Codex chats, and open a running subagent from the agents strip. Codex approvals show the proposed files and diffs, OpenCode can ask choice questions, and Claude's built-in server tools show as normal tool cards. Holding Cmd/Ctrl in a busy chat shows what Cmd/Ctrl+Enter will do, app shortcuts work from the chat editor, and oversized pasted images shrink to fit instead of failing. Signed-out OpenCode, Pi and OMP chats offer a Sign in button.
- **Phone:** Markdown is easier to read and renders math, GitHub alerts, task boxes and images. Rename a workspace from its menu, see automatic continue and Switch Account on usage-limit notices, and keep chat sends, PR text, review notes and Tasks drafts when a connection drops. The phone dials the relay right away when that worked last time, keeps terminal output across a network switch, and streams busy terminals without falling behind.
- **Agents & accounts:** Antigravity Chat can sign in with Gemini Enterprise, reports quota for every saved account and manages accounts inside WSL. `orca account` can select and remove any saved account. Antigravity IDE joins the Open In presets.
- **Remote hosts:** SSH says plainly when a host now serves a different Orca server, disconnects a host whose server you stopped, and honors IdentitiesOnly on manual hosts. Sleeping recipe VMs wake when any client opens them, `orca serve` can bind to one address, and browsing through a paired server is faster on high-latency links. Browser tabs show when an SSH host is controlling them, with a way to stop it.
- **Source control & Tasks:** Phone branch switches are refused with a plain reason when they would move uncommitted work or land mid-rebase. Checks show when they ran and how long they took. Tasks can filter GitHub PRs and GitLab MRs by state and by who wrote or reviews them, and pasted images upload before a GitHub draft is published.
- **Workspaces & plugins:** Multi-repo folder workspaces can parent workspaces, and workspaces can nest under parents on other machines. `orca plugin` installs, updates and removes plugins and manages catalogs, plugin pages show more about their publisher, and look-alike plugin names show who published them.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **macOS 13.4 minimum:** Orca now needs macOS 13.4 or later (previously macOS 12). Macs on older versions stay on their last compatible build through the in-app updater and see a notice, and Homebrew refuses the upgrade on macOS 13.0–13.3. Any Mac on macOS 13 can update to macOS 13.7 to keep getting Orca updates.
- **Dictation model:** The Zipformer EN dictation model is no longer offered. If you had it selected, Orca moves you to Parakeet v2, which you may need to download in Settings › Voice before dictation works.
- **New profiles:** Fresh desktop profiles open in a folder workspace at your home folder, named `~`. Existing profiles are unchanged. "Set up later" in onboarding now opens your default agent.
- **Pairing codes expire:** Unused desktop pairing codes now expire: the phone QR code after 10 minutes and the pair-another-computer link after 60 minutes. Devices that are already paired are unaffected.
- **Chat UI settings:** The changed files card and opened pull request cards are now controlled from Settings › Chat UI › Turn activity, as Turn diffs and Opened pull requests.
- **Local browser proxy:** The local browser control proxy now requires a per-session token that only Orca's own agent-browser launches receive, so other programs on your machine can no longer use it.
- **Downgrading:** Chats that used Plan mode can't be opened by v1.4.251 if you downgrade. They open again after you upgrade back.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat & agents

*Branch a chat from any reply, plan before building, see where a chat runs and keep long chats fast.*

* Fork a Chat UI chat from any finished response by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38326
* Support native Plan mode in chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38286
* Show machine, workspace and branch below the chat composer by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38253
* fix(chat): shrink the composer workspace footer and center its text on the icons by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/39261
* Show a card in chat for pull requests the agent opens by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38750
* feat(native-chat): show details on link cards for any repo on a known host by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38892
* Group turn diffs and opened PRs under Chat UI › Turn activity by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/39127
* Let users hide the changed files card in chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38756
* Holding Cmd/Ctrl in a busy chat shows what Cmd/Ctrl+Enter will do by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38749
* Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends the first queued card after a Stop by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38877
* feat(native-chat): open a subagent from the agents strip by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38640
* feat(native-chat): step between a question card's questions with Left and Right by @big-sheq in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38335
* Show OpenCode choice questions in chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38872
* Show proposed files and diffs in Codex approvals by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37960
* fix: display Claude server tools in chat and history by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38811
* Keep Claude plugin UI out of chat and recover blocked replies by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37965
* Offer terminal sign-in recovery in native agent chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/39012
* Keep the saved model when reopening ACP chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38815
* Import Codex command history the way the live chat shows it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/39066
* fix(omp): use OMP model roles, selectors and effort in chats and workers by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38713
* Keep app shortcuts working from the chat message editor by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38724
* fix(native-chat): let Cmd+R rename a chat tab from its composer by @big-sheq in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38388
* fix(native-chat): run the equalize pane sizes shortcut from Chat UI panes by @sungman-cho in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37755
* Show switch-back note after enabling Chat UI by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38703
* Shrink oversized pasted images to fit instead of failing with "Clipboard image is too large" by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/39050
* Highlight already open structured agent panes by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/39219
* fix: restore delete action in session list by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/39163
* Apply supported read-only controls to hidden text helpers by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38558
* Keep published active tabs aligned with current selection by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38844

## A little update ✨

We released two updates today! Check out the [v1.4.252 release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.252) for chat forking and Plan mode, a smoother phone experience, and workspace organization across machines.

A small release with a few minor improvements. A bigger one is coming later 🫣

## What's changed

* Reduce repeated work during host-status updates by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/39340
* Reduce process launches when reading Linux process start times by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/39439
* Dim the chat message rail until hover, focus or scroll by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/39369

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.252...v1.4.253

## New Features

- Open the agent command center with `codex agents --no-daemon`. The command center and session picker now mark unread results (#58238, #58239, #58263, #58264).
- Switch between connected backends from the terminal session picker and keep your drafts when switching (#58280, #58457).
- Preview local image attachments while composing on supported terminals, and open viewed local images from clickable transcript paths (#58261, #58446).
- Find API key and cloud provider options under “Sign in another way.” Enable `gcp_setup_wizard` to set up Google Cloud Vertex AI with Application Default Credentials or a credential file (#57857, #58427).
- Opt into macOS or Windows system proxy settings from `/experimental` (#58157).
- Expand patch details directly in the transcript while an approval prompt is open (#58281).

## Bug Fixes

- Saved chats stay visible after you switch model providers. If a chat can’t resume, you can read its transcript and prepare an editable prompt to continue in a new chat (#58202).
- `Ctrl+L` clears the terminal display while keeping earlier messages available through `Ctrl+T` (#58266).
- Deleting text that exposes a leading `!` keeps an ordinary draft in chat mode (#58412).
- Network approval prompts close when their requests end. Concurrent requests to the same endpoint prompt one at a time (#58350, #58351).
- Long realtime V3 conversations save completed speech to chat history as the transcript grows (#58221).
- Automatic context compaction now accounts for retained output from failed responses and responses with missing token usage data (#58404).

## Documentation

- The app-server README covers managed network constraints under `[permissions.network]` and `prompt-user` command rules that require fresh human approval (#58045, #58182).
- The `openai-docs` skill recommends the documented replacement when migrating away from a deprecated model (#58134).

## Chores

- DotSlash manifests now reference the Cargo packages shipped with the release (#58717, #58757).
- Linux musl builds use fewer allocator arenas to reduce idle memory after conversations unload (#58399).

items.sourceText:
## What's Changed
* Log the D1 failure class and retry an overloaded read once by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4997
* Defer Codex MCP tools except Computer Use by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5001
* Keep a sent image in place when the host stores the message by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5005
* Let Hermes Agent install and sign in on a self-hosted server by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4999
* Tell every provider that tools are unavailable in a toolless generation by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5010
* Show a fishing plush when the Marketplace has nothing to show by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5012
* build(nix): install OpenBot 0.61.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5011
* Keep ChatGPT working after a slow first start, and replace a too old hosted CLI by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5013
* Add TickTick to the Apps marketplace by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5014
* Send the account state again when the main window stops loading by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5016
* Show unread agent messages in side threads by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5015
* Assess and score feature requests in the triage skill by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5020
* Send the server list again when the main window stops loading by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5018
* Let a user tag browser tabs and threads in chat by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5021
* Keep the unsent text of each mobile chat by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5019
* Skip linked agents after a quiet routine run by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5030
* Keep custom ACP agent models whose values the model id charset refuses by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5034
* Lay out the page fewer times when a chat opens by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5038
* Tell Codex agents that exec does not list OpenBot's tools by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5040
* Stop full chat restyles from three menu rules by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5043
* Do not count the agent database host start against the first statement by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5044
* Add read-only SQL access to the OpenPanel ClickHouse by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5046
* Add Delete to the provider page by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5049
* Add stall, crash, startup, turn and window timing to host analytics by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5050
* Send the reason of a failed turn to analytics by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5053
* Report an unclean exit of the main process to analytics by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5054
* Log Rust info and warning records from provider stderr by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5071
* Show the WhatsApp self-chat to the orchestrator as the OpenBot user by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5072
* List Pi models whose ids the model charset refuses by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5080
* Let servers on this computer change their name and logo by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5094
* Log each reconnect step on mobile, and add a Discord link and a log page to Support by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5105
* Add Parakeet Unified EN and Cohere Transcribe, and use less memory in the voice hosts by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5107
* Show side-thread work, waits and unread replies on the mobile agent list by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5106
* Stop a wrapped user message with files from covering the next row in the mobile app by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5113
* Mark mobile 1.4.6 as available on Android by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5116
* Save keys from the request_api_key form in the Vault by default by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5114
* Send email through Cloudflare when the SMTP mailbox reaches its hourly limit by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5117
* Mark chats read through the message the host counts, and add Mark unread and the NEW line on mobile by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5115
* Tell messaging agents to save lasting facts that people give by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5118
* Show only the named file as an inline image of an agent answer by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5085
* Send a daily release regression report to Discord by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5104
* Try the account service again after the start window ends by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5122
* Edit Telegram and Slack workflows and connectors in the mobile app by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4963
* Keep each Dynamic Island on its own display by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5123
* Show Effort and Fast in the Brain Model picker menu, in sync with the header by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5127
* Let agents send files with messaging_post by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5125
* Stop the Android app running out of memory with pasted images by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5128
* Tell the requesting agent when a teammate request fails by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5129
* Stop the Android crash when window insets change by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5132
* Keep a scrolled-up chat in place when a plan closes by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5130
* Show the queue of a side thread as in the main chat by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5124
* Lay out the page fewer times for code previews and older messages by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5133
* Add the plush and flat avatar styles and the desktop avatar groups to the mobile app by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5134
* Stop Android crashes from a shadow node race in Reanimated by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5131
* Fill Bitwarden logins on every page of their site by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5136
* Stop the Android app from crashing on screen changes and keyboard drags by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5135
* Let each custom provider model set its reasoning efforts by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5138
* Let agents create repositories through OpenBotGit by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5139
* Reconnect the mobile app sooner after a return: bound the workspace reads and reload only open chats by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5141
* Show OpenRouter models that Pi added after its release by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5140
* Add a password manager engine and connect Proton Pass for browser sign-in by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5137
* Show agent questions in one paged chat bubble by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5146
* Give each browser profile its own proxy by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5145
* Stop compacting a chat that stays at 80% or more after compactions by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5153
* Stop the closed loading screen from rendering each frame by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5154
* Stop three iOS crashes: Live Activity on iOS 17, speech playback, and UI runtime memory by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5152
* Ask for a post and a follow on social networks by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5151
* Stop the mobile browser crash when a tab shows by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5155
* Run agent routines in the main chat again, with a switch for a separate thread by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5156
* Give routine threads Computer Use again by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5159
* Let a teammate decide on its own for a chat request by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5160
* Make the whole transparent window clear by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5161
* Put ~/.local/bin on PATH in the Docker image by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5162
* Keep an Android list scroll from showing Pin on a row by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5163
* Reduce idle energy use when no task runs by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5165
* Show icons as a fixed outline that only turns brighter on hover or selection by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5168
* Add pause and reply speed settings for voice conversations in the mobile app by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5169
* Let channel members reply to each other by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5167
* release: prepare v0.62.0 by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5170
* release: add the channel reply note to v0.62.0 by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5172
* Do not show "Queue unavailable" in the mobile chat by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5174
* Check the voice session settings file as text in the package checks by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5175


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/compare/v0.61.0...v0.62.0

items.sourceText:
# Hermes Agent v0.23.0

**Release Date:** November 5, 2026
**Since v0.22.0:** ~10,080 commits · ~1,950 merged PRs · ~8,720 files changed · ~725,200 insertions · ~201,400 deletions · **~850 issues closed** · 666 contributors

> **The Hearth Release.** In the old hymns Hermes kept the threshold and Hestia kept the hearth, and the two were honored side by side. v0.22.0 got newcomers through the door; v0.23.0 builds the fire they gather around. The headline: your whole Desktop workspace now opens in a browser tab, served by your own gateway. Underneath it, every conversation lives in one place: a single gateway owns each session, and the CLI, TUI, Desktop, editors, bots and cron all sit down at the same table instead of each running its own agent. From that one hearth, Desktop keeps every machine you run Hermes on connected at once, Group Chats route their own conversations, and the terminal finally draws your images inline and lets you rewind a conversation. Around it: plugins that keep themselves updated, price tags and spend limits on paid MCP tools, pluggable delegation, a plugin catalog that grew from about 600 to over 1,050 entries, a leaner built-in skill set, and a long run of memory and latency work for long-lived gateways. This release rolls up and fully documents the v0.22.1–v0.22.7 patch releases.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

---

## ✨ Highlights

- **Your Desktop workspace in a browser tab** — The new Webapp serves the full Desktop workspace from your own gateway: the same chats, Group Chats, plugins and settings, in any browser on your network or behind a public URL with sign-in. The Docker image and Nix package ship it. It is off by default; turn it on with `webapp.enabled` or Web Access in Settings. ([#141864](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141864), [#145598](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145598), [#145536](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145536), [#145072](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145072), [#145153](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145153) — @jquesnelle, @BearHuddleston, @IAvecilla, @Adolanium)

- **One gateway owns every conversation** — Before, the CLI, TUI, Desktop, editors (ACP), messaging bots and cron could each run their own copy of the agent against the same chat, which is how messages got written twice or went missing between surfaces. Now each machine runs one gateway that owns every session, and every surface attaches to it as a client: a chat you open anywhere is the same chat, with one queue and one history. You can even steer or edit a queued prompt from Desktop without it running twice. ([#106742](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/106742), [#140334](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140334) — @unsupportedpastels, @kshitijk4poor)

- **Pictures in the terminal** — When you paste an image, or a tool takes a screenshot, the CLI and TUI now draw it right in the chat instead of printing a file path: real pixels in kitty and Ghostty (CLI and TUI) and in iTerm2, WezTerm and Konsole (CLI), coloured blocks everywhere else, and full resolution in VS Code's terminal when its image support is on. ([#147293](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147293), [#148874](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148874) — @Adolanium)

- **Rewind a conversation** — Press Esc twice or type `/rewind` in the TUI or classic CLI, pick an earlier message, then edit and resend it or fork a new session from that point. The original session stays exactly as it was. The TUI can also start `/new` while a turn is still running; the old one keeps working in the background. ([#144937](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144937), [#148880](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148880) — @SaguaroDev)

- **Every machine in one Desktop window** — Desktop now keeps all your gateways connected at once, so switching between this computer and an SSH or remote gateway is instant. Terminal tabs run on the host they were opened on, and a Group Chat can mix bots from different machines. ([#147681](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147681), [#147708](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147708), [#148418](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148418) — @dskwe, @janviernine)

- **Group Chats that run themselves** — Bot Mode rooms can let a lead bot, or an automatic router, pick who answers a message that names nobody. Scheduled jobs can post into a room, rooms keep a purpose and shared notes, and bots no longer ping each other in endless loops. Rooms also look like a normal Hermes chat now, and each bot shows what it is doing live ("scout · terminal · 7s"). ([#144833](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144833), [#148417](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148417), [#148888](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148888), [#148903](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148903), [#148422](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148422) — @KoNit-K)

- **Plugins that keep themselves current** — `hermes plugins update` updates everything at once, and an opt-in Auto-update switch (CLI, chat, Desktop and dashboard) keeps catalog and git plugins up to date. Updates that would break your setup are held back instead of applied. The catalog itself grew from about 600 to over 1,050 entries, and a new Verified tier marks plugins built by the vendor itself. ([#141513](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141513), [#85794](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/85794), [#143468](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143468), [#144257](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144257) — @charan-rathore, @YS-OH-CORE)

- **Price tags and spend limits for paid tools** — Paid MCP tools, such as 3D or media generation, can declare what a call costs. The approval prompt shows each call's price and the chat's running total, and Hermes asks before a chat goes over its limit, even in YOLO mode. ([#142470](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142470), [#143780](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143780), [#143795](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143795), [#143787](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143787) — @liuhao1024, @fangliquanflq)

- **New official plugins, and a smaller core** — Meshy (text and image to 3D), ElevenLabs Music and Sound Effects, X Chat, REA (reverse engineering) and a bubblewrap sandbox are now one-command installs. Camofox, `mcp-serve`, the agent importers and Singularity moved out of core into plugins that install themselves for anyone who used them. ([#142619](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142619), [#146294](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146294), [#139725](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139725), [#143484](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143484), [#139983](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139983))

- **Choose how subagents are run** — Delegation is now pluggable: keep the default, or install the official `advanced-delegation` plugin to send each subagent task to a named model or into a separate profile. Switch with `/delegation`. ([#142563](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142563), [#142564](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142564), [#143423](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143423))

- **Lighter and faster, especially when Hermes runs all day** — Recurring cron jobs share a prompt cache, one-shot runs send about 1,570 fewer prompt tokens per call, and `patch`/`write_file` return in milliseconds with LSP on. Long-lived gateways now let go of closed sessions' memory, and the Desktop sidebar no longer slows down as sessions pile up (one store with ~35k cron runs went from a 121 s refresh to instant). ([#139876](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139876), [#144177](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144177), [#140387](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140387), [#147863](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147863), [#137087](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/137087), [#147819](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147819), [#144940](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144940) — @kshitijk4poor)

- **A leaner skill set you can lock** — The built-in skills went from 58 to 44, with Word, PowerPoint and Excel merged into one `microsoft-office` skill. `hermes curator lock` stops the agent from rewriting a skill you curated by hand, through any tool, even in YOLO mode. ([#147557](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147557) — @daviseford)

- **Password managers and a keychain vault key** — Verified password-manager plugins can hand the browser your logins without seeing anyone else's, and the browser vault's key can now live in your OS keychain. ([#143964](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143964), [#144246](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144246) — @Jesssullivan)

- **Stop a running cron job** — Cancel a running job from the CLI, Desktop, the API or the agent itself, and set per job what happens to runs missed while Hermes was off. ([#144801](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144801) — @kokhlo, @fangliquanflq, @LeonSGP43)

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- **The old built-in browser tools are gone.** Browser automation runs on `browser_exec` only; agent-browser and the ten `browser_*` tools (`browser_navigate`, `browser_click`, ...) were removed. Homes that used Camofox get the `camofox` plugin installed automatically. If your own prompts, skills or toolset lists name the old tools, switch them to `browser_exec`. ([#143146](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143146))
- **Desktop needs macOS 13+ and 64-bit Windows.** The app moved to Electron 44, which no longer runs on macOS 11, macOS 12 or 32-bit Windows. ([#142727](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142727) — @OutThisLife, @Adihaliem)
- **`hermes mcp serve` is now `hermes mcp-serve`** (it moved into a plugin). MCP clients that launch Hermes as a server need their command updated; nothing rewrites it for you.
- **Word, PowerPoint and Excel skills are now one `microsoft-office` skill.** Old copies stay on disk until you remove them.
- **The Webapp is off by default.** Nothing is served to a browser until you turn on `webapp.enabled` or Web Access.

## 🧠 Core Agent, Gateway & Tools

### Providers & Models
- **GLM-5.3 is the default model when you never pick one** — The silent default moves from GLM-5.2 to GLM-5.3, at about the same price and with the same 1M context window on Nous Portal and OpenRouter. ([#144810](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144810) — @calvinnwq)
- **New models** — GPT-6.1 Terra, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 and Gemini 4 Argon on Solstice. Claude Mythos is treated as always-thinking, so reasoning-off requests stop failing their first try. Nemotron 3.5 Super VL gets default parameters. ([#145204](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145204), [#140496](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140496), [#139466](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139466), [#148127](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148127), [#138462](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/138462) — @benbarclay, @unsupportedpastels, @rroverin)
- **Usage-window plans** — On subscriptions that track usage as allowances instead of credits, `/usage` shows one bar per allowance with its reset time. Pickers list the plan's recommended models first, tag them Large or Free, and say when an allowance has run out. ([#142308](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142308), [#145682](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145682) — @rob-maron)

items.sourceExcerpt: One gateway owns every local session** — The classic CLI, TUI, Desktop, API server, ACP, bots and cron now attach to each profile's single gateway instead of running their own agents against the same database. A chat is one conversation with one queue and one writer. Follow-ups route classic CLI commands (/model, /cron, /queue, /save, /snapshot, /resume, todos) through it. details.workflow: 検証用リポジトリで作業を中断・再開し、作業フォルダと直前の依頼が保持されるかを確認する。対象は「Hermes Agent v0.23.0：公式リリース」。この更新が必要な操作に影響するかを切り分けるための提案です。
steps: 現在の製品名・バージョン・ログイン方法を控え、公開データを使うテスト用フォルダを用意する。
検証用リポジトリで作業を中断・再開し、作業フォルダと直前の依頼が保持されるかを確認する。同じ入力・同じ依頼を保存する。
公式ノートの対象バージョンに切り替え、同じ依頼を再実行する。成功可否・手直し回数・出力差分を記録する。
details.benefit: この作業で再現した場合に限り、やり直しや手動確認が減る可能性があります。速度・品質の改善率は測定していません。
details.environment: プラン・地域・アプリ/CLIの対応条件は公式ページで確認が必要です。
details.limitations: ChatGPT Plus / Claude Pro / Google AI Proの契約からAPI利用権や他製品の機能を推定しません。CLI・アプリ・Webの提供差に注意してください。

## What's Changed
* Keep an old agent reply out of the end of the chat by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5176
* Add Higgsfield to the Apps marketplace by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5177
* Find MCP server commands on the PATH when the login shell is slow or fails by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5179
* Show how to fix a zero real-time limit when Linux stops a provider by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5180
* Preload recent agents on the web and send read mark events only to their member by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5182
* Prepare the mobile app 1.4.7 by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5184
* Tell the user to turn on ChatGPT device code sign-in by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5185
* Keep Claude signed in after OpenBot restarts and updates by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5187
* Stop Claude agents draining the 5-hour window twice as fast by @Mouhand-Kaddo in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4588
* build(nix): install OpenBot 0.62.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5188
* Let saved logins and cards fill again after an agent script by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5048
* Read Proton Pass logins from each vault of the access key by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5203
* Let users choose when the plan card starts long tasks by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5208
* Refuse Workspace only when this computer cannot confine the provider by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5205
* Fade sidebar chats that scroll under a folder name by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5209
* Close the browser pane when its last tab closes by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5218
* Let users choose the provider account when they create an agent by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5223
* Send a teammate message without a reply id back to the asking side thread by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5224
* Let a person's channel request create or change channels by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5226
* Keep the cause of each agent error in the provider log by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5228
* Record hosted server start time and remote connect time by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5229
* Clean up agent question styles and send question detail by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5164
* Let users set the local scripts limit for each hour by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5232
* Tint the content of a bubble with a chat color by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5234
* Show no effort in list_models for a model with no effort setting by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5239
* Lay out the page once for question cards when a chat opens by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5238
* Show the tokens and cost of each skill in the Usage page by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5237
* Show why a thread failed on a spent balance, and stop going back to it by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5240
* Open the attached file when a file name chip finds no workspace file by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5198
* Show the models of each Gemini account in the model menu by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5242
* Start OpenBot again when boat cancels a hosted server stop by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5214
* Let GPT voice relay requests to any agent by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5230
* Send selected text in a side thread to that thread by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5254
* Continue a hosted update when the AppArmor profile does not load by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5297
* Tell an agent that only the user can remove a Vault API key by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5299
