items.sourceText:
## Richer phone chats, add-to-chat from anywhere & steadier terminals ✨

- 📱 **Much more chat on the phone:** Rewind to an earlier message, continue a stopped reply, pin the agent's plan above the composer, paste images and long text, manage a chat's goal and see context usage, with unsent drafts kept across an app restart.
- 📎 **Add anything to chat:** Send a selection from a file, a Markdown preview or a terminal to any agent in the workspace, or start a new agent with it.
- 🔁 **Chats pick up after a restart:** New installs resume working chats automatically after Orca quits or updates, and resuming is more reliable for everyone who has it on.
- 🤖 **Workers can start their own workers:** Nested workers are allowed by default, finished workers can keep messaging their coordinator, and stopping a worker stops its helpers.
- ⚡ **Faster everyday work:** Launch skips a second login-shell capture, source control and the tab bar do less repeated work, and long chats stay responsive.
- 🖥️ **Steadier terminals:** Terminals re-attach after a daemon reconnect, survive a busy app, and new GPU canvases no longer flash blank.
- 🗂️ **Easier project organization:** Collapse or expand all projects, create a child worktree from the context menu and refresh folder project groups.

## Highlights

- **Chat:** Add a file, Markdown preview or terminal selection to a chat. Agent messages use one-line cards on desktop and phone, native chats appear in Cmd+J recents and title search, and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter on an empty composer steers the first queued message. Claude chats keep effort changeable after the first reply and clear a stuck "needs permission" status when Claude ends the request itself. Codex chats show `/usage` and subagent task names.
- **Phone:** Rewind and continue chats, pin the plan, paste images and long text, set and manage goals, see the context usage ring, follow background tasks, copy or share images, copy file paths, choose where links open, and sign in from a signed-out chat.
- **Orchestration:** Workers can start their own workers, keep messaging their coordinator after they finish, and stop their helpers when stopped. Mail waits for a draft you are typing, including in OpenCode and after a restart.
- **Performance:** Startup, source control conflict badges and branch compares, the tab bar, browser login detection, Pi terminal spawns and plugin catalog images all do less repeated work. Long chats no longer rescan their whole history on every status update. Chats with ACP agents also stop holding on to finished tool and message records for the chat's whole life.
- **Terminals & remote hosts:** Terminals re-attach after a daemon reconnect and keep their link through a main-process freeze. SSH explains when a host's server setup stops on a known cause and stops restarting a server that keeps crashing. Server actions reconnect a disconnected server.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Nested worker depth:** The default is now 4. Existing profiles set to 1 move to 4 on upgrade; you can set it back in Settings, and Orca keeps that choice.
- **Resume working chats after restart:** On by default for new installs only. Existing users keep their saved choice, and existing profiles that never chose stay off.
- **Claude permission status:** Clearing a "needs permission" status that Claude ended itself needs Claude 2.1.118 or later. Orca installs one more managed Claude hook for it; older Claude versions keep the previous behavior.
- **macOS updates:** Macs below a release's minimum macOS stay on their last compatible build and get a one-time notice. The minimum is still macOS 12, so nothing changes yet.
- **Chat UI menu:** "Fork Agent Session…" is no longer in Chat UI's menu. Terminals keep it.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat & agents

*Bring more context into chats, keep long chats responsive and smooth out Claude, Codex and OpenCode details.*

* Add a file, markdown preview or terminal selection to the chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38251
* Open a terminal when splitting a Chat UI pane by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37984
* Cmd/Ctrl+Enter on an empty chat composer steers the first queued message by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38732
* Include native chat tabs in Ctrl+PageUp/PageDown cycling by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37952
* Show native chats in Cmd+J recents and title search by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38574
* Use one-line cards for all agent messages on desktop and phone by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38615
* Show model and effort before a folder chat’s first message by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38498
* Keep Claude chat effort aligned with its resolved setting by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38338
* Keep a Claude chat's effort changeable after its first reply by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38272
* feat(native-chat): show the chat's Codex usage card for /usage by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38352
* Codex subagent rows show their task names instead of all saying "worker" by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38491
* Keep prices readable in chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38651
* feat(native-chat): color chat links with the theme's link color by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38676
* fix(native-chat): make file links in terminal-backed plan approvals actionable by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38495
* feat(omp): ask multiple-choice and batched questions in chat view by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38684
* fix(native-chat): list OpenCode's own and custom slash commands as soon as the chat opens by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38698
* fix(claude): drop the local-command caveat when rewinding to a slash command by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38743
* Remove Fork Agent Session from the Chat UI menu by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38646
* fix(native-chat): name a chat resumed from a session after that session by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38679
* fix(ai-vault): keep a reply that matches the session title in Latest turns by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38666
* fix(claude): turn on Artifact tools in native chat sessions by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38248
* fix(chat): repair account setup and recover startup retries by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38389
* fix(agents): paired-host agent tabs use the host's launch settings by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38301
* fix(acp): permission prompts from an agent's own work wait for you by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38488
* Clear a Claude permission wait when Claude ends the request itself by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38648
* Resume working chats after restart by default for new users by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38649
* Keep long chats responsive: stop rescanning whole history on each status update and subagent name by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38627
* Release obsolete ACP tool and message bookkeeping by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38767

### Orchestration

*Let workers do more on their own and deliver mail at the right moment.*

* Let workers start their own workers by default (nested worker depth 4) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38348
* Let a finished worker keep messaging its coordinator by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38357
* Stop a worker's helpers when the worker is stopped by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38373
* Make temporary worker banners more prominent by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38465
* Keep orchestration messages tied to their actual agent identity by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37966
* fix(orchestration): let worker_done settle when SQLite cannot write a temp file by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38358
* fix(orchestration): drop the worker brief line that read as a ban on pushing by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38349
* fix(orchestration): don't let a dim prompt suggestion hold mail as a draft by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38370
* fix(orchestration): hold mail for a draft typed before an Orca restart by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38398
* fix(orchestration): hold mail behind a draft typed into OpenCode by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38451
* fix(terminal): press Enter once the composer shows the pasted prompt by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38401

### Terminals, performance & updates

*Keep terminals attached and painted, start faster, and keep older Macs on a build they can run.*

* fix(runtime): re-attach every terminal a daemon reconnect detached by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38704
* fix(daemon): a main-process freeze no longer tears down the terminal daemon link by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38695
* fix(terminal): paint a new WebGL canvas through an open synchronized frame instead of flashing blank by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37604
* fix(terminal): ask before closing a tab when Orca can't tell if an agent is running by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38697
* fix(runtime): date title-only agent status at the PTY status transition by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38706
* Terminal tabs show the agent session's name instead of the first-prompt title by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38518
* fix(tabs): renamed sessions show their new name within seconds by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38628
* fix(tabs): a session's own name replaces a quick-command tab name by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38677
* perf(startup): stop a second login-shell capture on every launch by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38480
* perf(pi): skip rewriting current managed extensions on every terminal spawn by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38481
* perf(tab-bar): reuse each tab's activity status across unrelated store writes by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38467
* Keep dropped-macOS updaters on their last compatible build and explain why by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38777

### SSH & remote servers

*Explain server setup failures and keep remote servers connected.*

* fix(ssh): say what to do when a host's server setup stops on a known cause by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38508
* fix(ssh): stop restarting a managed orcad that keeps crashing, and say why by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38308
* fix(runtime): explicit server actions connect a disconnected server; name the launch hold by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38530
* fix(runtime): resume a server's status only after its action replaced the transport by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38532
* fix(managed-server): drop a stale update deferral once the host's activation moves by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38700
* fix(orcad): only evict real version slots from the artifact cache, so the shared Node runtime survives upgrades by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38717
* Retire a shared-control socket that opens but never becomes ready by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38690

items.sourceText: New Features Open the agent command center with codex agents --no-daemon . The command center and session picker now mark unread results ( #58238 , #58239 , #58263 , #58264 ). Switch between connected backends from the terminal session picker and keep your drafts when switching ( #58280 , #58457 ). Preview local image attachments while composing on supported terminals, and open viewed local images from clickable transcript paths ( #58261 , #58446 ). Find API key and cloud provider options under “Sign in another way.” Enable gcp_setup_wizard to set up Google Cloud Vertex AI with Application Default Credentials or a credential file ( #57857 , #58427 ). Opt into macOS or Windows system proxy settings from /experimental ( #58157 ). Expand patch details directly in the transcript while an approval prompt is open ( #58281 ). Bug Fixes Saved chats stay visible after you switch model providers. If a chat can’t resume, you can read its transcript and prepare an editable prompt to continue in a new chat ( #58202 ). Ctrl+L clears the terminal display while keeping earlier messages available through Ctrl+T ( #58266 ). Deleting text that exposes a leading ! keeps an ordinary draft in chat mode ( #58412 ). Network approval prompts close when their requests end. Concurrent requests to the same endpoint prompt one at a time ( #58350 , #58351 ). Long realtime V3 conversations save completed speech to chat history as the transcript grows ( #58221 ). Automatic context compaction now accounts for retained output from failed responses and responses with missing token usage data ( #58404 ). Documentation The app-server README covers managed network constraints under [permissions.network] and prompt-user command rules that require fresh human approval ( #58045 , #58182 ). The openai-docs skill recommends the documented replacement when migrating away from a deprecated model ( #58134 ). Chores DotSlash manifests now reference the Cargo packages shipped with the release ( #58717 , #58757 ). Linux musl builds use fewer allocator arenas to reduce idle memory after conversations unload ( #58399 ). * fix(fetch): run Readability.js under a bounded subprocess, off the event loop and stdout by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5391
* feat(fetch): open the simplified result with the page title by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5398
* feat(fetch): add an operator host allowlist, --allowed-hosts by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5392

* fetch: ask for native markdown through Accept content negotiation by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5387
* fix(fetch): reject an invalid prompt URL with -32602 by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5358
* chore: stamp Python CalVer versions for 2026.11.4 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5429
* Release v2.3.0: merge v2/main into main by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5430

## mcp-server-git 2026.11.4

### What's Changed

* fix(git): accept revision ranges such as main..feature in git_diff by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5360
* docs(git): document setting the commit identity via env vars or gitconfig by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5354
* feat(git): add git_merge tool by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5363
* feat(git): add a read-only git_remote tool that lists remotes by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5373
* feat(git): add prompts that embed the repository's changes by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5386
* chore: stamp Python CalVer versions for 2026.11.4 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5429
* Release v2.3.0: merge v2/main into main by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5430

## mcp-server-time 2026.11.4

### What's Changed

* feat(time): default omitted timezone arguments to the local timezone by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5364
* fix(time): report the second occurrence of an ambiguous fall-back time in convert_time by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5366
* feat(time): add get_time_ago for past times by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5369
* chore: stamp Python CalVer versions for 2026.11.4 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5429

## What's Changed
* Let a GitHub workflow trigger watch many repositories by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4769
* Add Devin as a built-in provider by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4766
* Add neutral and exact agent colours by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4765
* Copy the WhatsApp package manifest into the Signal image by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4771
* Count a starting chat delivery as busy for channel assignments by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4774
* build(nix): install OpenBot 0.60.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4778
* release: add the reply speed note to v0.60.0 by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4779
* Translate the Vault and Roles server settings into Polish by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4776
* Keep each avatar colour tile in its grid column by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4782
* Show the skills of channel agents in the channel `$` list by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4781
* Run each routine of an agent in its own thread by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4777
* Keep the local server window hidden by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4784
* Put the settings title and path in the window top row, and keep onboarding to three plan rows by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4786
* Let agents create and change channels by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4787
* Add the flat avatar style to the avatar editor by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4790
* Keep Grok's failed git start out of provider error toasts by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4791

* Remove the dark outline of the felt plushes in the light theme by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4804
* Start OpenBot on XWayland when a Wayland session has no monitor by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4807
* Show a new member's profile name in shared chats by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4810
* Lower the idle CPU use of the Dynamic Island by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4815
* Keep remote commentary in the thinking group by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4821
* Record the usage of Grok agents by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4830
* Keep a generation's result when Windows holds its temporary folder by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4832
* Give the saved Claude API key to generations without tools by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4833
* Keep the "Keep memories in this channel" setting when a channel is saved by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4849
* Name the missing member when a channel handoff is refused by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4850
* Report an MCP server whose command path does not exist by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4851
* Hold OpenCode notes from a channel until they are classified by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4854
* Give Claude its MCP servers in a file, not on the command line by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4859
* Show the outline on plush faces in a group avatar again by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4785

* Treat Grok's spent free usage as a plan limit by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4875
* Keep the home folder in Pi and Muse chats when Computer Use is on by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4878
* Write the Linux GPU log lines to main.log by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4880
* Run workflow conditions on a connected provider when ChatGPT is signed out by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4886
* Stop repeated compactions of a chat whose provider retries by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4891
* Give the quoted message to a channel member by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4888
* Hide channels and channel messages of agents that a member cannot see by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4892

* Add a model and effort picker to the workflow Condition step by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4915
* Show Markdown links in agent question cards in the mobile app by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4916
* Show spent plan limits in the mobile Runtime settings by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4918
* Read workflow handoffs with a title longer than 80 characters by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4922
* Add the Google User Data section to the privacy policy by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4919
* Say why a saved endpoint has no models in the Custom tab by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4917
* Keep the Usage page numbers inside their space by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4928
* Add chat colors for agents and for each user by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4933
* Show ask_ui decision cards reliably, and align the mobile cards with desktop by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4932
* Show the agent's text above a question that waits by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4903

* docs: add workspace versus chat history guide by @tomek-neony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4938

items.sourceText:
## Easier setup, more control over chats & tidier workspaces ✨

- 🎛️ **Choose Chat or Terminal from the start:** Onboarding now lets you pick Chat UI or Terminal, then choose an agent and install the skills for that setup.
- 💬 **Keep control of conversations:** Preserve chat inputs through uncertain delivery and Stop, choose whether sending moves the scroll position, and decide when idle chat agents stop—or keep them running.
- 🗂️ **Keep projects tidy:** Adding a project keeps discovered worktrees hidden, while create and clone handle symlinked parent folders consistently.
- 📝 **Make reading and editing your own:** Set the default Markdown view, optionally insert a final newline on save, and adjust chat width from pane headers.
- 📱 **A clearer phone Home:** The updated phone app separates Feed, Usage, Automations and Settings, shows more agent usage, and names recent conversations.
- 🧩 **Small fixes across daily work:** Keep terminal scroll position on input, open file links in their workspace, render Mermaid in PR comments, and close floating browser splits from their own toolbar.

## Highlights

- **Setup & skills:** Pick Chat or Terminal during onboarding, use the updated agent picker and theme step, and install Chat skills for the selected provider on this computer. Empty newly added projects can open the chosen Chat agent when that route is supported.
- **Chat behavior:** Inputs and queued follow-ups are retained through uncertain delivery and Stop. New settings control scroll position when sending and when idle chat agents stop. Loaded chat images stay visible across scrolling and workspace switches, and Pi compaction holds sends until it finishes.
- **Agent choices:** Managed Claude accounts keep later `/model` and effort choices when the defaults have not changed. Claude fallback is shown without changing saved model choices; OpenCode effort follows the selected model, and Claude chat adds Ultracode effort.
- **Projects & navigation:** Adding a project keeps discovered worktrees hidden. Project creation and cloning resolve symlinked parents consistently; manual workspace order and type-to-search in the new-workspace agent picker receive fixes.
- **Editor & browser:** Choose the default Markdown view, enable Insert Final Newline on save, preserve chat HTML appearance in file previews, and close a floating browser split without closing the terminal beside it.
- **Phone:** The updated app adds Home tabs, usage for more agents and conversation names in Jump back in. It also improves terminal input, effort controls, HTML previews and Android theme/navigation behavior.
- **Automation & notifications:** Automations use the shared agent picker, accept Pi model/thinking arguments and refresh when projects change. Interrupted terminal automation runs are recorded as failed, acknowledged desktop alerts clear, and OpenCode completion notifications handle OSC 7501.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Existing setup choices:** The new onboarding choices use existing surface and agent preferences. This release does not reset everyone's default agent or switch every existing workspace to Chat. A workspace with existing tabs keeps them; the new-project Chat path depends on a supported runtime and agent.
- **Chat settings:** Scroll-on-send and idle-agent stopping are configurable. Choose **Never** if you want idle chat agents to remain running; stopping an idle agent is separate from deleting the conversation.
- **Managed Claude accounts:** Unchanged defaults stop overwriting later account choices after settings synchronization. This does not recover choices overwritten by an older build, and changed default keys still apply.
- **Paired servers:** Improvements to paired-server file links use the new capability when available; older servers retain their existing path. There is no new minimum server version for the setup changes. GitHub issue limitations with older servers remain below.
- **Phone changes:** Native phone UI and Android fixes require an updated Orca Mobile app as well as a compatible desktop or server. The mobile changes are included in Orca Mobile 0.0.64; updating desktop alone does not install a native phone release.
- **Orchestration panel:** The experimental panel and its setting are temporarily disabled again. Orchestration messaging changes are separate from availability of that panel.

## Known issues

**Chat setup with no default agent:** With Chat UI enabled and the default agent cleared in Settings, Setup Guide's **Install skills** button can remain disabled without an explanation. Choose a default agent, such as Claude, before installing.

**Shell history after a cold restart:** Some Mac shell panes can reopen without showing their previous output after a full app and terminal restart. This class of failure was also observed on v1.4.248; the cause remains unresolved. This release does not claim to fix it.

**GitHub issues on older paired servers:** Opening an issue through a repository or URL can leave title, label and assignee editing unavailable. Phone issue Close/Reopen can also refuse an older server or intermediary. **Open on GitHub** remains available.

**Saved chat storage & performance:** Live-history compaction remains paused, so storage can grow as conversations continue. This release does not claim to remove every source of chat stalls. Hook changes reduce subprocess work, but whole-app latency, CPU and heap improvements were not measured.

**Long update delays:** With a 14- or 30-day delay, a release can leave the update feed before it becomes eligible. None and **Skip Delay Once** remain available.

**Plugin command replacements:** A plugin replacing a built-in command can still finish after Orca has used the normal command instead, causing the action to happen twice.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat

*Keep inputs available through interrupted delivery, adjust chat behavior, and make conversations easier to read.*

* Add chat width settings to pane headers by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37753
* Dismiss native chat link previews when opening links by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37911
* Keep question answers visible until delivery completes by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37883
* Fix OpenCode effort selection for the selected model by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37950
* Make links in chat questions clickable by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37992
* Add Ultracode to Claude chat effort by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38010
* Preserve chat inputs through uncertain delivery and Stop by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32267
* fix(native-chat): keep loaded chat images on screen across scroll and workspace switches by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38176
* fix(pi): show compaction in chat and hold sends until it ends by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38191
* feat(native-chat): add a setting to keep the scroll position when sending by @manuelmeurer in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38162
* feat(native-chat): let users pick when idle chat agents stop, or never by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38202
* Remove the New divider from Chat UI by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38044

### Agents & orchestration

*Choose Chat or Terminal during setup, keep provider choices intact, and improve agent messages and status.*

* fix(skills): rename computer use to orca-computer-use by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37659
* Show orchestration message content without the agent envelope by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37891
* update chat ui intro by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37924
* fix(agent-hooks): preserve Antigravity ownership across nested hooks by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37955
* fix(claude): reflect fallback without changing saved models by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37958
* Keep orchestration notices in one-line expandable cards by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37968
* Increase Orchestration panel and tab contrast by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37994
* Clarify account switching and session restart prompts by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38056
* fix(orchestration): a worktree a paired client starts on a remote server is that client's by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38034
* Deliver orchestration mail during active turns by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38041
* Remove redundant Show less buttons from agent cards by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38074
* Shrink orchestration message status backgrounds by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38079
* fix(ai-vault): show closed Antigravity chats in Agent Session History by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38203
* fix(claude-accounts): keep /model and effort choices on managed Claude accounts by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38219
* perf(agent-hooks): start 7 processes per Claude hook event instead of 17 by @rikbrown in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38180
* fix(notifications): notify when an OpenCode turn finishes over OSC 7501 by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38222
* Add Chat UI choice to onboarding by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36204
* feat(onboarding): theme step with color mode + optional theme carousel by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38021
* fix(claude): keep "Allow for this session" rules out of settings files by @King-Dylan in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37895

### Phone

*Improve Home navigation, usage visibility, chat controls and terminal input in the updated phone app.*

* fix(mobile): reopen workspace options at full width by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37919
* fix(mobile): check the upstream status reply before Sync decides whether to push by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37912
* Show failure Details in phone native chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37643
* Keep phone fork pull requests on their selected repository by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36762
* fix(mobile): type desktop replies from shared contracts and keep phone list facts beside the desktop row by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37917
* fix(mobile): keep the Android nav bar in step with Orca's theme by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37989

* feat(mobile): improve mobile terminal input by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37900
* fix(mobile): make the app icon full-bleed so iOS masks it cleanly by @tianlrz in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37074
* feat(mobile): show usage for every agent desktop tracks on the Accounts screen by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38187
* feat(mobile): title Jump back in rows with the conversation name by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38194
* fix(mobile): keep the effort control in one place for every model by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38200
* feat(mobile): split Home into Feed, Usage, Automations and Settings tabs by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38206

* fix(mobile): address android auto quit by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38226

items.sourceText:
We did two releases today! Be sure to check out the [v1.4.249 release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.249), which include easier Chat or Terminal setup, more control over conversations, and a redesigned phone Home.

## Lower terminal memory use, clearer chat changes & a Chrome-compatible password manager ✨

- ⚡ **Lower terminal memory use:** Stop repeatedly reading and parsing font files for terminal ligatures, fixing a source of high memory use and launch crashes in sessions with many terminals.
- ⚡ **Faster worktree switching:** Performance improvements make switching between worktrees faster.
- 📝 **See what agents changed:** Chat turns show changed files and line counts, with patches available inline on desktop and phone.
- 🔐 **Chrome-compatible password manager:** Enable in **Settings → Browser** to save, fill, import Chrome passwords, and manage logins, encrypted locally with your OS’s secure storage.
- 💬 **Chat UI keeps up with your agent:** Long, tool-heavy turns stay connected in Chat UI, and new chats follow your agent’s own model configuration unless you choose a model.
- 🖥️ **More reliable terminals and hosts:** Prevent stray escape-sequence text after terminal output gaps, and make paired-server workers and usage polling available on headless hosts.
- 📱 **Better phone continuity:** Send chat with Cmd/Ctrl+Enter and keep paired devices following the tabs they open.

## Highlights

- **Performance:** Worktree switching is faster. Terminal ligatures no longer parse an entire font for every terminal. In the PR’s Windows test with Commit Mono, 32 terminals relaunched without the previous out-of-memory crash; results depend on fonts and workload. Closing a tool in a long agent turn also avoids scanning every other live tool.
- **Chat:** Successful Claude and Codex edits appear as changed-file summaries in the conversation, with patch details loaded on selection. Chat UI no longer interrupts an otherwise healthy agent turn when it exceeds 128 live text or tool entries. Codex chats show requested wait durations and support goal pause, resume and clear.
- **Browser:** Save and fill logins in Orca’s browser and manage them in browser settings. Passwords use OS-backed encryption; the vault is unavailable when secure storage is unavailable.
- **Terminal & remote hosts:** Terminal stream recovery avoids printing partial escape sequences after output gaps. Headless hosts start the services needed for paired-server workers and usage polling.
- **Workspace & onboarding:** Choose Chat UI during onboarding, hide the onboarding checklist, find hidden discovered worktrees outside project grouping, and use the improved inactive workspace cleanup interface.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Terminal ligatures:** Common ligatures remain available. Font-specific ligatures outside the built-in list may no longer join with the GPU renderer.
- **Browser passwords:** The vault is available in the desktop browser, including local and SSH workspace pages; streamed paired-server pages and the web client do not have a vault. Secure OS encryption is required.
- **Chat model defaults:** A new chat without an explicit model choice uses the agent’s configuration. The displayed default can be stale until the agent starts and reports its model.
- **Terminal recovery:** Remote-runtime streams retain their existing recovery behavior.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat & agents

*Review changed files in context and keep longer agent turns moving.*

* fix(chat): keep pending workspace composers ready by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37954
* Show the requested wait duration in Codex chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37951
* fix(chat): show Codex image generation as generating while it runs by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38269
* Keep long agent turns alive beyond 128 timeline entries by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38257
* Show changed files directly in chat turns by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38256
* New chats run the agent's configured model when you haven't picked one by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38252
* fix(native-chat): let arrow keys reach a question card's answer field by @big-sheq in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38285
* fix(native-chat): run /goal pause, resume and clear in Codex chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38250
* fix(native-chat): show list numbers in folded chat messages by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38319
* fix(native-chat): wrap long answers in a question card's answer field by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38325
* fix(dictation): keep the transcript when you stop with the composer's stop button by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38327
* fix(native-chat): keep chat suggestions above the composer when the floating panel moves by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38322
* fix(native-chat): show @ and / suggestions above the agent setup submenu by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38328
* Keep a Pi chat awake while its background subagents run by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38207

### Terminals, performance & hosts

*Reduce terminal memory use and improve stream and headless host reliability.*

* fix(terminal): keep the ligature addon from reading font files by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38240
* fix(terminal): only resume a terminal stream where xterm is, so escape tails never print by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38049
* fix(orcad): stop the managed server crash-looping under a ulimit -v address-space limit by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38263
* fix(agent-state-rules): treat a 404 as nothing published, not a warning by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38278
* fix(serve): give headless hosts the services the desktop window path started by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37633
* fix(terminal): every terminal tab close declares who asked; no implied user close by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38284
* Use the shared agent picker for terminal quick commands by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38213

### Browser

*Save logins and improve remote workspace browser behavior.*

* fix(browser): stop terminal links in remote workspaces showing the agent glow by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38262
* feat(browser): save and fill passwords in Orca's browser by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33994

### Phone & paired devices

*Keep chat input and tab navigation consistent across devices.*

* fix(mobile): send chat with Cmd/Ctrl+Enter by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38267
* Keep the phone's chat Send button the same as desktop while the agent works by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38317
* fix(session-tabs): paired devices follow every tab they open, not just the first by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38336

### Workspaces, onboarding & automations

*Make setup, workspace navigation and automation runs easier.*

* Add Chat UI choice to onboarding by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36204
* Add hide button to onboarding checklist by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38241
* fix(right-sidebar): hide the previous worktree's panels while a workspace is created by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38261
* fix(automations): let Run Now start without checking the GitHub source tool by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38029
* Say where to switch back from Chat UI wherever Orca turns it on by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38243
* fix(sidebar): show hidden discovered worktrees outside project grouping by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38231
* fix(sidebar): extend the workspace list scrollbar hit area past the seam by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38288
* Align grouped workspace cards with sidebar headers by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38245
* Improve inactive workspace cleanup interface and add repository indicator by @Jingyue-Wu in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38281

### Tests, CI & maintenance

*Maintain tests and cross-version checks.*

* Remove 129 low-value test cases and 45 whole suites by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38233
* Remove 382 low-value test cases and 46 whole suites by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38238
* Remove 552 low-value test registrations and 58 whole suites by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38255
* test(cross-version): resolve moved shared modules in release checkouts by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38270
* test(e2e): layout oracle restart comparison honors terminalsRestart by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38271
* test: remove low-value renderer suites by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38276
* test: remove low-value renderer suites and unused fixtures by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38292
* test: remove low-value renderer suites and orphaned harnesses by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38299
* test: remove low-value renderer followup suites by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38310
* test: remove low-value launch palette and tour suites by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38316
* test: remove low-value account and surface settings suites by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/38323

items.try: 更新版のCLIを検証環境で試し、既存のスキル・設定・MCP接続に影響がないか確認してください。

items.sourceText:
## What's changed

- Added a record of your answer when Claude Code asks to turn on the mods it writes in a session
- Added `assume_role` on `mantle` upstreams of the Claude apps gateway, for a role in another AWS account and for per-developer AWS cost attribution
- Added an `effort` option to a mod's `$.model.fork`, so a quick side job can run at `low` whatever effort the session uses; the result reports the effort sent
- Added the date a stored claude.ai sign-in ends to `claude auth status` (`loginExpiresAt`) and to `claude -p` JSON results (`credential_expires_at`)
- Added a one-line stderr warning to `claude -p` text output, starting 10 days before a stored claude.ai sign-in ends
- Fixed `--continue` sometimes losing the earlier conversation after a malformed tool call's retries ran out (regression in 2.1.314)
- Fixed macOS sessions with many running Bash commands stalling while memory grew
- Fixed permission prompts being answered by keys typed just after sending a message, or before a slow prompt appeared
- Fixed `/logout`, `claude auth logout` and `claude mcp remove` reporting success, and changes to trust, consent or MCP settings being dropped with no word, when the config file could not be updated on a shared network home directory
- Fixed jobs exiting with `Not logged in` when another terminal or host signs in again to the same account and organization on the same home
- Fixed `claude mcp add` and `remove` writing the config without its lock: they now wait for it or exit 1, though another job's save can still replace a saved server
- Fixed `claude plugin` commands exiting before a slow token refresh was saved, which could sign you out on the next run
- Fixed `claude plugin validate` passing a custom-named marketplace file that `claude plugin marketplace add` rejects
- Fixed stdio MCP servers that exit on the version probe being re-probed on every start; a server that dies in under 3s for its own reason is also pinned to the legacy handshake for 7 days
- Fixed sessions being refused at startup by an `allowedProviders` list that another login on the same machine had stored
- Fixed idle compaction replacing a conversation with a reply that was not a summary
- Fixed the "Now using usage credits" notice reappearing about every 30 seconds while a background subagent is running
- Fixed custom slash commands that fail, or that only Claude can invoke, printing nothing in `claude -p` and SDK sessions
- Fixed `claude -p` and Agent SDK sessions reporting success when an API error cut off a reply while a mod hooked `turn.step`
- Fixed a message sent right after a model change still running after Stop in headless sessions: Stop now cancels or stops it as it would a queued message
- Fixed a deleted session transcript being re-created with its last prompt when an idle non-interactive session exited
- Fixed `claude remote-control` hosts, the background daemon and self-hosted runners failing to start new sessions (`spawn ENOENT`) after an update or version cleanup removed the binary of a still-running process
- Fixed a running Claude Code process owned by another user (for example one left by `sudo claude`) being treated as dead by version cleanup, which could delete its binary
- Fixed `/remote-control` showing a session as available after a failed connection
- Fixed `/design revoke` reporting success when the request failed with a 404
- Fixed a shell command approved after a self-hosted runner or cloud session restart running in the session's start folder, not the folder it was asked in; if that folder can't be entered, it is not run
- Fixed Claude not being told when an approved connector tool was unavailable after a cloud session restart
- Fixed cloud sessions being stopped in the middle of a turn when the service refuses uploads for several minutes
- Fixed variables a `Setup` hook writes to `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` not reaching the Bash tool in some cloud sessions
- Fixed the iPhone app showing a cloud session's turn as finished while it kept running, after a response was cut off at a tool call or a refused image or document was removed
- Fixed a restarted session re-sending a message that failed with an API error, ahead of the newer message waiting behind it
- Fixed a restarted session dropping its interrupted turn when the restart came right after Claude read a large image or retried a tool call
- Fixed every connection failing when the `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` file is empty, not PEM, or starts with a damaged certificate: readable certificates are now used, with a warning on stderr
- Fixed workflows re-running finished agents when resumed after a usage limit
- Fixed `/mcp` in cloud sessions counting tools the model can't use; a server's row now shows how many of its tools are available
- Fixed a duplicate notification when Claude left the status field out of a PushNotification call
- Fixed the error for a too-large image in a request with more than 20 images always saying the limit was 2000px; it now shows the API's limit
- Fixed the runtime in background shell details not updating while the dialog is open
- Fixed a mod's `turn.step` hook making a stopped reply finish as a success in headless runs
- Fixed retention cleanup leaving a home that only runs `claude -p` with no `~/.claude.json` backup: it now takes a fresh backup before deleting the last good one
- Fixed the stored login being replaced by an empty file when a network home directory has no room left for data but still takes new files
- Fixed tokens from `setup-token` being refused at start on machines with `forceLoginOrgUUID`, when the token belongs to a permitted organization
- Fixed non-interactive launches replacing a `~/.claude.json` that isn't valid JSON with defaults; the start now fails, says how to restore the file, and leaves it as is (anthropics/claude-code#87551)
- Fixed an empty `~/.claude.json` with no backup being reported as corrupted; Claude Code now starts as it does when the file is missing
- Fixed the restore command printed for a damaged or missing `~/.claude.json` naming an empty or cut-off backup, or failing on a read-only file
- Fixed the sign-in failure when a stored claude.ai login reaches its time limit: it now says so, and in `claude -p` names `claude auth login` and `claude setup-token`
- Improved how `~/.claude.json`, settings files and the stored login survive saves on shared network home directories: they are less often deleted, briefly emptied or replaced by a near-empty or older copy
- Improved sessions on network file systems to look again when the configuration file is wrongly reported as missing, so fewer start without your MCP servers and trusted folders
- Improved MCP tool errors: a call made before the tool is loaded now returns its input schema
- Improved the reliability of git commits and pull request creation when the Bash tool runs macOS's built-in `/bin/bash`
- Improved "Ask your admin for more usage" in the usage limit menu to send the request in one step
- Improved how fast remote sessions reconnect after a pause or sleep
- Improved You should know toasts to say "try again" instead of "press 2", which only works in the terminal
- Improved auto-update reliability: a brief network failure while verifying a release is now retried right away instead of waiting for the next check
- Improved unattended runs (`claude -p`, SDK apps) to stop rewriting `~/.claude.json` on every run when nothing in it changed
- Changed Claude Code to no longer install or update the IDE extension when started in an IDE terminal; use `/ide` from an outside terminal or your editor's extensions view
- Changed subagents to stop instead of switching models when "Switch models when a message is flagged" is set to "Ask each time"
- Changed background subagents to move a shell command to the background after 3 minutes on all providers, so the prompt cache doesn't expire while it runs
- Changed subagent progress summaries on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or with telemetry off: on a cold prompt cache, one can now wait up to 5 minutes for the subagent's pending response
- Changed what a mod attaches at `prompt.submit` to stay in the user's turn rather than go out as a system message
- Changed `deniedMcpServers` URL entries to also block Anthropic-provided servers whose upstream URL matches, and connectors in cloud sessions and on self-hosted runners, where the session is given the connector's own URL; otherwise deny a connector by name
- Changed the `/permissions` rule details, built-in rules and delete confirmation views to use the standard dialog; pressing Ctrl+C twice there now goes back or cancels instead of quitting
- Changed `/claude-api managed-agents-onboard` to give a new agent's built-in tools, and a quickstart template's MCP tools, the `auto` permission policy ("Judge risky actions") by default, matching the Claude Console; say "run without asking" to opt out
- Removed the 2.1.288 fix that kept the model's earlier thinking when resuming a conversation started on 2.1.286 or earlier; that thinking can now be dropped
- Gateway: Added a log warning when the Google access token from a federation (`external_account`) credentials file is about to expire
- Gateway: Improved the log hints about `listen.trusted_proxies`: they now say to list only a proxy that adds the connecting address to `X-Forwarded-For` itself
- Gateway: Improved the warning when AWS CountTokens fails on Amazon Bedrock: it says Claude Code, not the gateway, counts after the 501, and points at IAM only when AWS denies access
- Self-hosted runner: Added `CLAUDE_RUNNER_SPAWN_REASON` to the orchestrator's spawn-runner hook environment: why Anthropic sent the request (e.g. `runner_lost`, `resumed`); unset when none was sent
- Self-hosted runner: Added a startup warning when `--release-idle-session-min` is the last argument with no value (still ignored) or has a value of only spaces (still read as `0`)
- Self-hosted runner: Changed the orchestrator's log lines: `ok session=…` now prints at every log level on stdout (was debug only, stderr) with `reason=…` after `jti=…`, and `nack session=…` ends its fields with `reason=…` after `retryable=…`; update scripts that match `retryable=true:` or `retryable=false:`
- Remote Control: Fixed a misleading "spawn error: ENOENT" when a session's working folder is missing; the error now names the folder
- Remote Control: Improved the title a fork of a terminal fork is created with when the app doesn't set one: "Name (fork 2)"
- [VSCode] Fixed a window whose sign-in the organization's settings refuse starting a new Claude Code process in the background every minute
- [VSCode] Fixed a long word in the chat panel's error banner pushing its close button out of view
- [VSCode] Improved the sign-in screen to show what Claude Code printed when its sign-in status check fails
- [Cloud sessions] Added a No repository option: a cloud session on an Anthropic-hosted environment can now start without picking a repository
- [Cloud sessions] Added the usual Chrome names to cloud sessions, so tools other than Playwright can find the built-in Chromium through google-chrome and CHROME_PATH
- [Cloud sessions] Added a New session button to the card shown when a cloud session's environment was deleted, where the message box is hidden
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed reading GitHub Actions logs in cloud sessions: `gh run view --log` and `gh api` log requests now get the log in most environments, not an unreachable redirect
- [Cloud sessions] Improved most Create PR failure messages in cloud and Remote Control sessions: they now give the reason or a link to GitHub instead of saying Try again
- [Cloud sessions] Changed connector search results to tell Claude that the search covers only part of the connector directory
- [Remote Control] Fixed side-by-side checkouts of one repository looking identical in the environment menu's Remote Control rows; each now shows its own folder name
- [Claude Tag] Fixed keyboard focus and screen reader announcements in C

## More reliable terminals, dependable chats & easier AI choices ✨

- 🖥️ **More reliable terminals:** Keep active remote streams connected, preserve agent identity across daemon restarts, improve ordered mobile input and long messages to Windows Codex, and render Nerd Font symbols correctly after fonts load.
- 💬 **More dependable conversations:** Keep streaming replies after their prompts, hold queued follow-ups when a turn fails, and keep pasted text and terminal drafts separate from chat sends.
- 🎛️ **Choose how AI writes for you:** Pick Model and Effort for commit messages, pull-request descriptions, branch names and chat names from the Source Control settings.
- ⚡ **Less unnecessary chat work:** Preview updates avoid copying the full loaded conversation, and this release removes the live-history cleanup that could stall large chats.
- 📱 **Better phone continuity:** Reopen chats from cached messages, keep options current, and send long messages to Windows Codex more reliably.
- ⏳ **Choose when updates arrive:** Add an optional update delay in Settings, with a one-time option to skip the wait.
- 📝 **Editor & workspace improvements:** Opt into format on save, search theme pickers, and use familiar right-click actions on chat tabs.

## Highlights

- **Terminals:** Remote streams stay connected while output is flowing, agent identity survives daemon restarts, mobile input is pipelined in order, and long phone messages reach Windows Codex. Nerd Font symbols repaint once fonts load, and closed terminal workers can reopen from their orchestration cards.
- **Chat continuity:** Streaming replies stay after the prompt they answer. Follow-ups remain queued after a failed turn, expired attachments are identified when a send is refused, and pasted text can be opened from structured chats.
- **Agent startup & choices:** A final startup refusal is shown after the first attempt instead of repeated retries; temporary failures still recover. Chats preserve configured effort when you have not chosen an override, and Source Control text actions use Model and Effort menus.
- **Phone:** Cached chats reopen before fetching changes. Chat options, terminal settings, branch and pull-request details refresh more reliably; long phone messages reach Windows Codex, and browser tabs hosted by a desktop server can stream to the phone.
- **Updates & Windows:** Choose an update delay, retain a moved Windows installation's location during updates, and get a clearer explanation when installation is incomplete.
- **Editor & navigation:** Enable format on save, search theme choices, highlight selected Markdown table cells, and use image zoom shortcuts outside editor tabs.
- **Orchestration & plugins:** The Orchestration panel is available again as an experimental opt-in. Closed terminal workers can reopen from their cards, native chats receive complete orchestration messages, and enabled status bar plugins keep their workers running.
- **Performance & reliability:** Chat preview updates avoid a redundant full-history copy, cached text scrolling avoids whole-file layout updates, and diagnostic logging uses less data. The preview change removes unnecessary work; no whole-app latency improvement is claimed.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Update delay is optional:** Settings → General → Updates offers None, 1, 3, 7, 14 or 30 days. None remains the default, and **Skip Delay Once** bypasses a held update.
- **Format on save is optional:** Existing editing behavior stays the same until you enable it.
- **Orchestration panel:** This release restores the experimental opt-in after the earlier panel disablement.
- **Phone changes:** Phone app changes require an updated Orca Mobile app as well as a compatible desktop or server.
- **Saved chat history:** The live-history cleanup added earlier has been rolled back. Existing saved conversations, including already-compacted histories, remain readable.

## Known issues

**Saved chat storage:** Live-history compaction is paused, so chat storage can grow as conversations continue. This release does not claim to remove every source of chat stalls.

**Long update delays:** With a 14- or 30-day delay, a release can leave the update feed before it becomes eligible. None and **Skip Delay Once** remain available.

**GitHub issues on older paired servers:** Opening an issue through a repository or URL can leave title, label and assignee editing unavailable. Local and project-origin routes are unaffected; **Open on GitHub** remains available.

**Plugin command replacements:** A plugin replacing a built-in command can still finish after Orca has used the normal command instead, causing the action to happen twice.

---

items.sourceText:
# Hermes Agent v0.22.7

**Release Date:** November 3, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~174 PRs merged since v0.22.6 into a stable release for the GitHub release (CLI and installers), the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.23.0.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## About this release

Measured at commit `b200f5bc60e`, the window since v0.22.6 contains **581 non-merge commits** across **554 changed files** (+24,012 / −3,144), **174 merged PRs** and **29 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: opt-in lead routing for Desktop Group Chats (with a Lead badge on the room header), cron jobs that post into Group Chats, room purpose and shared notes, group rooms laid out in one chat column with each member's live state, pinned Kanban boards as quick-switch tabs, `$$TeX$$` diagram labels and mermaid diagrams rendered through Pele, a Desktop update error box that shows the failed update's output with a report link, Web Access naming the step Start is on with a running clock, Telegram on Team Gateway set up by linking an account to the shared bot, an opt-in Slack `thread_followup_silence` for unaddressed thread replies, a Daybreak switch for catalog-listed ChatGPT subscription models, and a batch of new plugin-catalog entries.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.23.0**, which will document everything from v0.22.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Updating

- Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
- Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: [v0.22.6...v0.22.7](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v0.22.6...v0.22.7)

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.317：公式リリース
items.summary: 主な話題：不具合修正、モデル対応、MCP・外部連携。キーワードに基づく日本語の暫定分類です。具体的な変更内容と提供条件は公式原文で確認してください。
items.why: 現在使っているコーディングエージェントの操作性・信頼性に関わる更新です。MCPやCLIと組み合わせた作業への影響を確認できます。
items.try: 更新版のCLIを検証環境で試し、既存のスキル・設定・MCP接続に影響がないか確認してください。
items.availability: プラン・地域・アプリ/CLIの対応条件は公式ページで確認が必要です。
items.sourceText:
## What's changed

- Added a warning to `/schedule` when a new cloud scheduled task gets connectors you did not ask for, with how to remove them
- Added a check that asks before a web or shell tool call sends your account email address to the network
- Added `onFailure: "block"` for Agent SDK hook callbacks, so a callback that fails blocks the action instead of letting it run
- Added a notice in Claude Desktop's Code tab when your organization's remote managed settings haven't loaded for the session, and another once they do
- Added a notice when auto mode's check has no answer for a subagent's tool call, which used to leave nothing in the main view
- Added `anthropic.plan`, `anthropic.seat_type`, `anthropic.provider` and `anthropic.custom_base_url` to OTel metrics, events and spans
- Added a cost report to the Claude apps gateway admin API, `GET /v1/organizations/analytics/cost`, for reading past spend over a date range in total, per developer, per day or per IdP group
- Added a daily record of each developer's IdP groups on Claude apps gateways with `admin:` set, kept for `admin.identity_retention_days`, which the cost report groups by
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_SESSION_ID`: set it to `1` on a self-hosted runner to have `claude -p` run inside a session use that session's ID and transcript, as in earlier versions
- Fixed project and local MCP servers disconnecting after the first turn in some Claude desktop sessions
- Fixed auto mode failing every turn when an LLM gateway set as the base URL answers 403 or 422 to its server-side safety check (a 403 with an apiKeyHelper is unchanged)
- Fixed `claude auth status` exiting before a slow token refresh was saved, which could sign you out on the next run
- Fixed a project's `effortLevel` setting being ignored by sessions that an app starts ahead of time and then opens in the project, such as new sessions in the desktop app's Code tab
- Fixed `claude --from-pr` reporting "No conversations found" in projects with many sessions when the linked session was older than the first page
- Fixed the second of two simultaneous permission prompts showing no file path or command on claude.ai and the mobile apps
- Fixed Remote Control and SDK hosts offering "don't ask again" on a mod's tool calls
- Fixed session titles being lost in cloud and SDK sessions when a new message or Stop arrived while the title was generating
- Fixed self-paced `/loop` wakeups sometimes not being scheduled when Claude left a field out of its request
- Fixed auto mode in cloud sessions stopping for approval when the Artifact tool uploaded, wrote to a database or saved a file through the outputs folder
- Fixed skills synced from claude.ai being lost or downloaded again every ten minutes when they can't be written to disk
- Fixed `/schedule` leaving a cloud scheduled task's next run time and link out of its results after creating or updating it
- Fixed screen readers speaking a running subagent's elapsed time and token count on every change in screen reader mode
- Fixed a region or network block (HTTP 403) being shown as a sign-in failure; the error now explains the block
- Fixed Claude saying a working claude.ai connector needed authorization or had failed in cloud sessions when a synced plugin included the same server
- Fixed `claude -p` exiting 0 when a full disk or quota lost its transcript or ~/.claude.json writes; it now prints an error and, in text and json output, exits 1. Full NFS exports may be missed
- Fixed edits to settings files made in the first second or so after launch not taking effect until a settings file changed again
- Fixed old transcripts not being cleaned up on machines where some runs skip cleanup, such as runs using `--setting-sources`
- Fixed deleted agent team inboxes being re-created by a teammate's late message
- Fixed a re-created agent teammate being removed from its team by an earlier shutdown approval
- Fixed stored scheduled tasks being impossible to list or delete after scheduled tasks were turned off
- Fixed Claude deleting your most recently updated `/team-onboarding` guide when asked to delete one without naming which
- Fixed Claude saying a `/team-onboarding` guide was deleted when the server refused the delete
- Fixed the Claude apps gateway hiding Amazon Bedrock's "Input is too long." error, which left sessions failing every turn with "upstream rejected the request" instead of compacting
- Fixed self-hosted runner sessions losing recent turns or the whole conversation when restarted while a plan waited for approval
- Fixed "Prompt is too long" after automatic compaction in sessions whose very large CLAUDE.md changed since it was last sent
- Fixed high memory use and slow startup in headless sessions with many plugins that register commands
- Fixed stdio MCP servers receiving an empty `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` when their env config sets it to empty; the variable is now unset, so the server can use the machine's own AWS credentials
- Fixed API requests failing with "unable to get local issuer certificate" behind some TLS-inspecting proxies after a root certificate renewal
- Fixed very long conversations losing their earlier summary when compaction had to shorten its own request
- Fixed a PDF's own metadata being able to make Read and @-mentions under-count its pages
- Fixed `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_OPUS` and `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_SONNET` having no effect on `[1m]`, other-region and undated spellings of the default model
- Fixed `/artifacts` and the Artifact tool's shared list showing no shared artifacts when you have 200 or more of your own
- Fixed Claude treating partial Grep and Glob results as complete when a search hit its time limit
- Fixed OpenTelemetry exports to an `https://` endpoint through a proxy never being sent when they started while another export was still in progress
- Fixed a flood of connection attempts to a proxy that blocks (HTTP 403) OpenTelemetry exports to an `http://` endpoint
- Fixed OpenTelemetry exports hanging indefinitely behind a proxy that never answers; they now time out after 10 seconds, or `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TIMEOUT` up to 30 seconds
- Fixed resumed sessions telling Claude again about a file change it already knew about
- Fixed Claude sometimes not using a built-in tool in a resumed session after an earlier call failed because the tool was switched off
- Fixed `/remote-control` answering "Unknown command" instead of saying that Remote Control is turned off by the `disableRemoteControl` setting
- Fixed agent team teammates in tmux or iTerm2 panes starting in auto mode when the lead session was in manual mode
- Fixed a background session sometimes losing a just-made change of permission mode when it was upgraded or retired
- Fixed Ctrl+C stopping all running background agents when pressed to clear typed text at the prompt
- Fixed /feedback showing "Enter to confirm" while a report is being sent
- Fixed child processes of a stopped shell command sometimes being sent SIGTERM twice, which could make some programs skip their cleanup
- Fixed `claude -p` run inside a cloud or self-hosted runner session sharing that session's ID: it wrote into the session's transcript, and a restart could resume the wrong conversation
- Fixed `claude -p` run inside a cloud or self-hosted runner session generating a title of its own and sending it to that session
- Improved the error shown on Microsoft Foundry when Azure credentials can't be loaded: it now says to check or refresh them, and reports as `cloud_credential_error`
- Improved `/design-sync` to say up front when your design system has moved to Claude, and stop before building instead of failing at upload
- Improved the startup error when a required Claude apps gateway can't be reached: it points to the network instead of a sign-in, and says when the gateway's TLS certificate can't be verified
- Improved the "Resume this session with" hint shown at exit to repeat the flags you launched with (for example `--chrome --debug`) ahead of `--resume`
- Improved how self-hosted runners recover from server errors: after a 5xx other than 501 or 529, a runner's next poll now opens a new connection instead of reusing the one that failed
- Improved how self-hosted runner sessions recover from server errors: after a 5xx other than 501 or 529, a session now opens new connections instead of reusing the one that failed
- Improved how self-hosted runner sessions recover when connections stop answering: after a heartbeat gets no answer, a session now opens new connections instead of trying each idle one in turn
- Changed SendMessage so a message to a running background agent arrives earlier: its running command moves to the background, without being stopped
- Changed subagents and teammates on a different model from the main conversation to use that model's saved effort level or its default, instead of the session's effort level
- Changed exit to skip the "Background work is running" prompt for plugin monitors
- Changed the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill to offer once, after a mod you built works, to help share the mod
- Removed the Read tool's "file unchanged since your last Read" stub: reading an unchanged file again returns its content
- Windows: Fixed every tool call being refused on some volumes where the native path lookup fails; the working-directory check now compares the folder's identity instead
- Windows: Fixed the session scratchpad and other temporary paths growing with your project's path length in sessions not started by Claude Desktop, which made repositories cloned into them hit the 260-character path limit
- Gateway: Fixed the status line and `/usage` showing a developer's own spend limit as 100% used after their group's pooled budget ran out
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed Claude not seeing the interrupted tool call when a session moves to a new runner and the turn is older than `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN_MAX_AGE_MS`
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed an MCP server that was switched off coming back on after the session moved to a new machine, when the session service had refused to save the switch
- Remote Control: Improved fork names when the app doesn't set one: a long name keeps its "(fork)" ending, and in sessions started with `claude remote-control` a fork of "Name (fork)" is "Name (fork 2)"
- [VSCode] Fixed forked conversations dropping messages: only one of the tool calls Claude ran in parallel was kept, and the last messages a compaction kept were lost, which could leave Claude's answer without the question it answered
- [VSCode] Fixed a message being lost when Claude did not finish starting in time: the extension now starts Claude once more before showing the error
- [VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen opening when a request is blocked for its region or network
- [VSCode] Fixed the Account panel showing the plan name with a lower-cased second word
- [VSCode] Fixed file links in a Claude tab opening on top of the chat instead of in another editor group
- [VSCode] Fixed attachment chips, menus, banners and dialogs in the Claude panel staying small when `chat.fontSize` is raised
- [VSCode] Fixed `ultrathink` not raising effort for its turn or showing its rainbow when telemetry is off
- [Cloud sessions] Added a link card to cloud sessions, so you can open or decline a link an MCP server asks you to visit instead of the request going unseen
- [Cloud sessions] Changed the organization environment dialog in admin settings to the personal dialogs' short layout: each section opens from a row, and unsaved input asks before closing
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed adding a network secret for a host that already has one silently replacing it; the Add secret form now refuses and points you to the existing secret
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed new scheduled tasks ignoring your organization's default environment: the form now starts on the one an admin chose instead of the Anthropic-hosted default
- [Remote Control] Fixed the next message to an idle session going un

details.basis: 日次レポートをAnthropic公式リリースノートで照合しました。使い方は本人向けの検証案です。
details.change: Agent SDKのフックに onFailure: "block" が加わりました。Webやシェルがアカウントのメールアドレスを外部へ送る前に確認を出し、/schedule では指定外のコネクターが付くと警告します。
details.before: SDKのフック処理が失敗した際に、対象の操作が続行される場合がありました。
details.after: 対象フックで onFailure: "block" を設定すると、コールバックの失敗時に対象操作をブロックできます。定期タスクのコネクターは警告を見て確認できます。
details.workflow: WindowsのAI作業用PCで、SNS投稿やコード編集を任せる前に、公開のテストデータでフックの成功・失敗を切り替え、意図した操作だけが進むか検証する。
steps: claude --version と、使用中のAgent SDKのバージョンをそれぞれ記録する。
SDKの対象バージョンでフック設定を確認し、検証フォルダ内だけを対象にする。意図的にフックを失敗させ、対象ファイルの変更が止まるかを比較する。
/schedule でクラウド定期タスクを設定するときは、確定する前に警告とコネクターの一覧を確認する。
details.benefit: 5/5。権限や接続先を先に確認できるため、開発やPC操作をエージェントへ任せる際の検証に直結します。
details.environment: フックは対応するAgent SDKが必要です。CLIやクラウド定期タスクの機能、SDKの認証・課金条件はそれぞれ確認してください。
details.limitations: 全操作が自動で保護されるわけではありません。対象フックの実装、適用されるツール、OSごとの動作は検証環境で確認が必要です。

items.sourceText:
## What's Changed
* build(nix): install OpenBot 0.58.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4369
* Keep the modes of a hosted release after a boat wake by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4373
* Show the Usage chart again by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4429
* Ask for a GitHub star after the third agent message by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4432
* Continue an agent turn that stops before its next step by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4431
* Show the context meter and compact Pi agents at 80% by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4433
* Answer 200 to Slack chatter for a host that is not connected by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4436
* Give slow MCP servers 10 seconds to start in Codex by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4437
* Show the next queued message with its actions above the iPhone composer by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4426
* Show the settings that Cursor fixes for each model by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4438
* Name the frame when a secure input field is in a same-site frame by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4439
* Wait for a file import only in the chat that gets the file by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4440
* Show the agent picture on iOS and Android notifications by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4435
* Allow SVG attachments in chat by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4441
* Move to the backup model when a Gemini quota is spent by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4446
* Add an Android adaptive icon with a themed layer by @jbaehova in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4423
* Renew the host Signal socket after sleep, and keep a phone copy of agents and chats by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4444
* Add Kimi as a provider by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4450

details.change: ローカルのHermes AgentがOpenBotのACPプロバイダーに加わりました。Geminiの利用枠到達時のバックアップ切り替えを修正し、Codexの任意MCPサーバーの起動待機を1秒から最大10秒に延ばしました。
details.before: Hermesはプロバイダー一覧から選べず、Geminiの特定の利用上限エラーはバックアップを設定していても失敗しました。起動が遅い任意MCPはCodexの初回処理で見えないことがありました。
details.after: インストール済みHermesと既存プロファイルが使えます。自動切り替えの条件を満たすと、Geminiの書き出し前の利用上限エラーでバックアップへ移ります。
details.workflow: Macで公開情報からSNS下書きを作る検証をHermesで試し、OpenBot再起動後に続きを依頼する。Codexでは読み取り専用のMCPツールを最初のターンで呼び出す。
steps: OpenBotを対象版に更新し、hermes --version でローカルCLIを確認する。
Nous Portalを使うなら hermes auth add nous、別のモデル接続なら hermes setup で設定し、OpenBotでHermesを選ぶ。
テスト用エージェントで会話し、アプリ再起動後に文脈が戻るか確認する。
Geminiの切り替えを試す場合はバックアップモデルを設定して Ask before switching をオフにする。自然に上限に達したときだけ、書き出し前のエラーで切り替わるかをログで確認する。
details.benefit: 5/5。日常のエージェント切り替えとCodexのMCP利用に直接関係し、失敗した作業を手動でやり直す手間を減らせる可能性があります。
details.environment: ローカルのHermes CLIと利用するモデルの認証が必要です。開発者はHermes 0.21.5とNous Portal無料枠で検証しました。
details.limitations: 開発者はHermesのWindows/Linux実機と、実アカウントで利用枠を使い切った状態を未検証です。Geminiの修正範囲は書き出し前のエラーで、MCPの起動待機延長はCodexエージェント向けです。
