items.sourceText:
## Improved Chat UI, richer phone reviews & more ways to make Orca yours ✨

- 🔄 **Continue after usage limits reset:** An optional setting resumes your chat automatically when its usage limit resets.
- 📱 **Richer reviews on your phone:** Browse branch commits, jump between files in diffs, and read or add pull-request review comments alongside the code.
- 🎨 **Make Orca yours:** Discover more themes, preview fonts in their own typefaces, and import Ghostty or Kitty configuration files.
- 🧩 **More powerful plugins:** Build custom editors, live status items and panels, and connect plugins to agent prompts, launches and workspace actions.
- 🤝 **Clearer agent activity:** Running workers stay visible after their coordinator finishes, with easier account switching and clearer hand-off cards.
- ⚡ **Smoother everyday work:** Fewer unnecessary redraws and offscreen animations, more reliable saved replies, and fixes for workspaces, terminals and emulator previews.
- 💬 **Improved Chat UI:** Choose Chat or CLI for each agent in Chat UI settings, keep drafts when continuing from a terminal, and see your selected permission mode clearly.

## Highlights

- **Chat UI:** Choose Chat or CLI for each agent directly in Chat UI settings. Permission choices stay visible, model and effort controls remain usable while options refresh, and focusing the composer keeps open overlays in place.
- **Conversation continuity:** Keep unsent text when moving from a terminal into chat, and preserve received replies and tool results while saving is busy. Turn on automatic continuation to resume a chat after its usage limit resets.
- **Phone source control:** Review each branch commit on its own page, jump between files, fold diff context, and read or add review comments alongside the code. The pull-request tab focuses on what blocks the merge, with clearer next actions and automatic refreshes.
- **Themes & fonts:** Find GitHub, VS Code and catalog themes in the appearance controls. Preview each font in its own typeface, import Ghostty themes with light/dark pairs, and bring in Kitty configuration files too.
- **Plugins:** Create custom editors that keep pending edits through saves and reloads, live status bar items, and component panels with a Box layout container. Hooks connect plugins to agent launches, prompts, tool calls, terminal sends and workspace creation; screenshot and testing tools help check the result.
- **Agents & orchestration:** Running workers remain in the Agents list after their coordinator finishes. Hand-off cards make delegated work easier to follow, and Codex and Claude account switchers are simpler to use.
- **Remote work & workspaces:** Preview remote HTML outside registered workspaces, find projects in stopped WSL distros after a restart, and see clearer Git progress. Child worktrees stay in the caller’s project, folder roots remain visible, and branch links open the current pull request.
- **Responsiveness & reliability:** Offscreen animations pause, unrelated settings changes cause fewer diff redraws, and unused editor models are released. Terminal fixes prevent stray escape text, while emulator previews offer clearer connection and startup feedback.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Chat or CLI per agent:** Chat UI is out of Experimental. Shared launch controls are also available in Settings → Chat UI, so you can choose which surface each agent opens.
- **Automatic continuation is optional:** Enable it if you want a usage-limited chat to continue automatically after the limit resets.
- **Phone Send behavior:** The phone follows the paired desktop’s send setting. Update Orca Mobile as well as your desktop or server to get the mobile changes.
- **Orchestration panel:** The experimental Orchestration panel is disabled while its app-wide lag is addressed. Orchestration commands continue to work.

## Known issues

**Saved chat storage:** Chat history can continue to use more disk space as conversations grow; automatic storage compaction is not included in this release.

**Plugin command replacements:** A plugin replacing a built-in command can still finish after Orca has used the normal command instead, causing the action to happen twice.

---

### Automations

*Choose whether automation setup runs, and avoid launching a wake that was cancelled.*

* Add run and skip setup choices to the automation CLI by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36543

### Native chat

*Choose Chat or CLI from Chat UI settings, keep drafts and replies intact, and use an optional automatic continuation after usage limits reset.*

* Show split shortcut in pane header tooltip by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36872
* Show a card in the chat when its agent hands work to another agent by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36848
* Move chat readers to the newest saved step after a no-op save by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37118

### Agents, integrations & orchestration

*Keep workers visible after their coordinator finishes, switch accounts more clearly, and see the selected permission and effort choices.*

* Say kept-open workers stay open, and hide no-action attention in worker-list by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36963

* Keep Fast preferences independent of routing availability by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37194

* Simplify and improve Codex and Claude account switchers by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37255

* Record a Claude terminal's process even when Orca saw Claude before its first hook by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36825
* Disable the lagging experimental orchestration panel by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37527

details.change: 主な話題：安全性・権限管理、モデル対応、エージェントの作業・設定。キーワードに基づく日本語の暫定分類です。具体的な変更内容と提供条件は公式原文で確認してください。
details.before: 旧版の具体的な挙動は取得した本文だけでは確認できません。比較結果は未確認です。
details.after: 「Orca v1.4.247：公式リリース」で案内された範囲が対象です。機能・提供条件は下の公式出典で照合してください。
details.workflow: 空の検証フォルダで、許可した操作と確認・拒否されるべき操作を一つずつ実行し、ダイアログと実行結果を比較する。対象は「Orca v1.4.247：公式リリース」。この更新が必要な操作に影響するかを切り分けるための提案です。
steps: 現在の製品名・バージョン・ログイン方法を控え、公開データを使うテスト用フォルダを用意する。
空の検証フォルダで、許可した操作と確認・拒否されるべき操作を一つずつ実行し、ダイアログと実行結果を比較する。同じ入力・同じ依頼を保存する。
公式ノートの対象バージョンに切り替え、同じ依頼を再実行する。成功可否・手直し回数・出力差分を記録する。
details.benefit: この作業で再現した場合に限り、やり直しや手動確認が減る可能性があります。速度・品質の改善率は測定していません。

items.sourceText:
# Hermes Agent v0.22.6

**Release Date:** November 2, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~776 PRs merged since v0.22.5 into a stable release for the GitHub release (CLI and installers), the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.23.0.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## About this release

Measured at commit `f0d94882e89`, the window since v0.22.5 contains **3,448 non-merge commits** across **4,316 changed files** (+248,579 / −94,077), **776 merged PRs** and **385 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: the Webapp served from the gateway's own listener (`hermes webapp`, a Desktop Web Access pane to open it on your network or your own URL behind Nous sign-in, and Desktop plugins loading in a browser tab), `/model reset` to clear a session's model pin without losing history, per-skill locks against autonomous writes (lockable from the Desktop Capabilities pane), opt-in prepared compaction (`compression.prepare_ahead`), `hermes cron cancel` plus a per-job missed-run policy and a Stop button in the Desktop cron editor, `/delegation` choices saved for the next session, `hermes migrate` and setup moving Grok Bot and OpenBot users over, opt-in OS-keychain storage for the vault key, the catalog's `requires_hermes` enforced at plugin install and update, agent-picked ElevenLabs voices in `text_to_speech`, a `pre_llm_call` hook that can block a turn before inference, Desktop group chat rename, disband, mentions and attachment paste, every profile shown as a Desktop sidebar section, Telegram video notes, Slack emoji reactions in thread context, and resumable downloads in the package manager.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.23.0**, which will document everything from v0.22.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Updating

- Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
- Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: [v0.22.5...v0.22.6](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v0.22.5...v0.22.6)

## What's Changed
* Download the provider that runs a saved custom endpoint by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4281
* Index remote sessions for the session sweep and membership cascade by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4282
* Show the OpenCode Go monthly limit as a third usage bar by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4284
* Accept a signed-in Claude sign-in check when its output is unreadable by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4286
* Show one Open OpenBot button on the invitation page by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4289
* build(nix): install OpenBot 0.57.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4291
* Replace the OpenBot Marketplace agents and skills with catalog v4 by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4292
* Turn on two active Signal machines by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4309
* Start workflows from GitHub events and change GitHub from workflows by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4288
* Record the GitHub App webhook secret, events, and private key by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4319
* Let a queue of more than 32 messages be reordered by @gustavo-ferreira03 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4294
* End a Pi turn that sends nothing for 10 minutes by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4320
* Wrap long model names in the model picker by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4322
* Mark the mobile app 1.4.5 available on iOS, and turn on its cloud servers and browser flags by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4336
* Show a full-window screen when a server is open in another web tab by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4352
* Connect to a remote server faster and sync the rest later by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4360
* release: prepare v0.58.0 by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4365


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/compare/v0.57.0...v0.58.0

## Orchestrator V3, improved terminal, Chat UI out of experimental & a refreshed phone app ✨

- 🤝 **Orchestrator V3:** A lot more token efficient and reliable. Works with both CLI agents and Chat UI, with visual worker indicators in Chat UI to help you follow progress.
- 🔕 **Quieter notifications:** Orca now filters out worker agent notifications during orchestration.
- 📱 **A refreshed Orca Mobile:** Choose **Light, Dark or System** and pick your **display language** in Settings. Enjoy cleaner screens, smoother sheets and faster workspace lists.
- 💬 **Chat UI is out of experimental:** Choose Chat or CLI for each agent, queue follow-ups while it works, and continue with another account or agent harness when you hit a usage limit.
- ⌨️ **Improved terminals:** Faster input for terminal agents, more reliable session restores, and fixes for text rendering, links and padding.
- 🎨 **Make Orca yours:** Choose an editor theme independently of the app, add a background image, or match the whole window to your terminal theme.
- 🧩 **Explore community plugins:** Browse the community catalog, try syntax themes, and build your own panels with TypeScript and TSX.
- 🖱️ **Improved computer use & browser use:** More reliable background browsing, sign-in popups, uploads and downloads, plus computer-use fixes on Windows and Linux.

## Highlights

- **Mobile theme & language pickers:** Pick **Light, Dark or System** for the phone app and choose your **display language** in Settings → Appearance and Language.
- **A refreshed phone app:** A Home screen focused on what needs you, compact top bars, bottom search, filter chips, clearer lists and smoother sheets. Workspace lists load with less data, images and Mermaid diagrams support pinch-to-zoom, and iOS can show inline HTML cards and previews. Run automations from your phone too.
- **Plugins:** The community catalog is visible by default, with public install counts and clearer publisher information. Plugin authors get TypeScript and TSX without a separate build step, component-based panels, worker communication, hot reload and CLI tools for testing and screenshots.
- **Chat UI:** Chat leaves Experimental. Choose Chat or CLI in each agent’s Settings row, with default model and effort choices. Follow-up messages queue by default while an agent works; Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends one straight into the running turn. Switch accounts for open chats, or continue a usage-limited conversation with another account or agent harness.
- **Themes & editors:** Set a separate code editor theme, tune editor typography, use background images, and apply Match Terminal across the whole window. Preview SVG source alongside the image, click to zoom images and Alt-drag to pan.
- **Source Control:** Resolve conflicts and complete merges on desktop or phone. Open every changed file from the mobile diff screen, return a pull request to draft from a paired phone, and refresh checks and reviews with current provider data.
- **Browser & computer use:** Agents can work with sign-in and payment popups, upload through file-picker buttons in nested frames, answer page dialogs and save downloads to the requested path. Background browser pages stay active while agents use them.
- **Orchestrator V3:** A lot more token efficient and reliable. Coordinators end their turn and wake when workers report back, with shorter CLI status and inbox output. It works great in Chat UI, where visual worker cards and activity indicators help you follow progress. Give finished workers follow-up tasks and reopen closed workers.
- **Everyday speed & polish:** Less whole-app hitching with many chats, quicker shell submissions, faster worktree checkout, and fewer redraws in chats and diffs. Child agents start collapsed, with idle agents grouped together on desktop and phone.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Chat or CLI per agent:** Chat UI no longer needs the Experimental switch. Existing users keep their launch preferences and existing conversations keep their surface. New installs start in Terminal. Choose Chat or CLI and the default model and effort in Settings → Agents.
- **Follow-ups queue by default:** While an agent works, Enter queues your next message. Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends it into the running turn instead. Turn off **Queue follow-ups** in Settings → Chat → Behavior to change the default. On a phone, hold Send to choose Queue or Steer. The phone follows its host’s setting; older clients or hosts without queue support keep sending immediately.
- **Mobile app updates:** Native Settings changes, including the theme and language pickers, require an updated mobile app. Update Orca Mobile as well as your desktop or server to get the full experience.
- **Plugin trust & updates:** Orca warns before trusting non-official plugins. Updates that request more access wait for individual review, and installed plugin content is verified again when loaded.
- **Isolated desktop plugin views:** Plugin panels and custom editors now use separate processes and storage with direct network access blocked. Browser and serve clients retain their existing iframe behavior.
- **WSL hosts:** Stopped distros stay stopped when restoring or switching workspaces, and blocked panes offer Start. Turning the WSL hosts setting off stops new hosts and moves while saved hosts keep serving. Idle WSL servers can exit after five minutes without putting that idle timeout in your own shells.
- **Orca skills:** Unedited bundled skills update automatically. Skills you have changed still prompt for review.

---

## Product experience

### Terminals

*Quicker prompt submission, more reliable restores and fixes for text weight, links, padding and Windows startup errors.*

* Bound the in-process macOS process table's blocking calls and ps fallbacks (#31783) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36282
* Fix macOS daemon PTY kqueue descriptor leak by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/16870
* Stop terminal text turning bold after a restart (STA-4042) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36463
* Link a URL wrapped inside a table cell on every row by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36482
* Skip the ConPTY input-reader check on WinPTY panes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36490
* Explain Git Bash console exhaustion when terminal startup fails by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36422
* Reserve the Git Bash capacity overlay for untouched Windows startup failures by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/16991
* Add Chat UI upgrade tip and Chat/Terminal default tiles by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36171
* Open OSC 8 hyperlinks on Mod+click in Agent Dashboard terminal previews by @alpenshtokk in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36483
* Submit at once to a shell idle at its prompt by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36614
* End multiple PTYs without blocking the Resource Manager by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36753
* Respawn restored local panes silently when the daemon reports their session gone by @Pr1p in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36620
* Close the terminal before continuing its conversation in chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36732
* Apply padding to both edges of each axis by @anmol0b in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36789
* Open a shell, not an unrequested chat, in empty workspaces when the default agent is Auto by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36927

### Native chat

*Queued follow-ups, account hand-offs and clearer conversation cards, with fewer redraws and more reliable questions and replies.*

* Agent message cards no longer reserve a row for the copy button by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36189
* Keep unrelated agent status updates from redrawing every native chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34596
* Keep async question controls available after agent notices by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35758
* Keep cancelled async questions hidden and show new ones by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35870
* Right-click Copy no longer offers a selection the click missed by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36405
* Keep pending questions through agent notices and undelivered replies by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36306
* Reduce whole-app hitches when many chats are running by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35624

* Keep model picker choices stable during discovery by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36113
* Stop a cancelled image leaving an extra space in a hidden chat's message by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36448
* A dropped screenshot is written once, straight into the chat's attachment store by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31779
* Stop a finished turn announcing "responding" to screen readers by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36474

* Chat UI leaves Experimental: each agent's Chat or CLI choice decides what opens by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36110
* Keep a hook-blocked prompt's Worked for line after reopen by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36515
* Keep chat image thumbnails square while scrolled away or loading by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36488
* Stop attributing recovered ACP replies to outside activity by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36302

items.sourceText: # ChatGPT for iOS ### New features - Add, preview, and remove attachments without leaving the full-screen composer. - Task read status now syncs with supported hosts, helping clear stale unread indicators across devices. ### Improvements and bug fixes - Follow-ups steer the running task by default unless you have saved a different preference. - Improved response annotations: add and edit notes on selected text, and tap numbered references to revisit the selected text and its note. - Custom-provider tasks keep their model and reasoning effort when you send a follow-up from iOS. - When you reopen a task, prompts that failed to send retain their attachments, and you can retry sending them. - Improved keyboard behavior when opening tasks, scrolling long drafts, and returning to an open editor. - Drafts, text selection, and undo history survive changes between compact and split layouts. - Improved iPhone Duo layouts, including full-width editing and controls that stay above the keyboard. - Linked files open directly, and closing the preview takes you back to the task. Absolute file links outside the workspace also open correctly. - Images with relative file paths load from the directory where the original turn ran. - Fixed invisible chart labels and bars in inline visualizations. - Reconnect errors show a single Retry control, with better alignment on iPad. - Archiving a task can reconnect to its host when the computer appears offline.

## What's Changed
* build(nix): install OpenBot 0.56.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4147
* Show notification levels as one card for each server by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4145

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.316：公式リリース
items.summary: Claude Codeが認証拒否やクラウドセッションのアーカイブで終了した際、macOS/Linuxにシェル処理が残る問題を修正。
items.why: 終了したつもりの処理によるCPU消費やプレビューポートの占有を減らせる可能性があります。
items.try: Mac M2で画像変換やローカルプレビューをAIに起動させた後、セッション終了時に処理が残らないか確かめる。
items.availability: プラン・地域・アプリ/CLIの対応条件は公式ページで確認が必要です。
items.sourceExcerpt: Fixed shell commands being left running on macOS and Linux when Claude Code exits by itself, for example when credentials are refused or a cloud session is archived / Fixed sonnet, opus and haiku on Vertex AI and Amazon Bedrock showing an error mid-session instead of switching to an older model when the newest is not yet available to the account or region
items.sourceText:
## What's changed

- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK`, which turns the `ultrathink` keyword off
- Added pooled group budgets to the Claude apps gateway: one monthly budget that a group's members share, on top of each member's own limit, set with `pooled_budget` on the spend limits admin API
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP` to keep system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for servers whose private CA needs one
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT` to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's
- Added `managed.policy_mode: layered` to the Claude apps gateway: every policy that matches a developer applies, each merged over the ones listed below it, not only the first
- Added `guardrail.input_tagging` on Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, which wraps prompts in the input tags that an Amazon Bedrock guardrail's prompt attacks filter needs; `all_messages_and_system` also tags the system prompt
- Deprecated fast mode for Opus 4.8 as of October 30, 2026; it will be removed on November 30, 2026. After removal, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error and do not fall back to standard Opus 4.8. Migrate to Opus 5.5 to keep the speedup
- Fixed shell commands being left running on macOS and Linux when Claude Code exits by itself, for example when credentials are refused or a cloud session is archived
- Fixed bash aliases with line breaks in their value (except in Git Bash), and functions whose names start with a dash, being garbled or lost in the Bash tool's shell
- Fixed bash scripts started from the Bash tool stopping after their first command when `SHELLOPTS` is exported
- Fixed PowerShell hooks not blocking on exit code 2 when the command begins with a type cast, `param`, `using` or an attribute
- Fixed some network requests hanging when a compressed response was cut off or corrupted
- Fixed `sonnet`, `opus` and `haiku` on Vertex AI and Amazon Bedrock showing an error mid-session instead of switching to an older model when the newest is not yet available to the account or region
- Fixed the Claude apps gateway not checking every model a request names against `availableModels`, `deniedModels` and `models`; a request that names a blocked model now gets a 400 naming the field
- Fixed `claude auth login` refusing to run where managed settings require a Claude apps gateway; in a terminal it now shows the gateway sign-in
- Fixed `--restricted` sessions uploading files from outside the working directories when a Read allow rule covered them
- Fixed prompts containing invisible characters needing a second Enter to send; plain prompts now send cleaned on the first Enter, and commands still wait for review
- Fixed sub-agents that inherited a parent sub-agent's model moving to the main model when a background job or message woke them
- Fixed a managed `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` getting the built-in exceptions back from a host app's `--settings`, a first rule added in `/permissions`, or `/auto-mode-setup`
- Fixed cloud sessions and cloud scheduled tasks not being marked as failed when auto mode stopped a turn because the server returned no safety verdict
- Fixed `claude -p` text output sometimes not saying why auto mode stopped a turn when a background agent was still running
- Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` being ignored in sessions started by a host application (such as Claude Desktop) behind a proxy or LLM gateway with experimental betas turned off
- Fixed plugin MCP `headersHelper` scripts receiving a corrupted `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` and server URL when a credential-named environment variable was set to a switch value such as `1`
- Fixed the SDK `register_repo_root` control request not loading the CLAUDE.md of a directory outside the working directory (with `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1`)
- Fixed the Artifact tool showing `?` for artifact database access rules at the `self` level, and not quoting those rules back when it refuses a republish that would drop them
- Fixed `/model <id>` not warning when the model isn't recognized by this version and auto-compact will assume a 200K context window
- Fixed the "hold space to speak" hint using up its three showings in one session, and showing an empty key when push-to-talk is unbound
- Fixed Grep and Glob never returning when the search process is killed at the timeout but does not exit, seen on Windows
- Fixed a rare case where resuming a conversation did not restore its plan, when `/clear` or `/resume` had been run while part of that conversation was still being saved
- Fixed first-run setup dropping words from the security notes and the terminal-setup explanation in narrow terminals
- Fixed the Enterprise survey card taking a typed 1 or 0 after a short pause; a typed answer now needs Enter
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being answered after a Stop, once the session's process had been replaced
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed an MCP server's on/off switch sometimes being lost when a session moved to a new machine
- Windows: Fixed the Bash tool losing your aliases and functions in Git Bash when the rc file sets errexit and pipefail and only winpty aliases, or none, are defined
- Improved `/code-review` started from the Code tab in Claude Desktop or on the web: cloud and `claude remote-control` sessions now show the findings card, not a plain-text list
- Improved `/diff` on large repositories: each refresh usually runs one fewer full-repository git command, and refreshes are spaced out when git is slow
- Improved the messages shown when `/ultrareview`, a cloud session or a cloud agent finds no GitHub remote: they now say to create a repository at https://github.com/new, and `/ultrareview` no longer suggests a `gh` command that `gh` rejects
- Improved SSL certificate errors to name the likely causes, among them a server that leaves out an intermediate certificate, and the fix for each
- Changed auto mode so that an `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` no longer removes the built-in rule on scheduled-task prompts
- Changed server-managed settings for Team and Enterprise logins: settings fetched from Anthropic's API now apply without an approval prompt, and a stored copy that doesn't verify is refused
- [VSCode] Added sign-in to a Claude apps gateway from the chat panel, with no terminal needed
- [VSCode] Changed `ultrathink` to run its turn at `xhigh` effort and show in a rainbow in the chat box, as in the terminal
- [VSCode] Fixed the missing Effort slider, Ultracode switch and model name when the model setting has the `[1m]` tag, such as `opus[1m]`
- [VSCode] Fixed saved `/btw` side-question history being deleted too early while a settings file has errors
- [VSCode] Fixed a conversation coming back in Auto mode after a reload or restart when its plan was approved with "Yes, and manually approve edits"
- [Cloud sessions] Added a form card to cloud sessions, so you can fill in or decline a form an MCP server asks for instead of the request being canceled without you seeing it
- [Cloud sessions] Added a "Catching up…" line that shows while a cloud or Remote Control session you switch back to is still bringing its messages up to date
- [Cloud sessions] Changed network secrets so Enterprise members can add and delete them on their own cloud environments, instead of only viewing them
- [Cloud sessions] Improved the Changes pane for cloud sessions: the note about what the list leaves out is now a badge beside the branch name, not a row above the diff
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed file search in a cloud session's Files pane showing folders as ../.. paths after Claude changed directory; results now show their path from the project's root
- [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude refusing to edit or append to a canvas it made in a Slack channel, from that channel, once the canvas was also shared to another channel or a DM
- [Claude Tag] Fixed untagged replies going unanswered in a Slack Connect thread when both organizations have installed Claude and Slack delivered the reply to the other organization's app
- [Claude Tag] Fixed a cloud scheduled task's live status checklist in Slack staying half-done; a run can now edit the top-level messages it posted during that run
- [Claude Tag] Changed a Slack channel's Respond automatically switch to a "How Claude participates" choice on the channel's Configure page and in Claude Tag admin settings
- [Code Review] Added a findings-by-severity card to the Code Review analytics page, showing the period's total findings, a daily chart stacked by severity, and each severity's count

details.workflow: Mac M2で画像変換やローカルプレビューをAIに起動させた後、セッション終了時に処理が残らないか確かめる。
steps: Claude Codeの版とテスト用プレビューのプロセスIDを控える。
機密のないテストセッションから短時間のプレビュー処理を起動する。
セッション終了後にアクティビティモニタで該当処理を確認する。認証切れを無理に再現する必要はない。
details.benefit: 終了したつもりの処理によるCPU消費やプレビューポートの占有を減らせる可能性があります。

items.sourceText:
## What's Changed
* Route a channel with many long member descriptions by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4102
* Say that the OpenBot source code is open, not that OpenBot is open source by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4104
* Explain why a Workspace only Claude agent cannot start its sandbox by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4108
* Build the macOS ARM64 release on macos-15 by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4109
* Drop a dragged sidebar chat in the section under the pointer by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4112
* Use the installed provider CLI and keep one downloaded version by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4113
* Send the same browser brands in the header as the page reads by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4116
* Send Signal and TURN capacity to OpenPanel by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4114
* Add Mark unread to the menu of an agent message by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4118
* Make browser tool results smaller so web work compacts less by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4115
* Add the OpenPanel server client to the Signal env file by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4120
* Add a Signal TURN allocation health route by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4110
* Let the user hide the Local server when other servers exist by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4121
* Add run_script to openbot_browser and find browser tools in fewer steps by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4117
* Keep a provider-started turn out of the next channel task by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4122
* Probe the TURN relay for the Connections status by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4111
* Show one chat row for each hosted site change by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4127
* Make the Signal restart burst smaller by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4129
* Let the user drag the Instructions field taller by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4124
* Raise the coturn total allocation quota to 12000 by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4103
* Hide providers that are not connected in workflow model lists by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4131
* Find server Providers and Import from Settings search by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4128
* Show and count server sites, and offer plans at the site limit by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4130
* Let a user message try a turn while a usage limit holds the agent by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4136
* Ask for analytics consent at first run and keep the answer on the account by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4133
* Show tooltips on the file preview header buttons by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4138
* Let the user choose the task-finished sound by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4137
* Keep an analytics "off" from before the account kept answers by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4141
* release: prepare v0.56.0 by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4142

details.change: OpenBotはWorkspace onlyのClaudeエージェントで隔離環境を起動できない理由を表示し、Mac ARM64版のビルド環境も変更しています。
details.before: 起動できない状況で、なぜ失敗したか分かりにくい場合がありました。
details.after: 失敗理由の表示が改善されます。すべてのOSで隔離環境が動くようになる修正ではありません。
details.workflow: Mac M2でCodex・Claude・Geminiを別途導入している場合、OpenBotのSettings → Storage → Provider runtimesで重複CLIの容量と利用版を確認する。WindowsではWorkspace onlyのClaudeが起動できないときの理由表示も確認する。

対象版でProvider runtimesの表示と使用中CLIを確認する。削除する場合は未使用と表示された対象を先に確認する。
WindowsでClaudeが起動しない場合は説明を読み、制約を記録する。権限を広げて解消したことにはしない。
details.benefit: CLIの重複と起動失敗の理由を把握しやすくします。実際に空く容量は本人の導入構成次第です。
details.environment: プラン・地域・アプリ/CLIの対応条件は公式ページで確認が必要です。
details.limitations: PATHのCLIが管理版と同版以上の場合に再利用。Antigravityは対象外。WindowsのClaude sandboxを新規に有効化する修正ではありません。

items.sourceText:
## New Features

- Added keyboard-driven transcript selection with word, line, and page motions, integrated search, and configurable shortcuts. (#57221, #57222, #57223, #57224)
- Rendered Markdown consistently in async questions, choices, answers, and transcript replies. (#57259, #57292)
- Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the bundled, Vertex AI, and Amazon Bedrock model catalogs. (#57293)
- Added `codex queue --resume` to resume unloaded threads after queueing a message. (#57232)
- Added clearer safety-block explanations and selectable safer follow-up prompts in the TUI. (#57363, #57365)
- Added `codex doctor --network-only` for focused configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket diagnostics. (#57606)

## Bug Fixes

- Preserved acknowledged approval and permission settings when resuming or forking threads. (#57227)
- Preserved local image attachments when restoring killed composer text. (#57502)
- Fixed standalone release cleanup on macOS when installations are in use or paths contain non-ASCII characters. (#57503)
- Restored spawned descendant threads when unarchiving their parent. (#57635)
- Fixed app-server thread startup and shutdown races and released completed runtimes promptly. (#57787, #57788)
- Improved TUI reconnection recovery, including offline `/quit` and `/exit` handling. (#57820)
- Preserved reasoning-token accounting across resume and fork to avoid premature compaction. (#57839)

## Chores

- Switched Bazel to source-built V8 with target-matched Rust bindings and native Windows MSVC archive support. (#57164, #57269, #57644, #57832)
- Shipped the standalone executor in canonical CLI and app-server release packages. (#57837)
- Standardized development and release builds on Node.js 24.22.1 and Rust 1.95.0. (#57168, #57373)

items.sourceText:
## A faster Orca, plugins & background computer use ⚡

- ⚡ **A faster Orca:** Launch smoothly with hundreds of chats, with less lag as you type and switch tabs.
- 🧩 **Customize Orca** with icon themes, syntax highlighting and custom editors.
- 🖱️ **Keep working** while agents use Chrome, Blender and other Mac apps in the background.
- 🎙️ **Dictate on your phone** and see your words as you speak.
- 💬 **Try the new Chat UI:** Search for “Chat UI” in Settings to turn it on, then right-click a tab to switch live between Chat UI and TUI.

## Highlights

- **A faster Orca:** Fast app with hundreds of chats. Typing stays more responsive, and hidden chats do less work while you use other tabs.
- **Plugins:** Add icon themes, syntax highlighting and custom editors from Settings → Plugins. Community publishing is coming soon, so you’ll be able to share your own plugins.
- **Background computer use on Mac:** Let agents work in Chrome, Blender and other apps while you keep using your mouse and keyboard. Orca’s in-app browser already works in the background; now computer use does too. Some actions still need the app brought forward.
- **Chats:** Enjoy a very polished Chat UI, send again after Stop, and preview links in chat. Search for “Chat UI” in Settings to turn it on, and right-click a tab to switch live between Chat UI and TUI.
- **Terminals:** Set a running terminal limit for each computer in Settings → Terminal → Advanced.
- **WSL:** Stopped distros stay stopped until you choose Start. Terminals remember their folder.
- **Browser:** Press Cmd+Opt+B on Mac for a browser split. Send shorter annotation feedback, now with pasted images.
- **Workspaces:** Your workspace name becomes its branch name again. Source Control actions get Model and Effort controls.
- **Phone:** See dictation as you speak, and read clearer code, tables and diagrams.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **New terminal host:** This release starts a fresh terminal host for new terminals. Terminals already open before the update keep running on the previous host and stay attached. The new running terminal limit setting needs the new host, and so do fixes such as the ble.sh startup fix and lighter process checks on macOS. Those apply to terminals you open after updating.
- **Plugins are on by default:** Installing a plugin, including from an `orca://plugins` link, only opens a review screen first. Plugins that run code ask for your consent before they install, and once approved they run with full access to your computer.
- **Running terminal limit:** The default now follows each computer: half of its system terminal limit, up to 4096, or 256 as before when Orca can’t read that limit. A value you set in Settings or with an environment variable takes priority. Raising or lowering it never closes running terminals. A remote server running an older Orca keeps working, but the limit can’t be changed there until it updates.
- **Chat naming:** Chats are now named by their own agent and account by default. A naming agent, custom command or arguments you saved before keep working, and the naming agent choice moved under Advanced in Settings → Chat → Chat naming.
- **Codex history across accounts:** A new switch, Settings → Agents → Share Codex history across accounts, is on by default and keeps today’s behavior. With it on, history from Orca’s managed accounts now also shows up in your own ~/.codex when you switch back to system default. Turning it off stops new sharing and removes nothing. On an SSH or WSL host running an older Orca, the switch stays disabled until that host updates.
- **Codex on macOS and Linux:** Orca now starts Codex with its paste guess turned off, so prompts typed from a phone or another client send instead of staying in the composer. Real pastes still arrive as pastes.
- **Computer use on a Mac:** Agents now act in the background by default. Agents can still ask for the old foreground mode with `--restore-window`, which drags into Chromium and Electron apps still need.
- **Browser annotations:** Send and Copy now give agents a short summary per note. Check **Include page details** in the Send menu to get the old full output; the choice lasts for that browser pane.
- **Workspace branch names:** A name you type for a new workspace is used as its branch again, even when Auto-rename branch from work is on. Auto-rename only replaces names Orca made up.
- **Automations:** Agents started by an automation skip their CLI’s startup update prompt, so the prompt can’t swallow the task. Agents you start yourself are unchanged.
- **Source Control actions:** Model and effort flags saved in an action’s Arguments move into the new Model and Effort controls when Orca loads; other Arguments stay as they are. A phone or remote server on an older Orca may launch these actions with a different model or effort until it updates.
- **New shortcuts:** Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+X opens Plugins (outside text fields), and Cmd+Opt+B on macOS opens a browser tab in a split to the right. Cmd+Opt+B can be changed in Settings → Keyboard.
- **Known limitation, downgrading:** If you go back to v1.4.244, custom model and effort choices on Source Control AI actions reset to the agent’s defaults, and updating again won’t bring them back.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat

*No more startup freeze with many chats, link previews, naming with the chat’s own agent, and a working Send after Stop.*

* Show chats as Interrupted or Done at startup without reading their history, so Orca no longer freezes after launch with hundreds of chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32146
* Show hover cards for GitHub PR and issue links in chats by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35199
* Show preview cards for web links in chats, never fetching private network addresses by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35221
* Name each chat with its own agent and account by default, with other naming agents under Advanced by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32106
* Let the next message go through after Stop force-kills a chat’s agent by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34653
* Keep a huge unbroken paste from freezing a chat by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36031
* Run launcher Commands like `op run -- codex` for every agent in chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35592
* Leave Claude plan mode when you approve a plan by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34549
* Resume a chat with a saved effort on Claude Code versions that predate --effort by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35878
* Keep the model options a chat accepted in what it shows and sends by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31208
* Keep a chat’s option controls working while its model list refreshes by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31927
* Handle large pastes in chat goal mode by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34654
* Order queued chat turns without rescanning the transcript by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34945
* Stop resting chats from delaying native command menus by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35069
* Recover from OpenCode failures in chats by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35247
* Keep models missing from a provider’s list available in chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35266
* Process image-heavy transcript runs once by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35572
* Reopen an old tool run without jumping to a stale scroll position by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35866
* Stop re-rendering chat composer controls on every keystroke by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35913
* Do less work for hidden chats and tab updates by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36047
* Keep the chat session record file within the file name length limit by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36056
* Make Settings permission menus match the chat permission picker by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36104
* Stop the saved chat status writer from remembering every closed chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36105
* Keep transcripts from re-rendering on status-only updates by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36141
* Keep chats ended with Stop readable after downgrading to v1.4.244 by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36142
* Skip the WSL distro walk for chat transcripts on this computer by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36152

### Plugins

*Icon themes, syntax packs and custom editors, one Plugins list with one-step install, and quick access from the status bar.*

* Plugin Alpha: icon themes, syntax packs and custom editors, one Plugins list with one-step install, and `orca://plugins` links by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35470
* Open Plugins from a status bar button or Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+X by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36153
* Show one Plugins list with Installed badges, inline switches, install-state filters, category chips and plain wording about trusted code by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36100
* Show the Plugins catalog in four columns with clear Show all and See all links by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35849
* Make Try it apply the plugin instead of opening its page by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35846
* Treat self-hosted plugin repository paths that differ in case as different repositories by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35640
* Stop an update already in progress when you turn off plugin auto-update by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35642
* Keep the Try it and Switch back toasts up long enough to click by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35650
* Apply a one-mode theme visibly when you install it by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35674
* Use one loader for plugin panels and editors, and keep suspended panels marked failed by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35680
* Keep unsaved edits in plugin binary editors across renames, reloads and duplicate tabs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35698
* Load installed plugins whose minimum Orca version predates their fields by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35756
* Keep plugin panels within the sidebar’s height by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36085
* Cap the plugin preview cache to the current version by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36089
* Count plugin installs from Orca’s public catalogs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36132
* Reload the active icon theme after a plugin update by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36151

### Browser

*A browser split shortcut, shorter annotation feedback with pasted images, and SSH proxies that work in the browser.*

* Open a browser tab in a split to the right with a shortcut (Cmd+Opt+B on macOS) by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35994
* Send compact annotation feedback by default, with an Include page details checkbox for the full detail by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35990
* Paste images into annotation comments and send them to the agent by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36004
* Reach sites through the SSH host’s proxy in an SSH workspace’s browser by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36022
* Keep your chosen default browser profile after a restart or update by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35991

## Security: Node.js runtime and CA certificate updates (October 2026)

On October 20, 2026, eMudhra disclosed that the private keys for eight of its intermediate CA certificates could be recovered from the public certificates. On October 21, Node.js shipped [security releases](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/october-2026-security-releases) that update its bundled CA certificates for the compromise and fix several unrelated high-severity runtime CVEs. On October 23, Python's `certifi` 2026.10.23 removed the eMudhra roots `emSign Root CA - C1` and `emSign ECC Root CA - C3`.

**How these servers stand**

- **The TypeScript servers rely on the Node.js runtime for certificate checks.** They ship no CA certificates of their own. Only `server-everything` makes outbound HTTPS requests (`gzip-file-as-resource`), and the Node.js it runs on verifies them. `server-filesystem`, `server-memory` and `server-sequential-thinking` make no network connections.
- **`mcp-server-fetch` verifies HTTPS against the `certifi` bundle**, through `httpx`. Installing from PyPI (`uvx mcp-server-fetch`, `pip install mcp-server-fetch`) resolves the current `certifi`, 2026.10.23 or later. The repository's `fetch` Dockerfile installs from its lockfile, which this release moves to `certifi` 2026.10.23 (#5341).
- **`mcp-server-git` and `mcp-server-time` make no network connections.**

**If you run a TypeScript server from npm (`npx` or a global install)**

It runs on your Node.js, which we can't update for you. Please run Node.js **24.22.1 or 26.12.1, or later**, and check with `node --version`. The packages' `engines` field accepts any Node.js 24, so npm won't warn you about an older, unpatched runtime.

**If you run `mcp-server-fetch` from an existing environment**

An environment created before October 23 keeps its older `certifi`. Refresh it with `uvx --refresh mcp-server-fetch`, or `pip install -U certifi`.

### What's Changed

* fix(filesystem): accept a case-only respelling of an allowed directory where the file system confirms it by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5319
* fix(filesystem): tail no longer counts a final newline as a line by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5316

* fix(filesystem): bound realpath/readdir waits and recursive walks (#4162) by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5326
* fix(filesystem): compare overwrite identity as BigInt stats, with a Windows no-device fallback by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5325
* fix(filesystem): retry a failed realpath once before losing a root by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5318
* fix(filesystem): head returns CRLF lines normalized to LF, like tail by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5324
* fix(filesystem): allow a client Root in its advertised form as well as its realpath by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5317
* fix(filesystem): move a file across filesystems by copying it on EXDEV by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5322
* test(filesystem): explicit timeout on the 100000-entry walk tests by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5331

* Release v2.2.0: merge v2/main into main by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5338

## @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory 2.0.1

### What's Changed

* fix(memory): keep unmodelled fields on stored records across writes by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5292

## mcp-server-fetch 2026.10.28

### What's Changed

* fix(fetch): refuse an autonomous fetch when robots.txt answers 5xx by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5299
* fix(fetch): refuse IPv4-compatible IPv6 addresses (::/96) by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5301
* fix(fetch): report an empty-tree page as unsimplifiable under beautifulsoup4 4.13 by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5304
* fix(fetch): treat a header-less response as HTML only when its body is by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5300
* feat(fetch): add --no-readability-js to keep extraction off Node.js by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5307
* fix(fetch): decode a page by the charset its HTML declares by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5302
* fix(fetch): require readabilipy 0.3.0 so HTML extraction works on non-cp1252 pages on Windows by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5311
* fix(fetch): recover server-rendered content hidden until hydration by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5308
* fix(fetch): declare beautifulsoup4 and name a missing Content-Type in the raw prefix by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5323
* chore: stamp Python CalVer versions for 2026.10.28 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5336
* Release v2.2.0: merge v2/main into main by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5338
* chore(fetch): bump certifi to 2026.10.23 in uv.lock (eMudhra roots removed) by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5341
* Release v2.2.0: merge v2/main into main (certifi lock) by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5342

## mcp-server-git 2026.10.28

### What's Changed

* docs(git): state that without --repository every reachable repository is in scope by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5305
* fix(git): create a branch on a detached HEAD, and from a commit-ish base by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5309

items.sourceText:
## What's Changed
* build(nix): install OpenBot 0.53.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/3710
* Hide machine use, alerts and alert notifications by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/3712
* Show that the agent waits for the user on the activity line by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/3713
* Widen a user message that holds a Markdown table by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/3714
* Give Gemini the full request timeout to list its models by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/3715
* Hide Steer for providers that cannot steer a running turn by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/3721
* Read only on-screen windows for the Computer Use rim by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/3720
* Log why an update check, download or install failed by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/3728
* Record the turn of turn-end activities by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/3729
* Keep a long model name inside the workflow Agent step by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/3725
* Load agent read states again after the account signs in by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/3731
* Do not show a paused group chat lead as working by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/3733
* Price Gemini (Antigravity) turns in agent usage by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/3735
* release: prepare v0.53.1 by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/3737


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/compare/v0.53.0...v0.53.1

items.sourceText: New Features Added keyboard-driven transcript selection with word, line, and page motions, integrated search, and configurable shortcuts. ( #57221 , #57222 , #57223 , #57224 ) Rendered Markdown consistently in async questions, choices, answers, and transcript replies. ( #57259 , #57292 ) Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the bundled, Vertex AI, and Amazon Bedrock model catalogs. ( #57293 ) Added codex queue --resume to resume unloaded threads after queueing a message. ( #57232 ) Added clearer safety-block explanations and selectable safer follow-up prompts in the TUI. ( #57363 , #57365 ) Added codex doctor --network-only for focused configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket diagnostics. ( #57606 ) Bug Fixes Preserved acknowledged approval and permission settings when resuming or forking threads. ( #57227 ) Preserved local image attachments when restoring killed composer text. ( #57502 ) Fixed standalone release cleanup on macOS when installations are in use or paths contain non-ASCII characters. ( #57503 ) Restored spawned descendant threads when unarchiving their parent. ( #57635 ) Fixed app-server thread startup and shutdown races and released completed runtimes promptly. ( #57787 , #57788 ) Improved TUI reconnection recovery, including offline /quit and /exit handling. ( #57820 ) Preserved reasoning-token accounting across resume and fork to avoid premature compaction. ( #57839 ) Chores Switched Bazel to source-built V8 with target-matched Rust bindings and native Windows MSVC archive support. items.sourceText:
## New Features

- Added a built-in Google Cloud Vertex AI provider, configured with `model_provider = "gcp"`. (#56265)
- Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the model catalogs. (#57337)
- Added a repository filter to the session picker and directory grouping to the agent command center, making it easier to navigate sessions across linked worktrees. (#56308)
- Added experimental attached thread forks to the app-server API. (#56351)
- Enabled reasoning effort changes during a conversation by default for supported models. (#56163)
- Enabled memory v2 by default for fresh profiles and added support for importing external-agent memories into it. (#56211, #56414)

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed fresh TUI sessions to honor the server’s default approval reviewer when no explicit override is provided. (#56090)
- Kept TUI preferences editable and immediately applicable when execution settings are invalid. (#56091)
- Cancelled remote MCP tool requests when their local response futures are dropped. (#56132)
- Prevented queued agent messages from restarting work after an interrupt or a switch to Plan mode. (#56330)
- Stopped retrying when a provider reports that a model was not found, preserving its error message. (#56445)
- Closed a marketplace URL validation gap that could allow Git to connect to a different host than the one checked against allowed patterns. (#56263)

* fix(core): preserve user-level ~/.gitconfig in shell and git environments by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29832
* fix(core): prevent false positive matches in isAuthenticationError by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29835

## What's changed

- Added `--hold-idle-file` and `--max-hold-min` to `self-hosted-runner`, to keep an idle session while your host reports processes it left running
- Added a tip for the Explanatory output style, shown when you ask Claude for explanations
- Fixed long freezes at startup and after reading or editing files when a CLAUDE.md file holds a very long list item
- Fixed interrupting Claude not taking effect until a timeout while an MCP server had not answered a resource read or a skill was still downloading
- Fixed standard-context sessions stopping with "Usage credits required for 1M context" when a request ran over 200K tokens; Claude Code now compacts the conversation and continues
- Fixed Write and Edit stalling for up to 5 seconds after they ran, and reporting 0 lines changed, when changing thousands of lines in a file
- Fixed subagents being unable to use MCP tools from servers that finish connecting after the subagent starts
- Fixed Claude seeing stale MEMORY.md and CLAUDE.md content right after automatic compaction when those files were edited earlier in the session
- Fixed `claude -p` and SDK sessions saving transcript messages out of order or keeping messages that were taken back
- Fixed `SubagentStop` hooks running about twice a minute for each running subagent instead of once when it finishes
- Fixed the @ file picker ignoring `.ignore`/`.rgignore` negation rules that re-include git-ignored files
- Fixed a subagent's isolated worktree being removed while a background subagent it started was still working in it
- Fixed background agents in auto mode that wait on their own shells starting a new main conversation turn on every wake
- Fixed the Bash tool description claiming the working directory always persists between calls
- Fixed the environment block naming a shell commands don't run in, such as fish when the Bash tool uses zsh
- Fixed `claude mcp add`, `claude mcp remove` and `/mcp` naming the current folder instead of the project entry in `~/.claude.json` that holds a local-scope server when run below a repository root
- Fixed `claude mcp list` and `claude mcp get` showing the error code twice on failed-connection lines (for example `ENOENT: ENOENT: …`)
- Fixed Remote Control sessions staying on "Connecting" for about two minutes when a network proxy blocks a startup request
- Fixed messages that Claude sends to a cloud or Remote Control session appearing as your own message in the Claude mobile apps
- Fixed Claude not being told the cause when a file attached to a message sent over Remote Control or to a cloud session could not be saved because the disk was full, or that a message's attachments past the first 20 were left out
- Fixed WebFetch and WebSearch hanging on a stalled response in Cowork cloud sessions; an unfinished request now fails after 300 seconds
- Fixed a background session that crashed between turns not being restarted while it was attached, pinned, or had a scheduled task or wake-up set
- Fixed the "background service did not respond" error suggesting the disabled `claude daemon restart`; it now suggests `claude daemon stop --any` and says it ends background sessions
- Fixed `claude respawn <id>` starting the background service before reporting that no background session matches the id
- Fixed `/effort` not warning about a prompt cache miss in plan mode when the plan model differs from the session model
- Fixed `/ide` saying the VS Code extension was installed before the install finished or when it failed
- Fixed the Write tool's file preview skipping rows and miscounting hidden lines when a line is wider than the terminal
- Fixed ↑ in an agent's chat tab recalling a message that was still waiting to be delivered, so resending it sent a second copy
- Fixed Cowork cloud sessions losing their connectors and most tools after a restart when a plugin or your settings named an `agent`; Cowork cloud sessions now ignore that setting
- Fixed agent teams sessions showing an empty task list when coming back with `--resume`, `--continue`, `/resume` or `--session-id`, including after `/clear` or a crash, and `/branch` writing to the original session's list
- Fixed pasting text that mentions an image file, such as `! open /tmp/shot.png` or `/review look at /tmp/shot.png`, attaching the image and dropping its path from the prompt
- Fixed the feedback draft card showing its 1/2/0 and Esc shortcuts while the prompt has text, when those keys act on the prompt instead of the card
- Fixed a lone backslash in quotes or brackets, like `"\"` or `(\)`, disappearing from Claude's responses
- Fixed agent teammates compacting their history when `DISABLE_COMPACT` is set
- Fixed the rewind menu offering "Summarize from here" and "Summarize up to here" when `DISABLE_COMPACT` is set
- Fixed a finished `/code-review`, or another skill that runs in a sub-agent, running a second time when a cloud or background session restarts
- Fixed long hidden thinking being cut off as idle on Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry and Claude Platform on AWS, where the endpoint sends thinking progress updates
- Fixed `/ide` saying it had installed the JetBrains plugin when nothing was installed
- Fixed Claude Pro and Max subscribers being told to ask their admin when their subscription can't be used; the message now points to billing settings
- Fixed the diff pane opening by itself after an edit in wide fullscreen terminals when it had nothing to show
- Fixed `/mcp` showing a remote server as failed after "Clear authentication" when the server works without sign-in
- Fixed `/mcp` showing "authenticated" for a remote server that Claude Code sends no credentials to
- Fixed a `--plugin-dir` folder of plugins loading as one plugin when an empty `.mcp.json` was at its top
- Fixed `/usage` never showing large prompt-cache misses under "What's contributing to your limits usage?"
- Fixed status line links staying plain text in background sessions after you open them from a terminal that supports links
- Fixed the /rewind confirmation saying the conversation "will be forked" when the later messages are removed from the conversation
- Fixed the /rewind warning that wrongly said manual and Bash edits are never affected by a code restore
- Fixed plan approval in screen reader mode sending feedback you had dismissed with Escape
- Fixed Claude Code retrying requests the API marked not to retry, which could hold a turn for minutes or, in unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`), indefinitely
- Linux: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands failing with `bwrap: Can't create file` when a `--plugin-dir` folder was also an added directory and `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` was on
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed a session failing to start when a rate limit (HTTP 429, or a git wrapper that exits 75) blocks an added read-only repository; it now starts without that repository
- Improved startup time for Pro and Max accounts by skipping two network requests on launches within an hour of the last check
- Improved `/teleport` and `claude --teleport` to warn when a compacted cloud session loads from its last compaction, so the messages it summarized aren't in the local copy
- Improved the messages shown when a background session's process exits: they no longer promise a restart that isn't coming, and they say how to resume the session
- Improved artifacts with several views: Claude now routes each view on the link's `#name` and no longer says the address bar stays the same as you switch views
- Improved shell commands that reach their timeout: the result now shows the output so far and says the command is still running in the background
- Improved compaction: when the model's reply has no summary in it, Claude Code now usually asks for the summary once more before it replaces the conversation
- Improved the Artifact tool's choice between a page and a document: explainers and visual or interactive work become artifact pages; documents are for writing people keep editing or pass around
- Improved startup time for launches whose only arguments are options and their values, such as `claude --model opus`
- Improved the "Connection dropped" API error: it now says where to look first (the proxy or gateway in use, else VPN or firewall; Anthropic API only, Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged)
- Improved screen reader mode: deleting a rule in /permissions says "Deleted allow rule …" right away
- Improved the message shown when a pasted sign-in code is refused: it now says the code may have expired or been used, and to sign in again
- Improved Slack connector sends: Claude now checks a channel's topic for posting rules before messaging a channel you didn't name
- Improved screen reader mode: Claude's questions are listed as "Questions: Color (answered), Pages", without arrows or symbols
- Changed `ultrathink` in the interactive terminal to run its turn at xhigh effort on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 and Fable 5.1 through Anthropic's API; typed while Claude is working, it raises the rest of that turn
- Changed the `ultrathink` rainbow to appear only where the keyword can raise effort, and not when the word is quoted or part of a file path
- Changed Ctrl+D in agent view to match the prompt: on an empty input, pressing it twice exits
- Changed `--output-format json` and `stream-json` output to write DEL, C1 control and Unicode format characters inside strings as `\uXXXX` escapes; parsed values are unchanged
- Changed model names and IDs to drop the `[1m]` suffix and its label on models where the suffix has no effect; the suffix is still accepted
- Changed startup warnings about permission rules in settings files to show once per user until the rule changes
- Changed `/code-review` to tell Claude to put the effort level first and use max only when asked
- Changed `DISABLE_COMPACT` in settings files and in a mod's `$.env.set` so they can only turn compaction off, not back on
- Changed Claude Code on Bedrock, Mantle, Vertex, and Foundry to load model settings from a signed file on downloads.claude.ai; set CLAUDE_CODE_MODEL_CATALOG=off to turn this off
- Changed sessions that set `CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS` with feature-flag fetching off to reuse a claude.ai skills list up to 10 minutes old that another session on the machine fetched
- Changed clicks on scrollbar arrows and bars in fullscreen lists to act when the mouse button is released, so moving off the scrollbar before letting go cancels the click
- Changed `claude purge` to say it deletes data only on this computer, not anything stored by Anthropic
- [VSCode] Added syntax coloring to code blocks in Claude's replies, in light, dark and high contrast dark themes
- [VSCode] Added a "Running UserPromptSubmit hooks" spinner status and screen reader announcement for slow UserPromptSubmit hooks
- [VSCode] Fixed custom skills and custom slash commands sent from the VS Code or JetBrains panel leaving out the open file or selected lines that ordinary messages include (anthropics/claude-code#102799)
- [VSCode] Fixed the extension host freezing while the login shell ran its start-up files to read PATH on macOS and Linux
- [VSCode] Fixed clicking an image in a tool result, or closing its preview, also opening the result's text in an editor tab
- [VSCode] Fixed voice dictation continuing to record after a message was sent with the Send button; sending now stops dictation first, as pressing Enter already did
- [VSCode] Changed the extension to start Claude Code sessions with `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` set while VS Code's telemetry setting is off, so they send no usage metrics or error reports and fetch no feature flags
- [VSCode] Changed the session list side bar to load Web sessions when the Web tab is first opened, not at startup
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed routines in Anthropic-hosted environments staying locked after their owner left the organization and rejoined; the owner can now turn them back on
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed a failed routine API token delete or reg

items.sourceText: New Features Added a built-in Google Cloud Vertex AI provider, configured with model_provider = "gcp" . ( #56265 ) Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the model catalogs. ( #57337 ) Added a repository filter to the session picker and directory grouping to the agent command center, making it easier to navigate sessions across linked worktrees. ( #56308 ) Added experimental attached thread forks to the app-server API. ( #56351 ) Enabled reasoning effort changes during a conversation by default for supported models. ( #56163 ) Enabled memory v2 by default for fresh profiles and added support for importing external-agent memories into it. ( #56211 , #56414 ) Bug Fixes Fixed fresh TUI sessions to honor the server’s default approval reviewer when no explicit override is provided. ( #56090 ) Kept TUI preferences editable and immediately applicable when execution settings are invalid. ( #56091 ) Cancelled remote MCP tool requests when their local response futures are dropped. ( #56132 ) Prevented queued agent messages from restarting work after an interrupt or a switch to Plan mode. ( #56330 ) Stopped retrying when a provider reports that a model was not found, preserving its error message. ( #56445 ) Closed a marketplace URL validation gap that could allow Git to connect to a different host than the one checked against allowed patterns. items.sourceText: # GPT-6.1 Terra in Work and Codex GPT-6.1 Terra is now available in ChatGPT Work and Codex on Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu plans. It's a fast, efficient model for professional work that combines strong image understanding with precise computer use. Reason about images and screens, then act on what you find across your browser, desktop, and apps. Terra also provides clear, direct writing that puts results first and explains supporting details in plain language. Choose GPT-6.1 Terra from the model list in **Advanced** in the ChatGPT desktop app or ChatGPT Work on the web. Work also supports Terra on mobile. The model isn't available in Chat and does not support UAE inference residency. Enterprise access depends on workspace availability and administrator controls. See [Models](/codex/models?surface=app#app-gpt-61-terra) for guidance and [browser use](/codex/browser) and [computer use](/codex/computer-use) for tool setup and access requirements.

items.sourceText:
## Security fixes

v2.1.0 fixes eight vulnerabilities in three servers. Upgrade
`@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` and `@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything`
to 2.0.1, and `mcp-server-fetch` to 2026.10.24.

| Package | Affected | Fixed in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` | 1.0.0 through 2.0.0, and date versions through 2026.8.31 | 2.0.1 |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything` | 1.0.0 through 2.0.0, and date versions 2025.9.24 through 2026.8.31 | 2.0.1 |
| `mcp-server-fetch` | through 2026.10.19 | 2026.10.24 |

### `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` 2.0.1

* **Writes stay inside the directory that was checked** (Linux and macOS). A parent directory swapped for a symlink between the access check and the write can no longer redirect `write_file`, `edit_file`, `create_directory` or the `move_file` destination outside the allowed directories. **On Windows this is only partly fixed**; the advisory says what is still exposed and how to configure around it ([GHSA-53mr-w429-c597](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-53mr-w429-c597))
* **Paths are checked exactly as they are used.** The access check no longer strips a trailing quote or whitespace that the file operation keeps, so a sibling directory named after an allowed one with that suffix is no longer reachable ([GHSA-7rgq-gccq-qphx](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-7rgq-gccq-qphx))
* **A symlink spelled in a different letter case no longer passes the symlink check** for a new path on a case-insensitive volume, such as macOS's default. This was a regression in 2026.8.31 ([GHSA-4gxg-m5jx-9j57](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-4gxg-m5jx-9j57))
* **`list_directory_with_sizes` checks each entry before reading its size**, so a symlink inside an allowed directory no longer reveals the size and modification time of a file outside it ([GHSA-hhwq-wxfx-cj7g](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-hhwq-wxfx-cj7g))

### `@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything` 2.0.1

* **The HTTP and SSE transports refuse requests from other web origins.** They now check the `Origin` header and no longer send `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, so a web page the user visits can no longer call the server's tools (such as `get-env`) or read their results ([GHSA-mvf5-2qqv-rg3c](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-mvf5-2qqv-rg3c))

### `mcp-server-fetch` 2026.10.24

* **The address check and the connection use the same host name.** For an internationalized (IDNA) host name, the server used to check one form of the name and connect to another, which could reach an internal address ([GHSA-v38p-wf49-hx2j](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-v38p-wf49-hx2j))
* **NAT64 addresses are judged by the IPv4 address they carry.** An address in `64:ff9b::/96` that wraps a private, loopback or link-local IPv4 address is now refused, as an IPv4-mapped one already was ([GHSA-66qx-2266-pmj6](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-66qx-2266-pmj6))
* **robots.txt is checked again after every redirect**, not only for the URL first requested ([GHSA-3jqg-r5pp-rmp2](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-3jqg-r5pp-rmp2))

### Upgrading from a date-versioned npm release

The TypeScript servers moved from date versions (2025.x, 2026.x) to semantic versions in 1.0.0. Package managers rank 2.0.1 below every 2025.x and 2026.x version, so they won't offer it as an upgrade. If you are on a date version, install 2.0.1 explicitly, for example `npm install @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@2.0.1`.

## Packages

| Package | Version | Registry | In this release |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
